Job Description:

Senior Director, Global Strategic Marketing, Heart Recovery

Location: Danvers, MA preferred. Remote work options may be considered on a case-by-case basis and if approved by the Company.

Fueled by innovation at the intersection of biology and technology, we’re developing the next generation of smarter, less invasive, more personalized treatments.

Are you passionate about improving and expanding the possibilities of Cardiovascular? Ready to join a team that’s reimagining how we heal? Our Cardiovascular team develops leading solutions for heart recovery, electrophysiology, and stroke. You will join a proud heritage of continually elevating standards of care for stroke, heart failure and atrial fibrillation (AFib) patients.

Your unique talents will help patients on their journey to wellness. Learn more at

Purpose & Summary:


We are searching for the best talent to join our team as Senior Director, Global Strategic Marketing, Heart Recovery.

The Senior Director, Global Strategic Marketing, Heart Recovery provides global strategic marketing leadership across the complete Heart Recovery portfolio, including Cardiology, Surgery and Heart Failure.

This leader defines where to play, how to win and how to create and scale differentiated value globally across the Heart Recovery continuum. The Senior Director translates patient, physician, health-system, clinical, economic, competitive and technology insights into an integrated multi-year portfolio strategy that drives patient impact, sustainable growth, innovation priorities, evidence generation, market development, and successful commercialization.

The Senior Director serves as the enterprise strategic marketing integrator for Heart Recovery, connecting the Cardiology, Surgery and Heart Failure strategies into a coherent portfolio narrative and investment agenda. The role partners closely with Product Management, R&D/Product Development, Medical and Clinical Affairs, Regulatory, Quality, HEMA/Market Access, Finance, Supply Chain and Operations, Global Professional Education, Healthcare Solutions, Regional/Customer Marketing and Commercial leadership.

The role leads a global GSM organization and establishes the capabilities, governance, talent, and operating mechanisms required to convert strategy into measurable patient adoption, market development, successful launches, sustainable revenue growth, market access, clinical adoption, and a strengthened standard of care.

Key Responsibilities:


Own the Global Heart Recovery Portfolio Strategy

  • Lead development of the multi-year global strategic marketing and portfolio strategy spanning Cardiology, Surgery and Heart Failure.
  • Define priority disease states, indications, patient populations, physician segments, care pathways, and markets.
  • Establish a clear portfolio-level Where to Play / How to Win framework.
  • Integrate market attractiveness, unmet need, competitive differentiation, clinical evidence, regulatory pathway, reimbursement, development feasibility, and financial return into portfolio choices.
  • Anticipate emerging technologies, competitors and changes in clinical practice and care-delivery models.
  • Recommend investment, acceleration, sequencing, partnering, lifecycle management or deprioritization decisions.

Create an Integrated Strategy Across Cardiology, Surgery and Heart Failure

  • Connect cardiogenic shock, High-Risk PCI, STEMI across the Cardiology platform. Integrate surgical heart recovery, high-risk cardiac surgery, and related surgical pathways. Integrate acute and chronic heart failure, right heart failure, ECMO where applicable.
  • Identify opportunities where patient identification, treatment pathways, evidence, technology, education, and market development cross platforms.

Shape the Standard of Care

  • Build disease-state and patient-pathway strategies that expand appropriate identification, referral, and treatment.
  • Understand treatment algorithms, patient journeys, stakeholder beliefs, and barriers to adoption of therapy.
  • Develop strategies addressing clinical, economic and operational adoption barriers.
  • Partner with Medical/Clinical Affairs, Professional Education and Healthcare Solutions on market-development priorities.
  • Build strategies that support hospital protocols, referral networks, treatment pathways and appropriate guideline evolution through evidence and scientific pathways.
  • Maintain deep relationships with key clinicians, investigators, societies, and external stakeholders.

Own Strategic Input to Innovation and Portfolio Development

  • Serve as the business and market voice in portfolio and innovation governance.
  • Partner with R&D to translate unmet needs and voice-of-customer insights into differentiated solutions and product requirements.
  • Define customer and market requirements, target product profiles, and product-market fit.
  • Build market models, demand forecasts, competitive scenarios, pricing assumptions, and business cases.
  • Evaluate opportunities using revenue potential, gross profit, ROI and eNPV.
  • Ensure innovation decisions reflect the complete solution, including product, evidence, patient identification, training, access, services, digital capabilities, and customer workflow.

Own Global Positioning, Value Proposition and Portfolio Narrative

  • Establish the overarching Heart Recovery strategic narrative and value proposition.
  • Define global positioning and message architecture across Cardiology, Surgery and Heart Failure.
  • Translate differentiated clinical benefit into meaningful clinical, operational, and economic value.
  • Maintain globally consistent strategic positioning while enabling appropriate local adaptation.
  • Partner with Regional Marketing and Commercial teams to translate global strategy into market-relevant activation.
  • Translate clinical and scientific evidence into commercial strategy, value propositions, and claims.
  • Identify strategic evidence gaps needed to accelerate adoption or differentiate the portfolio.
  • Partner with Clinical and MA on evidence priorities, RWE, registries, clinical programs, and publication strategies.
  • Ensure product and evidence launches operate through a common strategic framework and remain aligned with Regulatory, Medical, Quality and Legal requirements.

Partner to create Pricing and Economic-Value Strategy

  • Define global pricing strategy and pricing guardrails in partnership with HEMA, Finance, and regional teams.
  • Establish willingness-to-pay and value-based pricing hypotheses.
  • Develop economic value propositions and integrate reimbursement considerations into innovation and market-development decisions, direct partnership with HEMA
  • Develop market-access strategies for priority indications and geographies.
  • Incorporate reimbursement and economic considerations into launch sequencing and geographic expansion.

Lead Strategic Planning, Analytics and Performance Management

  • Lead the strategic marketing components of annual and long-range planning.
  • Develop global market models, patient-based forecasts, and competitive scenarios.
  • Recommend portfolio resource allocation based on expected patient and economic impact.
  • Establish KPIs linking strategy to patient identification, treatment, clinical adoption, market share, geographic expansion, pricing, access, revenue, gross profit and launch performance.
  • Establish executive dashboards for portfolio health, strategic initiatives, and launches.
  • Use market research, competitive intelligence, RWE, CRM, and commercial analytics to improve decisions.

Organizational and Leadership Responsibilities

GSM Leadership:

  • Lead and develop the Global Strategic Marketing organization across Cardiology, Surgery and Heart Failure.
  • Establish common strategic-marketing standards, tools, governance, and talent expectations.
  • Build succession plans and develop the next generation of global marketing leaders.
  • Create a culture characterized by patient centricity, strategic rigor, candor, accountability, and execution.
  • Recruit, coach, retain and develop high-performing global talent.
  • Build a strong GSM leadership bench capable of rotating into broader leadership roles.

Qualifications / Requirements:

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, life sciences, engineering, or related discipline.
  • Approximately 12+ years of progressive business experience, preferably within MedTech, medical devices, cardiovascular, healthcare or another regulated environment.
  • Significant experience leading global strategic marketing and/or upstream marketing.
  • Demonstrated experience developing multi-year portfolio, market-development, and growth strategies.
  • Proven leadership of multiple complex global products and/or evidence launches.
  • Strong command of segmentation, targeting, positioning, value proposition, pricing, forecasting, and portfolio management.
  • Strong financial acumen, including business-case development, ROI, NPV/eNPV and investment prioritization.
  • Demonstrated ability to transform voice-of-customer, market intelligence and unmet clinical need into innovation strategy and commercial opportunity.
  • Track record leading senior, global, cross-functional teams in highly matrixed organizations.
  • Significant people-leadership experience with evidence of hiring, developing, coaching, and retaining talent.
  • Experience influencing senior executives and communicating complex strategies clearly and decisively.
  • Experience operating across US and international markets.
  • Working knowledge of regulated medical-device commercialization, including FDA and major international regulatory environments.
  • Ability to travel approximately 30-40%, including international travel.

Strongly Preferred

  • MBA or other relevant advanced degree.
  • Deep cardiovascular and Heart Recovery market experience, such as mechanical circulatory support, interventional cardiology, cardiac surgery, or heart failure.
  • Direct experience developing new disease states or creating new markets.
  • HEMA, reimbursement, and health-economic strategy experience.
  • Clinical evidence and claims strategy experience.
  • Experience working directly with KOLs, investigators and professional societies.
  • Experience managing substantial portfolio budgets and making resource-allocation trade-offs.

Job Title: Associate Clinical Project Manager (COA & eCOA)

Job Location: Durham, North Carolina, United States of America

Job Location Type: Remote

The Associate Project Manager is a high-impact, remote-friendly role at the intersection of clinical outcomes, technology, and client delivery. This position supports the end-to-end execution of COA (Clinical Outcome Assessment) and eCOA licensing services for global clinical studies, serving as a trusted subject matter expert for clients and internal stakeholders alike.

In this role, you will combine expertise in COA/eCOA licensing, managed services, and technology-enabled delivery with client engagement and team collaboration skills. You’ll support complex licensing initiatives, help drive operational excellence, and ensure compliant, high-quality outcomes that directly support the success of clinical trials.

The position also offers strong opportunities for growth, influence on process and product improvements, and contributions to commercial growth through client expansion and proposal support - all while working in a flexible, remote environment with a globally respected organization.

Essential Functions

  • Supports the end-to-end delivery of COA and eCOA licensing services across client engagements, leveraging expert knowledge of IQVIA products, licensing processes, and managed services models.
  • Acts as a SME for COA/eCOA licensing activities, including license identification, permissions, fee negotiation coordination, contract execution support, and ongoing study support.
  • Identifies opportunities for additional COA, eCOA, and related services within existing client accounts and makes decisions independently within defined parameters.
  • Ensures delivery of high-quality licensing and technical services by modeling adherence to quality, compliance, and documentation standards, and reinforcing best practices across the team.
  • Oversees licensing service activities performed by Associate Delivery Consultants and Delivery Consultants, including task coordination, prioritization, and issue resolution.
  • Proactively identifies risks or issues related to licensing timelines, data availability, or vendor dependencies, ensuring appropriate mitigation and remediation plans are in place.
  • Maintains deep technical and operational knowledge of COA/eCOA licensing processes and supported applications, ensuring team readiness through ongoing knowledge sharing and training.
  • Provides structured feedback from client experiences to product management, clinical outcomes, and professional services teams to support continuous improvement of processes, tools, and offerings.
  • Supports project management activities, including coordination with internal stakeholders and client study teams, timeline management, and cost tracking.
  • Supports financial activities as needed, including licensing cost estimation, proposal inputs, invoicing coordination, and revenue tracking.
  • Participates in sales, proposal development, and client presentations related to COA/eCOA licensing services, while supporting ongoing account and study delivery activities.

Desired Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Life Sciences, Clinical Research, a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Familiarity with eCOA platforms and clinical trial technology implementations.
  • Experience with COA and/or eCOA licensing, clinical study support, or related managed services delivery.
  • Experience in CRO, life sciences, healthcare, or pharmaceutical development environments.
  • Strong understanding of quality, compliance, and documentation requirements in regulated environments.
  • Proven ability to coordinate cross-functional team work.
  • Excellent problem-solving, organizational, and client-facing communication skills.

IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other status protected by applicable law.

Any false statements, misrepresentations, or material omissions during the recruitment process will result in immediate disqualification of your application, or termination of employment if discovered later, in accordance with applicable law. We appreciate your honesty and professionalism.

Command|Link is a global SaaS Platform providing network, voice services, and IT security solutions, helping corporations consolidate their core infrastructure into a single vendor and layering on a proprietary single pane of glass platform. Command|Link has revolutionized the IT industry by tackling the problems our competitors create. In recognition for our unprecedented innovation and dedication, Command|Link was recognized as the SD-WAN Product of the Year, ITSM Visionary Spotlight, UCaaS Product of the Year, NaaS Product of the Year, Supplier of the Year, and the AT&T Strategic Growth Partner. Command|Link has built the only IT platform for scale that solves ISP vendor sprawl and IT headaches. We make it easy for our customers to get more done, maximize uptime and improve the bottom line.

Learn more about us here!

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the following states: Alabama, Arizona, Arkansas, Florida, Georgia, Indiana, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maryland, Michigan, Mississippi, Missouri, Nevada, New Hampshire, North Carolina, Ohio, Oklahoma, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Virginia, Wisconsin

About your new role:

We are seeking a driven Channel Manager with at least 3 years of full sales cycle experience, preferably within Telecom, SaaS, or IT sectors. This role focuses on developing, managing, and growing relationships within our channel partner ecosystem to drive revenue and maximize market share.

The ideal candidate has an inside sales background with a proven ability to manage the entire sales process, from prospecting and partner engagement to closing business.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and nurture relationships with existing and prospective channel partners to drive revenue growth.
  • Manage the full sales cycle, including prospecting, presenting solutions, negotiating terms, and closing deals.
  • Collaborate with partners to identify new business opportunities and co-selling initiatives.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of company products, solutions, and competitive landscape.
  • Consistently meet or exceed assigned sales quotas and key performance metrics.
  • Provide ongoing partner enablement, training, and support to maximize partner effectiveness.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to partners, providing insights that align with their business goals.
  • Maintain accurate sales forecasting and pipeline management using CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce).
  • Work closely with internal teams including marketing, technical support, and sales leadership to drive channel success.

What you'll need for success:

  • Minimum 3 years of full life cycle selling experience, including prospecting, presenting, and closing.
  • Proven inside sales experience; experience working with channel partners or in a partner-driven sales environment preferred.
  • Background in Telecom, SaaS, or IT industry is highly desirable.
  • Strong understanding of solution selling and partner-driven sales models.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Self-motivated with a strong work ethic and a results-driven mindset.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.

The base pay for this position as displayed at the bottom of the job description is a range based on our lowest geographic region, up to our highest geographic region. Pay is based on location among other factors, such as skill-set, experience, and qualifications held.

raw.description:
Learning Designer
Rasmussen University
Online/Remote

Learning Design at Rasmussen University is integral to enhancing the educational experiences of our online students. This position is focused on developing, implementing, and refining instructional materials and courses that support the diverse learning needs of our students. The Learning Designer collaborates closely with subject matter experts and programmatic ownership, leveraging educational technologies and applying instructional design principles to create effective, engaging, and accessible online learning solutions that align with Rasmussen University's commitment to student success and academic excellence.

Responsibilities:

Interested in Joining Rasmussen University as a Learning Designer? As a Learning Designer you will:

  • Design and develop assigned courses using modern learning theories and applying instructional design principles and methodologies.
  • Collaborate with subject matter experts (SMEs) to create engaging and effective learning materials.
  • Create multimedia content, including videos, interactive activities, simulations, and assessments.
  • Utilize e-learning authoring tools (e.g., Articulate Storyline) to develop interactive content.
  • Ensure content is accessible and adheres to best practices in online education.
  • Use learning management systems (LMS) to build and organize course materials.
  • Integrate various educational technologies and platforms to enhance the learning experience.
  • Analyze learner data and feedback to identify areas for improvement in course design.
  • Review and revise course materials to ensure accuracy, clarity, and alignment with the course competencies.
  • Provide course content support to students and faculty as needed.
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously, ensuring timely delivery of course content.
  • Maintain clear and consistent communication with team members and stakeholders.
  • Conduct training sessions for faculty on best practices in online teaching and course design.
  • Stay current with the trends and advancements in online education, educational technology. and instructional design.

Reporting Relationships:

The Learning Designer reports directly to the Learning Design Manager. This position does not have direct supervisory responsibilities but may provide informal leadership and guidance to other team members and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams.

Requirements:

We are looking for Learning Designers with:

  • 1-3 years of experience in instructional design, e-learning development, training, or a related field.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Instructional Design, Educational Technology, or a related field is required. Master’s degree in a related field preferred.
  • Experience in designing and developing online courses for higher education.
  • Experience with online learning management systems (Blackboard, D2L, Moodle, etc.).
  • Proficiency in e-learning authoring tools such as Articulate Storyline, H5P, or similar.
  • Quality Matters (QM) certification or experience with QM standards preferred.
  • Strong understanding of instructional design models and theories (e.g., ADDIE, SAM, backward design).
  • Familiarity with accessibility standards and ensuring course materials are accessible to all learners.
  • Excellent project management skills with the ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Adaptable to new technologies and tools.
  • Commitment to continuous learning and professional development.
  • Ability to analyze learner data and feedback to inform course improvements.
  • Creative problem-solving abilities and attention to detail.

About Us:

American Public University System (the System) is accredited by the Higher Learning Commission (HLC) (www.hlcommission.org), an institutional accreditation agency recognized by the U.S. Department of Education. HLC accredits degree-granting institutions nationwide and is also recognized by the Council for Higher Education Accreditation. The System is comprised of American Military University, American Public University, Rasmussen University, and Hondros College of Nursing. The System is authorized by the West Virginia Higher Education Policy Commission and other appropriate agencies in the states where it has campuses. The System is authorized to operate as a postsecondary educational institution by the Illinois Board of Higher Education. American Public University System, Inc., which operates the System, is a wholly owned subsidiary of American Public Education, Inc. American Public University System, American Public University, and American Military University are not affiliated with American University or the U.S. Military.

It is the policy of Rasmussen University to afford equal opportunity to all qualified persons. We treat all qualified individuals equally as to their recruitment, hiring, assignments, advancements, compensation, and all other terms and conditions of employment. Rasmussen University does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, sex, age, national origin, sexual orientation, or physical, mental, or sensory disability, or any other characteristic protected by law.

🧭 Position Summary

As a Care Coordinator I – Translationsat MTI America, you will provide high-quality, “white glove” customer service to injured workers, clients, providers, and vendor partners throughout the referral and service-delivery process.

The Care Coordinator is responsible for processing referrals, coordinating medical products and services, communicating referral status and updates, obtaining required information and authorizations, maintaining accurate documentation, and supporting timely service delivery. This role requires strong attention to detail, sound judgment, empathy, and the ability to manage multiple priorities, communication channels, and systems in a fast-paced healthcare environment.

✅ Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as a primary point of contact for referrals, inquiries, and service requests from injured workers, clients, providers, claims adjusters, nurse case managers, and vendor partners.
  • Process and coordinate referrals for medical products and services in accordance with established workflows, client requirements, state regulations, and applicable workers’ compensation guidelines.
  • Contact injured workers regarding new and existing referrals to confirm demographic information, scheduling needs, referral details, and other required information.
  • Provide timely updates regarding referral status and the delivery of medical products and services.
  • Coordinate scheduling, authorizations, service delivery, and follow-up activities based on detailed referral specifications and established processes.
  • Identify and procure appropriate vendor partners based on the products or services requested and applicable network requirements.
  • Obtain and communicate quotes to clients as needed and follow up to secure required written authorization for medically necessary products or services.
  • Communicate with vendor partners, claims adjusters, nurse case managers, providers, and other stakeholders regarding new and existing referrals.
  • Confirm required and relevant billing information is complete and aligned with established workflow and billing processes.
  • Accurately enter verbal and written claim and referral information into company systems in accordance with internal and external customer requirements.
  • Maintain complete, concise, accurate, and professional case notes and documentation throughout the referral lifecycle.
  • Review documentation for accuracy and completeness prior to submission, billing, or referral closure.
  • Provide excellent customer service and demonstrate empathy when assisting injured workers, clients, providers, and other callers.
  • Work toward first-contact resolution whenever possible and appropriately escalate issues requiring additional support.
  • Manage multiple priorities, systems, and communication channels simultaneously while meeting established deadlines and service expectations.
  • Meet or exceed established departmental performance and quality competencies.
  • Collaborate effectively with internal teams and external partners to resolve service issues and support positive outcomes.
  • Perform other duties as assigned based on business needs.

🎓 Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Bilingual English/Spanish.
  • Minimum of two (2) years of experience in healthcare network scheduling, patient care scheduling, medical service coordination, or a related healthcare environment; an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate documentation.
  • Sound judgment, critical-thinking, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to work across multiple communication channels and systems simultaneously.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and database or case-management systems.

💡 Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in workers’ compensation, managed care, claims management, or medical coordination.
  • Knowledge of medical terminology and healthcare processes.
  • Understanding of claims management and authorization processes.
  • Experience coordinating medical products, services, or durable medical equipment.
  • Associate degree or higher.

🧠 SkillsDescriptions

Customer Service & Relationship Management

Builds rapport with injured workers, clients, providers, and vendor partners while delivering responsive, empathetic, and professional service.

Communication & Active Listening

Clearly communicates information verbally and in writing, listens attentively, and appropriately adapts communication to the needs of different stakeholders.

Referral Coordination & Follow-Through

Effectively manages referrals from receipt through service delivery and closure, ensuring required scheduling, authorizations, documentation, and follow-up activities are completed.

Data Entry & Documentation

Accurately enters, tracks, and maintains sensitive claim, referral, and patient information within company systems.

Problem-Solving & Critical Thinking

Identifies issues, evaluates available information and options, exercises sound judgment, and appropriately resolves or escalates concerns.

Attention to Detail & Accuracy

Ensures case notes, referral information, billing information, documentation, and communications are complete, consistent, and accurate.

Adaptability & MultitaskingEffectively works across multiple systems and communication channels while adapting to changing priorities and service needs.

🏢 Work Environment & Physical Requirements

  • Position may be remote, hybrid, or on-site based on business needs and position assignment.
  • Ability to work at a computer workstation for extended periods.
  • Ability to work effectively in a virtual environment when assigned remotely.

Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. About the Role:

We are looking for a Head of Sanctions to help shape, strengthen, and scale a high-performing compliance culture across the global Compliance organization.

This senior leadership role reports into the Global Head of Financial Crimes and is responsible for the global sanctions programme end to end — the framework, the controls, the technology, and the team — covering sanctions advisory, list management, screening, investigations and reporting. In addition, hold executive accountability for the geofencing programme and for all name screening controls covering PEP and adverse media.

The ideal candidate is a strong compliance leader and operator who can combine regulatory awareness, program management, stakeholder engagement, and practical execution in a fast-moving environment. Experience in crypto, fintech or financial services is strongly preferred.

What You’ll Do:

Sanctions programme

  • Set and maintain the global sanctions framework, policy, and standards; ensure alignment with global and local sanction regulation requirements. Lead sanctions advisory on escalated matters: complex escalations, exposure analysis, licensing strategy, and voluntary disclosure. Lead sanctions-related regulatory filings, metrics, and board/committee reporting.

Name screening — PEP and adverse media

  • Lead all name screening controls globally: sanctions, PEP and adverse media — covering onboarding and ongoing screening. Drive screening technology strategy with Engineering and vendor management — evaluation, implementation, and continuous optimisation. Lead the design of adverse media taxonomy and severity tiering, ensuring consistency and defensibility in judgement.

Geofencing programme

  • Hold executive ownership of the geofencing and jurisdictional access control programme: residency and onboarding restrictions, IP and location controls, app store and web access, VPN/proxy detection, and perimeter integrity testing. Define the target-state control architecture and drive its delivery with Product, Engineering, and Data..

Leadership and delivery

  • Build, lead, and develop a global, multi-jurisdiction team; set clear accountabilities and a strong quality culture.
  • Represent the function in audits, regulatory exams, and independent reviews; own findings and remediation.
  • Partner with Training to build capability across first-line and compliance teams.

What We’re Looking For:

  • 10+ years of relevant experience in financial crime compliance, with at least 6+ years leading a sanctions function at scale in a regulated financial institution or VASP.
  • Direct, demonstrable ownership of name screening controls across PEP and adverse media — not advisory-only exposure.
  • Experience designing or running a geofencing / jurisdictional access control programme, or equivalent perimeter control ownership.
  • Experience of regulatory engagement and exam management on sanctions matters.
  • Fluency with screening technology: matching algorithms, threshold tuning, transliteration handling, and alert workflow design.
  • Working knowledge of on-chain analytics and wallet screening for sanctions exposure (Chainalysis, Elliptic, TRM or equivalent).
  • Strong understanding of compliance program management in a regulated or high-growth environment.
  • Experience managing global or multi-market compliance initiatives.
  • Proven ability to lead complex programs with multiple stakeholders, timelines, dependencies, and governance requirements
  • Strong project management skills, including planning, execution, reporting, issue tracking, and remediation management.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex topics for different audiences.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, including working with senior leadership, regional teams, external vendors, and cross-functional partners.
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, remote, global, and rapidly evolving environment.

Why Binance

Carda Health is building the world's first patient-centered virtual heart and lung platform, starting with cardiac and pulmonary rehab. With only 10% of eligible patients accessing rehab, we're revolutionizing care through accessible, effective, and engaging home-based programs. We are a team of clinicians, mathematicians, entrepreneurs, and engineers who believe technology and data, when applied ethically, can transform healthcare.

Who are you?

You are a seasoned people operations leader who has built and scaled HR infrastructure at a growing company. You've owned the full employee lifecycle, benefits, and multi-state compliance, and you've built the systems and policies that let a team grow without losing the details. You move easily between strategy and execution: designing a leave policy one day, handling a sensitive employee relations matter the next. You hold a high bar on accuracy, confidentiality, and compliance, and you know how to turn regulatory requirements into simple processes employees actually follow. You're ready to own and shape the people function for a fast-growing virtual care company.

What will you do?

As Senior Manager of People Operations, you will own people operations at Carda Health end to end for a remote, multi-state team of clinicians and corporate staff. Reporting to the Head of Operations, you will set the direction for our people programs, serve as the escalation point for complex employee matters, and build the processes, policies, and systems that support our next stage of growth. You will help build out the team over time.

In a little more detail, you will be expected to:

  • Design scalable onboarding, offboarding, and internal transition processes for employees and contractors, with a particular focus on clinical hires
  • Own our HRIS and payroll stack, including configuration, integrations, data integrity, and reporting, and lead vendor evaluation and implementation as we outgrow current tools
  • Lead benefits strategy and administration, including annual renewals, broker and carrier management, plan design and benchmarking, open enrollment, and ACA compliance and reporting
  • Own leave and accommodation programs (FMLA, ADA, state paid leave), managing complex cases directly and partnering with outside counsel as needed
  • Oversee payroll accuracy and controls in partnership with Finance, including multi-state tax registrations and audits
  • Build and maintain a multi-state compliance program: policies and handbook, required postings, registrations, HIPAA and annual training, and audit readiness
  • Serve as the escalation point for employee relations, including investigations, performance documentation, and terminations, partnering with managers and counsel
  • Partner with clinical leadership on licensure tracking, credentialing support, and workforce compliance for clinicians across states
  • Build people metrics and reporting (headcount, turnover, time to hire, benefits cost) for leadership and board materials
  • Support compensation administration, including salary bands, leveling, and annual review cycles

What we look for

  • 8+ years of experience in HR or people operations, including at least 2 years owning the function or a major part of it at a startup or high-growth company
  • Deep experience administering and configuring an HRIS and payroll platform (such as Rippling, Gusto, Justworks, or ADP), including at least one implementation or migration
  • Comfort in building and automating processes using AI and LLMs
  • Strong command of multi-state employment law and compliance, including I-9 and E-Verify, FMLA, ADA, state leave laws, wage and hour, and worker classification
  • Experience leading benefits renewals, managing brokers, and owning ACA compliance for an applicable large employer
  • A track record handling employee relations matters, including investigations and terminations, with sound judgment
  • Ability to build processes and policies from scratch and document them so they scale
  • Comfort with data: building reports and using metrics to inform decisions
  • Excellent judgment and discretion with confidential information
  • Clear, warm written communication suited to a remote team, and credibility with executives and frontline clinicians alike

Nice to haves

  • Experience in healthcare or another regulated industry, especially supporting a clinical workforce
  • Experience with clinician licensure, credentialing, or multi-state license compliance
  • Experience supporting a company through rapid headcount growth or a funding stage transition
  • Experience managing or mentoring HR team members
  • PHR, SPHR, SHRM-CP, or SHRM-SCP certification
  • Prior experience at an early-stage health tech company

Introductie

Ben jij een gediplomeerd apothekersassistent met oog voor kwaliteit, processen en samenwerking? Zoek je een veelzijdige functie waarin je farmaceutische zorg combineert met coördinatie, innovatie en digitale zorg? Dan is deze rol bij Wellis Pharmacy iets voor jou!

In deze functie werk je volledig remote, in een digitaal team dat farmaceutische zorg verleent aan Nederlandse én Duitstalige cliënten.

Over Wellis

Wellis is een snelgroeiende healthtech scale-up die één van de meest traditionele sectoren opnieuw uitvindt: de apotheek. Wat nog maar kort geleden begon, is inmiddels uitgegroeid tot een winstgevend Europees bedrijf met tienduizenden klanten — en we staan pas aan het begin.

Door medische expertise te combineren met technologie en data maken we de zorg slimmer, efficiënter en persoonlijker. We richten ons op thema’s zoals gewichtsbeheersing, leefstijlbegeleiding en medicatie op maat.

Bij Wellis sluit je je aan bij een jong, ambitieus team dat snel schakelt, conventies doorbreekt en bouwt met impact. We creëren een omgeving waar professionals zich thuis voelen: met korte communicatielijnen, veel eigenaarschap en de energie van een organisatie die hard groeit.

Over de rol

Als Online Apothekersassistent ben jij de verbindende schakel tussen cliënten, apothekers en het logistieke team. Je zorgt dat alles soepel verloopt: van intake tot medicatieverstrekking. Je combineert klantgericht contact met procesmatig inzicht en kwaliteitsbewust werken — volledig digitaal, vanuit huis.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden

  • Cliëntcontact & farmaceutische zorg: uitvoeren van telefonische intakes, beantwoorden van vragen via telefoon, e-mail en chat.

  • Dossierbeheer: controleren en aanvullen van cliëntendossiers, bewaken van medicatieveiligheid en signaleren van bijzonderheden.

  • Samenwerking met apothekers: afstemmen over recepten en afwijkingen, zorgen voor correcte documentatie volgens wet- en regelgeving.

  • Procescoördinatie: ondersteunen van de logistieke processen op afstand en meedenken over verbeteringen in workflow en kwaliteit.

  • Kwaliteitsbewaking: bijdragen aan het borgen van procedures en meewerken aan optimalisatie van digitale zorgprocessen.

Requirements

Wie ben jij

  • Diploma MBO-4 Apothekersassistent, dokterassistent of verpleegkunde.

  • Minimaal 5 jaar werkervaring als apothekersassistent, doktersassistent of verpleegkundige.

  • Affiniteit met digitale zorg en ervaring met werken in online systemen.

  • Communicatief sterk, klantgericht en nauwkeurig.

  • Vloeiend Nederlands én goed Engels.

  • Je woont in Nederland.

  • Zelfstandig, verantwoordelijk en organisatorisch sterk.

  • Proactief en in staat om verbeteringen aan te dragen.

  • Beschikbaar voor minimaal 24 uur/week.

Wat bieden wij

  • Een volledig remote functie met veel autonomie en flexibiliteit.

  • Marktconform salaris volgens CAO Apotheken, inclusief pensioen.

  • Flexibele werktijden tussen 08:00 en 23:00 uur (maandag t/m zondag).

  • Werken binnen een enthousiast en deskundig team dat digitale zorg vormgeeft.

  • Ruimte voor professionele ontwikkeling en persoonlijke groei.

  • De mogelijkheid tot volledig flexibel remote werken, zodat werk en privé in balans blijven;

  • De mogelijkheid om meer te werken en vrije tijd op te bouwen of uit te laten keren;

  • Meerdere leuke teamuitjes;

  • Hele leuke collega's :)

Hiring Proces

  • Sollicitatie – Stuur je CV en motivatie via onze website.

  • Kennismaking – Kort online gesprek met HR om jouw ervaring en motivatie te bespreken.

  • Inhoudelijk gesprek – Met onze apotheker en coördinator over de inhoud van de functie.

  • Finale kennismaking – Met het management, om te kijken of er een goede match is.

Highlights

Een veelzijdige, volledig remote rol waarin je jouw farmaceutische kennis combineert met digitale zorg en procescoördinatie — met ruimte om door te groeien in een snelgroeiende organisatie.

raw.description:
Flying Bisons is a leading Strategic Design & Digital Consulting company based in Warsaw, with projects across Europe and the Middle East. Our mission is to help our clients Unleash Digital Potential.

We work at scales where real impact happens: enterprise platforms, government services, and corporate ecosystems used by millions of people. Our projects include national workforce platforms (Qiwa, Ajeer), education ecosystems (Madares), major banks (Bank Pekao, Alinma), global telecoms (Ooredoo, Salam), and international brands (KFC, Hebe, NaTemat, Enel-Med).

Our uniqueness comes from going beyond design craft. As we wrote in our manifestos, Strategic Design Manifest and Strategic Design: The Future of Design, design craft is only 10% of success. The other 90%, the Invisible 90%, is about navigating politics, aligning stakeholders, and protecting fragile visions until they reach reality.

That’s why we’re building the discipline of Strategic Design, and we invite you to cooperate with us in this area.

As a Lead Product Designer at Flying Bisons, you'll take hands-on ownership of designing and delivering outstanding digital products, combining exceptional UX and visual craft with strong product thinking, client collaboration and AI-powered workflows.

Scope of services

  • Leading product design projects from the initial concept to launch.

  • Creating high-quality user experiences and visually outstanding interfaces for digital products.

  • Translating business objectives and user needs into clear, intuitive product experiences.

  • Developing concepts, user flows, wireframes, high-fidelity designs and interactive prototypes.

  • Presenting design solutions to clients, communicating their value and defending design decisions.

  • Collaborating closely with product managers and developers to define solutions and ensure successful implementation.

  • Using AI-powered tools and workflows to accelerate design, exploration, prototyping and delivery.

What we are looking for

We're looking for a hands-on designer who leads through craft and ownership. Someone who designs every day, takes responsibility for the product and pushes projects forward.

This is not a people-management role. We care about the quality of your work and your ability to make things happen, not your job title.

What you bring:

  • Top-tier visual design: Exceptional visual taste and the ability to create interfaces that stand out among the best digital products on the market.

  • Top-tier UX skills: A strong understanding of both business objectives and user needs, with the ability to translate them into simple, intuitive and effective product experiences.

Nice to have

  • Motion design skills and experience creating engaging interactions and animations.

  • Branding experience and a strong understanding of visual identity.

Cooperation terms

raw.excerpt: About Vcheck Vcheck was founded in 2012 on the belief that the investigative rigor of a boutique firm could be brought to scale through technology.
raw.description:
About Vcheck

Vcheck was founded in 2012 on the belief that the investigative rigor of a boutique firm could be brought to scale through technology. Today, we run more than 25,000 investigations a year across six continents, helping financial institutions, private equity firms, and Fortune 500 companies see clearly through complexity and make decisions with confidence. Based in New York, with team members in the US, Canada, Romania, and India, we have earned a place on the Inc. 5000 for five consecutive years and are backed by Sunstone Partners as we enter our next phase of growth.

We are building something different: a portfolio risk management platform that pairs the rigor of an investigative shop with the efficiency of a modern technology company. Our team brings together talent from tech and SaaS companies with people from compliance, law enforcement, journalism, and many other fields. Whatever path brought each of us here, what unites us is curiosity, attention to detail, and a commitment to getting it right.

About the role

We are looking for an AI Architect to design, build, and operate the AI systems that power Vcheck’s technology transformation. This is a hands-on technical leadership role where you are expected to ship systems, not just design them. You will own the architecture of our agentic AI capabilities, from model selection and prompt engineering to agent orchestration, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise software integration, while leading a small AI and automation team and setting the technical standard for how AI is embedded across the business. This is not an AI research role or an innovation lab experiment, so success means production AI systems that work, scale, and help Vcheck move faster, spend less, and deliver higher quality than our competitors. This is a remote role based in the US, with candidates in the NYC metro area preferred.

What you'll be doing

  • Design and implement multi-agent AI architectures for business critical workflows, including agentic orchestration systems, AI augmented software delivery pipelines, and intelligent automation across operations and service delivery.
  • Evaluate and select AI models, frameworks, and tooling (LLMs, embedding models, vector databases, orchestration layers) for each use case, balancing capability, latency, cost, and reliability.
  • Own the architecture and evolution of internal AI frameworks, including reusable prompt libraries, agent pipelines, and workflow automation tooling that multiply the team’s capacity across initiatives.
  • Define and implement integration patterns that connect AI systems to Vcheck’s enterprise software stack (ERP, CRM, ticketing, data platforms) through APIs, webhooks, and protocol layers.
  • Manage and develop a small AI and automation team, and set engineering standards for code quality, testing, documentation, and deployment.
  • Design and maintain observability systems that track AI adoption, output quality, accuracy, cost, and ROI, and keep automated outputs at 99%+ accuracy through reflection and review loops.
  • Implement AI governance standards, including model evaluation, output validation, audit trails, data residency, and compliance with Vcheck’s security and regulatory requirements.
  • Upskill engineering and operations teams on AI implementation best practices, agentic design patterns, and prompt engineering so AI adoption scales beyond the AI team.
  • Other duties as assigned

About you

Key requirements:

We're looking for someone who is passionate about joining a diverse team and is driven to achieve results through ownership, process optimization, and upstanding character. If this describes you, we encourage you to apply, even if you don't meet every requirement listed.

  • 8+ years of software engineering or architecture experience, with the last 3+ years focused substantially on AI/ML systems in production.
  • Deep hands on experience building with LLMs, including prompt engineering, RAG architectures, fine tuning tradeoffs, context window management, and tool and function calling.
  • Experience designing and deploying multi-agent AI systems in production, including orchestration, task delegation, error handling, and observability.
  • Proficiency in Python (preferred) or an equivalent language, with the ability to read and work across production codebases in multiple languages.
  • Solid cloud infrastructure experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP, including deployment, scaling, cost management, and security.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to document architecture decisions clearly enough that other engineers can build on them without your involvement.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead small technical teams and set engineering standards.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and Microsoft Teams.
  • Experience with AI native development tools and workflows such as Claude Code, Copilot, or Cursor is preferred.
  • Familiarity with vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector), embedding pipelines, and semantic search architectures is valued.
  • Background integrating AI systems with enterprise software through APIs, webhooks, and protocol layers (MCP, REST, GraphQL) is preferred.
  • Experience with AI governance, including model evaluation, output validation, audit trails, and data residency constraints in enterprise environments, is valued.
  • Prior experience in a B2B technology enabled services company, a SaaS environment, or due diligence and background screening is a plus.

Why us?

You will be joining a cutting-edge company, where you will tackle complex challenges and work with the very best in the industry. In addition, we offer:

  • Competitive compensation package, including equity
  • Comprehensive benefits, including medical, dental, & vision insurance coverage for you & your loved ones
  • 401k plan with a 4% employer match
  • Flexible vacation policy, encouraging you to take the time you need
  • Annual wellness allowance to support your health and well-being
  • Quarterly team events to keep us connected in a hybrid environment
  • Playing a vital role in shaping our company's future
  • A fun and collaborative work environment where you'll be supported by a team of dedicated and collaborative colleagues

Please be aware that Vcheck uses AI-powered note-taking, interview recording, and transcription tools to ensure accuracy and efficiency during our talent acquisition processes. By participating in the application and interview stages, you acknowledge and consent to the use of these technologies.

Vcheck is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, age, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other factor protected by applicable law. This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leave of absence, compensation, benefits, and training.

Vcheck expressly prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, age, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

No matter what background you bring with you, if you are committed to excellence and good at what you do, we welcome you to apply to join us and encourage you to come as you are.

raw.description:
About the Company:

ProFarm is an agricultural technology company developing biological solutions that help growers protect their crops, improve productivity, and achieve better economic outcomes.

We're entering a new chapter, with new leadership, an expanding product portfolio, a renewed focus on commercial execution, and a comprehensive rebrand underway.

We believe agricultural marketing can be more distinctive, compelling, and thoughtfully executed without sacrificing the scientific credibility and practicality our customers expect.

We're looking for someone who can help us bring that vision to life.

The Opportunity:

We're seeking a Brand & Marketing Manager to drive the day-to-day execution of ProFarm's marketing, creative, and communications activities.

This is a hands-on role for someone who combines excellent creative instincts, strong communication skills, operational discipline, and an enthusiasm for using modern technology and AI to work smarter and accomplish more.

You'll be responsible for ensuring our commercial team has the marketing tools it needs to succeed while helping roll out an entirely new brand identity across our business.

Your work will serve three primary audiences:

  • Our internal teams: Equipping sales, business development, and other departments with effective materials, communications, and resources.
  • Our retail and distribution partners: Helping partners understand, promote, and sell ProFarm products.
  • Growers: Communicating the practical, technical, and economic value of our solutions in ways that resonate with the people using them.

On any given day, you might be developing a sales presentation, creating a digital campaign, updating our website, coordinating a trade show, organizing a webinar, drafting a company announcement, or bringing a new piece of branded apparel to life.

We don't expect you to be an expert in every marketing discipline. We do expect you to be resourceful, organized, creatively ambitious, and capable of using AI tools and outside specialists to deliver excellent work.

You'll report to our COO and work closely with our SVP of Growth, commercial organization, and company leadership.

What You'll Do:

Commercial Marketing & Sales Enablement:

  • Create and maintain high-quality sales presentations, product sheets, retailer materials, brochures, and other commercial assets.
  • Support the execution of product launches, distributor initiatives, pricing and promotional programs, and targeted campaigns.
  • Work with sales, product management, and technical teams to translate complex information into clear, compelling communications.
  • Help our sales organization deliver consistent messaging across territories, products, and customer segments.
  • Maintain an organized, accessible library of current marketing assets and sales tools.

Brand, Design & Creative:

  • Help implement ProFarm's new visual identity across all internal and external touchpoints.
  • Design and produce compelling assets for presentations, digital channels, print, events, and other media.
  • Maintain consistent creative standards across work produced internally and by external partners.
  • Coordinate with creative agencies, freelance designers, photographers, printers, and production vendors as needed.
  • Develop distinctive branded merchandise, apparel, and other creative applications that reinforce our identity.
  • Bring fresh ideas and creative approaches that help differentiate ProFarm in the agricultural industry.

Communications, Content & Digital Marketing:

  • Develop, edit, and coordinate content for our website, LinkedIn, social channels, email campaigns, and other communications.
  • Help establish and maintain a clear, consistent voice across company communications.
  • Coordinate press releases, company announcements, public relations activities, and internal communications.
  • Support organic digital marketing and the execution of targeted paid-media initiatives when appropriate.
  • Maintain website content and coordinate with external development or technical resources.
  • Support content development for product education, customer stories, and industry thought leadership.
  • Coordinate technical and regulatory reviews to ensure product claims and marketing materials are accurate and appropriate.

Events, Webinars & Marketing Operations:

  • Coordinate trade shows, conferences, field events, customer meetings, and other industry activities.
  • Support webinar planning, promotion, production, and follow-up.
  • Manage marketing calendars, project schedules, deliverables, and vendor coordination.
  • Oversee production and distribution of marketing collateral, event materials, and promotional items.
  • Help manage marketing expenditures, vendor relationships, and project budgets.
  • Establish efficient, repeatable processes that help the organization execute marketing activities consistently and on time.
  • Track relevant marketing activity and performance to identify opportunities for improvement.

AI-Enabled Marketing Execution:

We believe AI and emerging creative technologies can fundamentally change what a lean, talented marketing function can accomplish. This is a central part of how we expect this role to operate.

You'll be expected to actively explore, adopt, and integrate AI tools into your daily work, including:

  • Accelerating content creation, copywriting, editing, research, and creative ideation.
  • Developing and adapting visual assets, presentations, and campaign materials across formats and audiences.
  • Streamlining repetitive workflows, content repurposing, and marketing production.
  • Improving the efficiency of project management, reporting, and internal coordination.
  • Evaluating new AI tools and identifying practical opportunities to improve output and efficiency.

We're not looking for someone who simply uses AI occasionally. We're looking for someone who is genuinely curious about these technologies and can demonstrate how they use them to produce better work, faster, without compromising accuracy, judgment, or creative quality.

What We're Looking For:

Strong creative instincts. You have an excellent eye for design, typography, layout, and visual storytelling. You care deeply about how things look and recognize when something needs another round of refinement.

A hands-on, get-it-done mentality. You enjoy creating things yourself, solving problems, and seeing projects through from concept to delivery. No task is beneath you.

Excellent communication skills. You're a strong writer and editor who can communicate clearly to different audiences, from internal employees to retailers and growers.

Outstanding organization. You can manage multiple projects and stakeholders, stay ahead of deadlines, and keep the details straight.

AI fluency and curiosity. You're comfortable experimenting with new technologies and have demonstrated how AI can improve your productivity, creative output, and workflows.

High standards and good judgment. You care about quality, take feedback well, and continuously improve your work.

Resourcefulness and ownership. You know when to do something yourself, when to leverage technology, and when to bring in outside expertise.

Experience & Qualifications:

  • B.S. or B.A. degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related field.
  • Approximately 3–6 years of relevant experience in marketing, brand communications, graphic design, creative production, or a related field. We value demonstrated capability over years of experience.
  • A strong creative portfolio showing work you've personally developed or helped deliver.
  • Proficiency with creative tools such as Adobe Creative Cloud, Figma, Canva, or comparable platforms.
  • Demonstrated experience using AI tools to improve creative or operational workflows.
  • Strong writing, editing, and presentation-development skills.
  • Experience with digital content, social media, website content management, and marketing communications.
  • Strong project management skills and experience working with vendors or external creative partners.
  • Comfort learning technical subject matter and translating it into approachable marketing content.
  • Ability and willingness to travel occasionally for company meetings, field visits, trade shows, and other events.

Experience in agriculture, crop protection, biologicals, or technical B2B marketing is helpful but not required.

We're more interested in your creativity, initiative, work ethic, and demonstrated ability to deliver exceptional work.

What Success Looks Like:

In your first year, you'll have:

  • Helped successfully launch ProFarm's new brand identity across its most important touchpoints.
  • Improved the quality, consistency, and availability of materials supporting our sales organization.
  • Established dependable processes for communications, marketing campaigns, events, and digital content.
  • Built an organized and accessible library of current commercial and creative assets.
  • Demonstrated meaningful improvements in marketing productivity through AI-enabled workflows.
  • Developed strong working relationships with our internal teams and external partners.
  • Become a trusted resource who can take a project from an initial idea to a polished, completed deliverable with minimal oversight.

Why Join ProFarm?

This isn't a role where you'll spend your days maintaining an established marketing machine. You'll help build a modern, efficient marketing function at an important stage in our company's evolution.

You'll have meaningful ownership, exposure to senior leadership, opportunities to work across a wide variety of creative and commercial projects, and the freedom to bring new ideas to an industry ready for a fresh approach.

We're looking for someone who wants to grow with the business, takes pride in the quality of their work, and is excited about what a talented individual equipped with modern tools can accomplish.

Compensation:

  • ProFarm offers a comprehensive benefits package including a 401(k) plan with employer match, and a health plan including medical and dental coverage, life insurance coverage, long term disability, and a flexible spending account for dependent care and/or medical expenses.
  • The above is a list of essential duties and responsibilities for this position. This list is not all-inclusive and other duties may be assigned. This job description may be modified as needed.
  • ProFarm is an equal-opportunity employer. A pre-employment background check will be required.

We want to see your work! Applications should include one or two examples of your marketing work, such as a campaign, a brand project, written content, or a strategy you developed.

raw.title: Configuration/Source Code Repository Lead
raw.excerpt: Overview The Configuration Manager sets up and sustains Git-based source control for the Remote Order Entry System (ROES) on the Supply Chain Management Development Security Operations (SCM DSO) program.
raw.description:
Overview

The Configuration Manager sets up and sustains Git-based source control for the Remote Order Entry System (ROES) on the Supply Chain Management Development Security Operations (SCM DSO) program. ROES is a large VistA code base written in MUMPS (M) and hosted on InterSystems Caché or IRIS. VistA code has traditionally been managed in routine and global files rather than in file-based repositories. This role bridges that world and modern DevSecOps. The Configuration Manager exports routines and related artifacts into a structured GitHub repository, defines branching and check-in/check-out practices that fit M development, and builds automation so code moves reliably between Caché namespaces and environments. After the initial setup, the role maintains configuration baselines and release integrity over the application's lifecycle.

At TISTA, you’ll do meaningful, mission‑driven work that improves lives alongside teammates you trust and leaders who are transparent and supportive. We invest in your learning and internal mobility so you can build a career that keeps advancing. We’re proud to serve and hire Veterans, and we put people first in everything we do.

TISTA associates enjoy above Industry Healthcare Benefits, Remote Working Options, Paid Time Off, Training/Certification opportunities, Healthcare Savings Account & Flexible Savings Account, Paid Life Insurance, Short-term & Long-term Disability, 401K Match, Tuition Reimbursement, Employee Assistance Program, Paid Holidays, Military Leave, and much more!


Responsibilities

Repository Setup and Architecture

  • Design the GitHub organization and repository structure for a large MUMPS code base, including package-based directory layouts (for example, one directory per VistA package or namespace) and a decision on monorepo versus multi-repo.
  • Establish the repository as the source of truth by exporting routines (.m or .int files), data dictionaries, and other artifacts, and by reconciling differences between development, test, and production accounts.
  • Configure teams, roles, and least-privilege access integrated with VA identity services, and handle large files and binary artifacts appropriately.

Branching, Merging, and Check-In/Check-Out for M Code

  • Define, document, and enforce a branching strategy suited to VistA patch cadence (for example, trunk-based with short-lived feature branches, plus release and hotfix branches tied to patch streams).
  • Establish conventions for routine naming, namespace ownership, line-level formatting, and commit messages that reference patch or work item IDs.
  • Configure branch protection, required reviews, CODEOWNERS by package, and status checks.
  • Resolve merge conflicts specific to M code, such as concurrent edits to shared routines, and coach developers who are new to Git on pull request workflows.
  • Provide guidance on keeping Caché namespaces and Git branches synchronized, including import and export procedures for developers working in Studio, VS Code (with the InterSystems ObjectScript extension), or terminal sessions.

Workflow Streamlining and Automation

  • Build CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions (self-hosted runners as needed inside the VA boundary) or comparable tools to import code into disposable Caché or IRIS test instances, compile routines, and run automated tests.
  • Integrate M-aware quality gates, such as the M-Unit testing framework, static analysis and standards checking (for example, XINDEX-style checks or open-source M linters), and routine size and structure checks.
  • Automate KIDS build and patch assembly, packaging, and installation into target environments where permitted.
  • Use containerized Caché or IRIS instances for repeatable build and test environments, where approved.
  • Link commits to Jira or other work items for end-to-end traceability, and standardize issue, pull request, and workflow templates.

Configuration Management and Baseline Control

  • Maintain configuration baselines for routines, globals that carry configuration (such as parameters and file definitions), scripts, and environment settings across dev, test, preproduction, and production.
  • Manage versioning, tagging, and release candidates consistent with VistA patch version and sequence numbering.

Support, Training, and Transition

  • Serve as the escalation point for repository, build, and release issues.
  • Collaborate with VistA developers, testers, security staff, product owners, and the Caché/IRIS database administrators.

Qualifications

  • Five or more years of experience in software configuration management, release engineering, or DevOps, with at least two years of hands-on experience with Git and GitHub.
  • At least two years of experience working with MUMPS (M) code and InterSystems Caché or IRIS, including routines, globals, and namespaces. Working knowledge of VistA architecture.
  • Demonstrated experience defining branching and merging strategies and enforcing them across multi-developer teams.
  • Experience building CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or equivalent.
  • Proficiency with scripting (Bash, PowerShell, or Python) for exporting, importing, and automating code movement.
  • Knowledge of configuration management principles, including baselines, change control, and audits.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Eight or more years of experience in configuration management for large enterprise or government health applications.
  • Prior experience on VistA sustainment or modernization contracts, including familiarity with the VA Software Document Library, patch release processes, and VistA Evolution or similar programs.
  • Experience building or using tooling to bridge M and Git (for example, routine export and import utilities, the InterSystems Git integration or source control hooks, or open-source VistA tools).
  • Experience with M-Unit and automated testing of VistA code, and with code standards tools such as XINDEX.
  • Experience with the InterSystems ObjectScript VS Code extension and Caché Studio source control hooks.
  • Experience with GitHub Enterprise administration, SSO/SAML, and audit logging.
  • Experience with Agile and SAFe in a federal contracting environment.

Per typical contract language, additional years of relevant experience (commonly four to five years) may substitute for a degree, subject to the labor category definition in the contract.

raw.excerpt: About the Role We’re looking for an experienced Category Lead to own a services category within a fast-growing, two-sided marketplace business.
raw.description:
About the Role

We’re looking for an experienced Category Lead to own a services category within a fast-growing, two-sided marketplace business. The role has two parts: growing the category’s live partnerships and expanding the category through new partners and new regions. You’ll build the strategy, own revenue, conversion and quality targets, and lead cross-functional work with Product, Design, Engineering and Marketing. This role suits a hands-on strategy and operations leader who wants to own outcomes from start to finish in a fast-moving environment.

Key Responsibilities

Grow live partnerships

  • Grow the category’s current partnerships through promotional campaigns, demand generation and product improvements.
  • Work with Product, Design and Engineering to prioritize and ship changes that grow category performance.
  • Work with the partnerships team to strengthen key partner relationships, including joint business plans, commercial discussions and business reviews.
  • Build account playbooks that can be used at scale.

Expand the category

  • Analyze the competitive landscape and where demand is to find new partners and new regions (for example Europe, Asia or Latin America).
  • Build a clear point of view on whether, where and with whom the category should grow, and recommend which partners to pick.
  • Onboard new partners and lead launches from start to finish.

Across the category

  • Help shape the category roadmap in line with business priorities. Track performance against targets and recommend where to invest across partners and initiatives.
  • Lead complex, higher-risk programs such as new partner launches, new sub-categories, and changes to pricing or incentives. Set the execution plan and hold cross-functional teams accountable for delivering it.
  • Build the category’s KPI framework. Use data and forecasting to size opportunities, diagnose performance and frame trade-offs for leadership.
  • Turn category needs into product requirements and marketing priorities. Build alignment across Product, Marketing, Operations, Legal and Finance without direct authority.
  • Spot competitive and partner trends early and turn them into clear recommendations for leadership.
  • Share knowledge, support teammates’ growth, and raise the bar on analytical rigor and execution.

The balance between growing live partnerships and expanding the category changes case by case, so you’ll need to be strong at both.

Qualifications

Required

  • About 10 years of experience in strategy and operations, business operations, category management or a similar role
  • Hands-on experience putting operational frameworks in place and driving commercial growth
  • A track record of owning a P&L or a growth metric and delivering measurable top-line and bottom-line results
  • Strong analytical rigor, including the ability to check that the right metrics are used and sliced correctly so conclusions are accurate
  • Working knowledge of SQL: able to read and understand a basic query and spot or fix issues (for example, a wrong date range or metric). Writing complex queries from scratch is not required.
  • Financial modeling skills: able to read a P&L and build forecasts for category and partner performance
  • Confidence working directly with external partners, including leading commercial discussions and partner onboarding
  • Strong executive communication, with experience influencing senior internal and external stakeholders
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional programs without formal authority and to work independently with little direction
  • Comfort working at the pace of a high-growth tech environment

Preferred

  • Experience at a two-sided marketplace or high-growth tech company
  • Background in food, mobility or car rentals
  • Experience managing a category at scale, or launching and growing a new business line
  • A background in business operations, strategy and operations, category management or general management. Partnerships backgrounds are welcome if they include hands-on operations experience.
  • Interest in developing people leadership skills over time

Key Details

  • Start date: As soon as possible (early January 2027 is possible for strong candidates)
  • Duration: 12 months
  • Location: Remote (within the U.S.), with optional in-person team weeks in San Francisco roughly every one to two months
  • Work schedule: Full-time, 40 hours/week, Monday-Friday
  • Pay rate range: $75-$86/hour + benefits
  • Work Authorization: Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship.
  • Engagement: W-2 Contract role
