Job Description:

GDIT is seeking a Sr. Principal RF/Spectrum Systems Engineer to support Counter Unmanned Aircraft Systems (CUAS) engineering for the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA). In this high-impact role, you will lead the research, testing, evaluation, and spectrum analysis of cutting-edge UAS detection and mitigation technologies in active airport environments.

This position uniquely bridges hands-on RF engineering, advanced systems analysis, and national policy development—directly influencing future FAA Advisory Circulars and aviation safety standards.

Key Responsibilities

RF & Radar Engineering

  • Lead radar testing across L, S, C, X, Ku, and Ka frequency bands using FMCW, pulse Doppler, and other waveforms (including Phased Array antenna technologies).
  • Lead testing of mitigation devices operating in other frequency bands (VHF/UHF/Microwave).
  • Conduct precise RF measurements (power, gain, EIRP, spectrum occupancy) and evaluate electromagnetic compatibility (EM/EMC) for spectral compliance.
  • Perform near-field and far-field antenna range measurements in controlled or operational environments.

CUAS Research, Testing & Evaluation (RD/T&E)

  • Conduct rigorous spectrum interference testing at active airports prior to CUAS deployment.
  • Develop, execute, and oversee detailed test plans, test cards, and structured evaluation frameworks.
  • Manage vendor systems during deployment, troubleshooting, data collection, and teardown.
  • Establish selection criteria for UAS platforms used in evaluations, alongside performance metrics and pass/fail criteria.
  • Document all RD/T&E activities to contribute to FAA guidance on the selection, procurement, deployment, and management of CUAS systems as well as RF-specific measurement equipment.

Systems Engineering & Strategic Policy

  • Conduct thorough RF hazard analyses and safety assessments prior to open-air testing.
  • Translate complex RD/T&E data into performance specification frameworks using modeling, simulation, and analysis tools to shape FAA Advisory Circulars.
  • Utilize technical data tools to model and analyze spectrum environments and system capabilities.
  • Create multi-airport CUAS operational recommendations and best practices aligned with FAA Safety Risk Management (SRM) principles.

Qualifications Required:

  • Bachelor of Engineering degree in Electrical, Aerospace, Systems, Mechanical (preferred) or other technical discipline. Non-U.S. degrees must be ABET accredited.
  • 10+ years of progressive engineering experience in RF, radar, or spectrum management.
  • Proven experience using spectrum analyzers and other equipment to test, evaluate and characterize complex RF devices and environments for FCC/NTIA compliance.
  • Demonstrated success in conducting open-air RF/spectrum data collection.
  • Ability to evaluate the functional capabilities of complex technologies with minimal supervision.
  • Highly collaborative with strong technical writing and presentation skills for both technical and non-technical audiences with teams including other disciplines.
  • Ability to independently plan and deliver projects with high-quality, on-time results.
  • Proficiency with MS Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Physical ability to lift up to 25 lbs. during field deployments.
  • Ability to obtain an FAA Suitability clearance and maintain a valid U.S. passport.

Preferred:

  • Direct experience developing or executing structured test plans for aviation or defense technologies.
  • Proficiency with data analysis and visualization tools (e.g., MATLAB, Python, JMP, or advanced Excel).
  • Familiarity with FAA Safety Risk Management (SRM) principles or airport operations.
The likely salary range for this position is $147,292 - $199,278. This is not, however, a guarantee of compensation or salary. Rather, salary will be set based on experience, geographic location and possibly contractual requirements and could fall outside of this range.

GDIT typically provides new employees with 15 days of paid leave per calendar year to be used for vacations, personal business, and illness and an additional 10 paid holidays per year. Paid leave and paid holidays are prorated based on the employee’s date of hire. To ensure our employees are able to protect their income, other offerings such as short and long-term disability benefits, life, accidental death and dismemberment, personal accident, critical illness and business travel and accident insurance are provided or available. Growth & Experimentation Manager -Full Time (Remote)

Our Organization

CDP, a Boston-based public benefit corporation, uses the collaborative fundraising model to improve the operational efficiency and revenue generation capacity of the public media system. CDP currently provides more than 230 NPR and PBS stations with outsourced marketing, data analytics, fundraising, and technology services. These services help stations raise more net income, grow their donor files faster, lower their fundraising costs, and free up development talent allowing stations to better focus on local engagement. Since its inception, CDP has driven $1 billion in incremental net value back to stations and has become the most widely adopted station service in the history of public broadcasting.

Just as CDP is committed to supporting public media organizations around the country, we are equally committed to supporting each of our team in their own professional development. For more information visit

Department Overview:

The Strategic Marketing & Fundraising Services Team (SMFS) team delivers data-driven scalable fundraising programs that strengthen donor relationships and maximize long-term results for partner stations in the mail and digital fundraising spaces. Through strategic planning, creative development, cross-functional collaboration, and continuous testing and performance optimization, the team develops and executes customized direct mail and digital strategies aligned with each station’s brand, goals, and fundraising priorities.

Position Overview:

Reporting to the Director, Digital Marketing Fundraiser & Strategy, the Growth & Experimentation Manager builds, launches, and optimizes growth experiments across digital fundraising channels—including email, forms, paid media, and emerging channels. This role focuses on testing new ideas quickly, translating concepts into tangible digital experiences, and applying learnings to improve fundraising and business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Build, launch, and optimize growth experiments across digital fundraising channels, including emails, forms, ads, and other channels, with a focus on testing new ideas quickly and implementing learnings. Partner with mail and digital leadership to
  • Prioritize and execute a shared testing roadmap, balancing priorities set by leadership with experiment ideas of your own.
  • Partner with the Associate Director, Digital Fundraising Strategy, the Principal Data Solutions Engineer, and the Sr. Digital Marketing Developer to turn concepts into tangible digital experiences, tools, campaigns, and workflows in Iterable, PushPlanet, SpringBoard, Snowflake, and other platforms.
  • Lead the development and testing of new digital fundraising tools and campaigns, AI tools, platforms, integrations, and digital capabilities, including PushPlanet and subforms, SMS, paid media initiatives, and emerging tools.
  • Work cross-functionally with creative, digital (email and forms), analytics and data, and Client Success teams to bring experiments to life.
  • Analyze experiment results and translate findings into actionable recommendations, optimizations, and opportunities for future testing.
  • Identify opportunities to improve, streamline, or automate existing processes and workflows, including evaluating project management and other operational tools, and coordinate implementation of process improvements with the relevant teams.
  • Stay curious about emerging trends in digital fundraising, marketing technology, paid acquisition, conversion optimization, and AI, and assess their potential application to our work.
  • Document experiments, results, and learnings in an Asana project to create a shared knowledge base of what works—and what does not—and help establish a repeatable test → learn → iterate → scale framework for digital fundraising innovation.
  • Identify successful experiments and develop recommendations and implementation plans for scaling proven approaches across campaigns, channels, and stations. Establish repeatable processes and documentation that enable successful tests to be adopted beyond the original pilot.
  • Evaluate experiments against fundraising and business outcomes, including conversion rates, response rates, revenue, acquisition costs, donor value, and operational efficiency, where applicable.
  • Champion inclusion and a supportive culture in all aspects of work, modeling these values across the organization.

Preferred Experience & Skills:

  • 5-7 years of demonstrated experience designing, executing, measuring, and iterating on marketing or digital growth experiments.
  • Strong analytical skills, including hypothesis development, KPI definition, test design, and interpretation of results.
  • Technical aptitude and the ability to learn new platforms, integrations, and marketing technologies quickly.
  • Experience with digital fundraising, conversion rate optimization, marketing automation, landing pages, forms, or related digital marketing capabilities.
  • Familiarity with analytics and data tools, including tracking implementation, event measurement, and performance reporting.
  • Ability to translate business challenges into practical technical solutions and collaborate effectively with technical and nontechnical teams.· Strong project management skills, including prioritization, documentation, and management of multiple concurrent initiatives.
  • Curiosity, resourcefulness, and comfort working through ambiguity in a fast-moving environment.

Educational Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent work experience preferred.

Commitment to Inclusion:

We strongly encourage individuals from historically marginalized and underrepresented groups to apply, even if you don’t meet every qualification. We value diverse perspectives, lived experiences, and commitment to public service. All CDP people have unique talents and experiences that create our company culture where we can all thrive and bring our whole selves to work each day.

Successful candidates will identify easily with a set of character attributes, as listed below:

  •     Inclusive mindset:  You embrace and demonstrate an inclusion mindset and role model these behaviors for the organization.
  •     A Communicator: You possess strong communication skills and have great customer service skills; you like people and want to help.
  •     A Critical Thinker: You regularly look for ways to find efficiencies, innovate, and make improvements where you can.
  •     Process Oriented: You’re able to understand, work in, create, and improve processes.
  •   A Collaborator: You’re a team player willing to help where needed; a relationship builder whose can-do attitude inspires others; you actively share your job knowledge with team members.
  •   Someone Who Seeks to Learn: You are eager to listen, study, and learn new things quickly; you are resourceful and are open to regularly accepting and growing from feedback.
  •     Enterprising: You have proven success working in a fast-paced and changing environment; you have a strong work ethic and are excited to add value to the organization and its mission.

CDP is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, nationality, immigration status, citizenship, religion or religious creed (or belief, where acceptable), sex/gender, sexual orientation, gender identity and gender expression, pregnancy, marital status, age, citizenship, marital status, handicap or disability, genetic information or characteristics (or those of a family member), Veteran or military status,  political belief, or socio-economic status.  CDP does not discriminate against individuals on the basis of those characteristics or any other characteristic protected by law.

Overview

Insight Global Consulting is seeking a Project Manager to lead complex consulting engagements for clients across the automotive industry, including OEMs, Tier 1 and Tier 2 suppliers, mobility companies, manufacturing organizations, dealer and aftersales operations, and automotive technology partners.

This role is responsible for end-to-end delivery of strategic business, operational, and technology initiatives across an automotive portfolio. Successful candidates will lead cross-functional teams, manage executive stakeholder relationships, oversee project financials, and drive successful customer outcomes across multiple client engagements.

This is not a traditional automotive operations role. Rather, the Project Manager serves as a trusted advisor and delivery leader for programs that may include digital transformation, EV and mobility transformation, manufacturing and supply chain optimization, connected vehicle initiatives, dealer and customer experience modernization, PMO implementation, systems modernization, procurement transformation, reporting and analytics initiatives, operational excellence programs, and enterprise technology deployments. A successful candidate is a strategic project or program leader who has operated inside an automotive, mobility, manufacturing, or supplier organization and understands how those businesses function across operations, product lifecycle, technology, procurement, quality, finance, PMO, and service delivery.

Responsibilities

Program & Portfolio Delivery

  • Lead multiple concurrent client engagements ranging from $500K to multi-million-dollar programs.
  • Manage scope, schedule, budget, risks, dependencies, and stakeholder communications across project portfolios.
  • Establish governance frameworks, executive reporting cadences, and program management standards.
  • Drive program planning, resource forecasting, delivery execution, and successful project outcomes.
  • Ensure adherence to contractual commitments, KPIs, SLAs, and client success measures.

Client Leadership

  • Serve as the primary delivery contact for client executives, program sponsors, and steering committees.
  • Facilitate executive business reviews, status meetings, risk reviews, and strategic planning sessions.
  • Build trusted advisor relationships with client leadership teams.
  • Identify opportunities to improve program outcomes, operational efficiency, and business value.

Transformation & Strategic Initiatives

Lead automotive consulting engagements such as:

  • Automotive Digital Transformation Programs
  • EV, Battery, and Mobility Transformation Initiatives
  • Manufacturing Operations and Plant Modernization
  • Supply Chain, Logistics, and Procurement Transformation
  • Dealer, Aftersales, Warranty, and Customer Experience Modernization
  • Product Lifecycle, Engineering, and Launch Readiness Programs
  • ERP, CRM, PLM, MES, and Enterprise Systems Deployments
  • Data Governance, Reporting, and Business Intelligence Projects
  • AI Readiness, Automation, and Advanced Analytics Initiatives
  • Quality, Compliance, and Operational Excellence Programs
  • PMO Design, Portfolio Governance, and Change Management Programs

Risk & Financial Management

  • Manage engagement financial performance, forecasting, and profitability.
  • Monitor program risks, issues, dependencies, and mitigation strategies.
  • Drive change control governance and scope management.
  • Escalate delivery concerns and implement corrective actions when necessary.

Team Leadership

  • Lead cross-functional consulting teams including project managers, business analysts, PMO analysts, architects, engineers, technical SMEs, and client resources.
  • Coach and mentor project managers and emerging program leaders.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and client-centric delivery.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Experience

  • 10+ years of project and program management experience.
  • 5+ years managing large-scale enterprise, transformation, manufacturing, supply chain, technology, or automotive-related programs.
  • Demonstrated success delivering strategic business and technology initiatives.
  • Experience leading complex programs involving multiple stakeholders, workstreams, and vendors.
  • Consulting, professional services, or client-facing delivery experience.

Required Industry Experience

  • 8+ years of program and project management experience within automotive OEMs, suppliers, mobility companies, manufacturing organizations, dealer operations, aftersales/service organizations, or related automotive technology environments.
  • Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional business, operations, technology, product lifecycle, manufacturing, supply chain, or transformation initiatives within an automotive environment.
  • Experience partnering with manufacturing operations, engineering, product, supply chain, procurement, quality, dealer operations, service delivery, finance, IT, PMO, and executive leadership teams.
  • Experience managing programs that span multiple business functions rather than a single project discipline.
  • Strong understanding of how automotive organizations plan, fund, govern, launch, operate, and optimize programs across product development, manufacturing, supply chain, commercial operations, dealer networks, and customer lifecycle functions.

Candidates are not expected to be automotive engineers or plant operators but must understand how automotive organizations operate, make investment decisions, manage transformation, and deliver measurable business outcomes.

AI Fluency & AI-Enabled Project Delivery

A significant portion of this role may involve delivering AI-related consulting engagements for automotive clients, including RAG implementations, AI-enabled engineering workflows, knowledge management solutions, automation initiatives, predictive analytics, and integration of AI tools into product development, manufacturing, quality, service, and operational processes.

Preferred AI Fluency

  • High-level understanding of enterprise AI concepts, including generative AI, large language models, RAG, prompt design, model evaluation, AI governance, data readiness, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
  • Ability to translate business and engineering use cases into clear project scope, requirements, workstreams, milestones, risks, and success measures.
  • Familiarity with the types of data, content, and systems commonly involved in AI initiatives, including engineering documentation, requirements repositories, design standards, drawings, service records, manufacturing data, quality data, and internal knowledge bases.
  • Ability to lead conversations with technical teams, data scientists, architects, engineering SMEs, security, legal, compliance, and business stakeholders without needing to be a hands-on AI engineer.
  • Understanding of common AI implementation risks, including poor data quality, unclear ownership of source content, hallucination risk, model performance limitations, security and access control concerns, change adoption challenges, and unclear ROI measurement.

AI Project Management Expectations

  • Define and manage AI project phases such as discovery, use case prioritization, data and content assessment, solution design, prototype development, pilot execution, validation, production readiness, deployment, and adoption.
  • Ensure AI initiatives have clear business objectives, measurable outcomes, decision owners, escalation paths, acceptance criteria, and go/no-go checkpoints.
  • Coordinate cross-functional workstreams across business process design, data engineering, system integration, security review, model or tool evaluation, testing, stakeholder training, and change management.
  • Create governance for AI solution validation, including user acceptance testing, SME review, accuracy thresholds, feedback loops, issue triage, and continuous improvement after launch.
  • Partner with client stakeholders to manage expectations around what AI can and cannot do, ensuring that project plans address operational adoption, responsible use, and long-term sustainment.
  • Track AI-specific risks and dependencies separately from general project risks, particularly around data access, security approval, source system integration, content quality, model performance, stakeholder trust, and adoption readiness.

Program Management Expertise

raw.description:
À propos de Cozey

Chez Cozey, nous cherchons à libérer le potentiel de votre maison et à rendre l’achat de meubles aussi simple et agréable que possible. Nos meubles élégants et réfléchis s’adaptent à l’évolution des modes de vie, alliant innovation, excellent rapport qualité-prix et service client exceptionnel. En tant que marque en pleine croissance, principalement en ligne, notre succès repose sur une équipe qui partage notre passion pour redéfinir l’expérience des meubles.

La mission du ou de la Gestionnaire de l’expérience et de la formation en commerce de détail chez Cozey

Relevant du Vice-président de la stratégie et des opérations de commerce de détail, vous façonnerez la manière dont nos équipes en magasin apprennent, dirigent et offrent une expérience client exceptionnelle.

Alors que Cozey continue d’élargir sa présence en magasin, vous bâtirez les programmes de coaching et de formation qui développeront des leaders confiant.e.s, rehausseront les comportements de vente et donneront vie à l’expérience de notre marque dans chacun de nos magasins. Une solide base de formation sur les produits est déjà en place. Vous vous concentrerez donc sur le développement de nos leaders en tant que coachs, sur la création d’une culture d’apprentissage continu et sur la transformation de la formation en résultats concrets.

Ce poste est en télétravail et ouvert partout au Canada. Vous devez résider près de l’un de nos magasins Cozey, soit à Edmonton, Calgary, Toronto, Montréal ou Vancouver, et prévoir environ 25 à 30 % de déplacements.

Ce que vous ferez

  • Bâtir un programme de coaching évolutif qui permet aux gérant.e.s de magasin, aux gérant.e.s adjoint.e.s et aux détenteur.rice.s de clés de devenir de meilleur.e.s coachs, de donner de la rétroaction constructive et d’aborder les conversations difficiles avec assurance.
  • Donner vie à la philosophie de vente de Cozey en traduisant les attentes en matière d’expérience client en comportements quotidiens qui renforcent le lien avec les client.e.s et rehaussent l’expérience en magasin.
  • Concevoir des programmes, des outils et des ressources de développement du leadership et des ventes qui rendent l’apprentissage concret, mémorable et facile à appliquer sur le plancher de vente.
  • Collaborer avec l’équipe Produit pour faire évoluer en continu la formation sur les produits et s’assurer que chaque membre de l’équipe possède les connaissances et l’assurance nécessaires pour parler de nos collections.
  • Mesurer l’impact de l’apprentissage en suivant le taux d’achèvement des formations, la rétention des connaissances et la performance sur le plancher de vente, et utiliser ces constats pour améliorer continuellement les programmes.
  • Vous rendre dans nos magasins pour coacher les leaders et les équipes sur le terrain, renforcer les meilleures pratiques et contribuer à de meilleurs résultats en magasin.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes Opérations de détail, Marketing, Produit et Expérience client pour créer une expérience cohérente et connectée entre nos canaux numériques et nos magasins physiques.
  • Bâtir des cadres de formation et de coaching évolutifs pour soutenir l’expansion de Cozey en commerce de détail, avec la possibilité de mettre sur pied et de diriger éventuellement une équipe de formation régionale.

Nous aimerions recevoir votre candidature si vous avez

  • Au moins 5 ans d’expérience en commerce de détail, dont au moins 2 ans dans un rôle axé sur l’expérience client, la formation ou les opérations de détail.
  • De l’expérience dans le développement de leaders et dans le coaching de gestionnaires sur la façon de diriger, de motiver et de faire grandir leurs équipes.
  • Une solide compréhension de ce qui fait une excellente expérience de vente, ainsi que la capacité de traduire les normes d’expérience client en comportements quotidiens.
  • De l’aisance à animer des expériences d’apprentissage engageantes, que ce soit devant un groupe de leaders en magasin ou en coaching individuel sur un plancher de vente achalandé.
  • La capacité de mener des conversations difficiles, de donner de la rétroaction constructive et d’aider les autres à gagner confiance en leur leadership.
  • Un équilibre entre pensée stratégique et exécution concrète : vous savez bâtir un programme, rallier les gens et le mener à terme sur le plancher de vente.
  • Une approche de l’apprentissage fondée sur les données, avec la capacité d’en mesurer l’impact et de transformer les constats en actions.
  • De la curiosité envers l’IA et les outils émergents, et l’envie de les utiliser pour rendre le contenu et les ressources de formation plus efficaces.
  • La flexibilité de voyager environ 25 à 30 % du temps. Le bilinguisme anglais-français est un atout.

Avant tout, vous aimez sincèrement aider les gens à se développer. Vous savez que les excellentes expériences client commencent par d’excellent.e.s leaders, et vous êtes motivé.e par la possibilité de contribuer à bâtir les deux.

Nous prenons soin de vous

  • Un salaire concurrentiel et une gamme complète d’avantages sociaux.
  • D’innombrables occasions de croissance personnelle et professionnelle au sein d’une jeune entreprise en pleine croissance.
  • Une politique de congés payés généreuse qui vous donne le temps nécessaire pour recharger vos batteries.
  • Un rôle où vos stratégies et vos décisions influencent directement les opérations et la croissance de l’entreprise.
  • Un milieu de travail où chacun.e est accueilli.e, entendu.e et valorisé.e.

Veuillez noter que nous pouvons utiliser des outils propulsés par l’intelligence artificielle pour soutenir certaines étapes de notre processus de recrutement, notamment la revue des candidatures et la coordination des entrevues. Ces outils nous permettent de consacrer plus de temps à l’essentiel : apprendre à connaître les candidat.e.s. Toutes les décisions d’embauche sont prises par des humains, et nous nous engageons à offrir un processus juste et inclusif.

raw.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!

Fullsteam is a leading provider of vertical software and embedded payments technology dedicated to helping businesses flourish by providing their customers with seamless experiences. With a dynamic and growing team of over 1,900 employees, we are committed to driving innovation and delivering best-in-class software and payment solutions that empower small and medium-sized businesses across numerous industries. Our purpose is to help our customers grow their businesses and delight their customers. Join us and be a part of a forward-thinking company that values growth, excellence, and the success of our clients.

At Commerce7, part of the Fullsteam organization, we believe that above price and product, the number one reason why a consumer chooses a brand is customer experience. Customer experiences that are customer-centric lead to loyalty, customer happiness, and ultimately drive sales and profit. Our mission at Commerce7 is to empower wineries with the tools and insights needed to deliver exceptional customer experiences and succeed in DTC.


At Commerce7, the moments that bring wineries together, like a packed webinar, a well-run tradeshow, or a dinner that people remember, are where relationships are built. The Marketing Coordinator (Events) makes those moments happen. Working with Marketing, Sales, and RevOps, you coordinate the logistics, vendors, and operational execution that turn great events into pipeline and lasting customer connections.


Great events happen when planning is given the time it needs. You’ll work backward from each event date, build in room for strategy, planning, and approvals, and flag risks early so there’s always time to adjust. Leadership owns strategy, event selection, budget, and contracts.


Primary Responsibilities:

  • Own logistics for approved trade shows, conferences, webinars, and customer events, including registrations, travel arrangements, shipping, schedules, and onsite support.
  • Prepare booth assets, branded merchandise, presentations, and attendee communications; confirm vendor requirements and arrange approved services.
  • Track event expenses, process invoices, and flag budget discrepancies; obtain approval for changes to pricing, services, or contracts.
  • Build and run checklists, timeline and run-of-show, and flag risks early.
  • Coordinate the production and delivery of event promotional assets, including emails, digital content, and social media materials.
  • Coordinate sales collateral, promotional materials, and approved sponsorship or co-marketing activities with Sales, Customer Success, and Partnerships.
  • Support event and campaign lead capture, check contact details, and route leads for timely follow-up using established handoff processes.
  • Maintain contact records, campaign tracking, and event documentation in the CRM and marketing automation tools, following established data and consent procedures.
  • Schedule customer meetings, manage booth schedules, and gather collateral needs from Sales, Customer Success, and Partnerships.
  • Maintain calendars, timelines, checklists, and task trackers across assigned projects; coordinate meetings, agendas, status updates, and stakeholder communications.
  • Compile post-event reports for marketing leadership, including attendance, demos, spend, and other event metrics. Document lessons learned and update event playbooks.

Skills & Competencies:

  • Keeps many moving parts straight at once, such as registrations, shipping, travel, vendor deadlines, and run-of-show. Builds checklists and timelines without being asked, and raises risks early rather than at load-in.
  • Tracks spend against budget, reads a quote or invoice carefully, and flags variances. Knows to escalate any change in price, scope, or contract terms rather than approving it.
  • Comfortable representing Commerce7 at trade shows and events. Warm, professional, and views work through the lens of hospitality.
  • Writes concise briefs and status updates. Works well with Sales, RevOps, Customer Success, and external vendors, and closes the loop without being chased.
  • Works independently within established event processes and escalates decisions regarding strategy, budgets, contracts, or significant event changes to leadership.
  • Takes feedback well, runs a post-event debrief, and turns lessons into better checklists for the next event.
  • Clearly manages internal communications and planning via Slack and internal meetings as necessary.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 1–3 years of experience in event coordination, marketing, or a related field, including support for events, campaigns, or projects.
  • Degree or diploma in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience using a CRM such as HubSpot, Salesforce, or a similar platform to maintain contacts or track campaign activity.
  • Proficiency with spreadsheets, presentations, and collaboration tools in Microsoft Office or Google Workspace.
  • Ability and willingness to travel occasionally to support scheduled industry events.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, technology, hospitality, or the wine industry, including trade show, conference, or webinar support.
  • Familiarity with email marketing, marketing automation, digital and social media tools, and basic campaign performance reporting.

Location:Canada preferred; open to considering candidates based in the United States.

Salary Range: $70,000 - $80,000 USD / $70,000 - $80,000 CAD

raw.description:
*CANDIDATES MUST BE LOCATED IN THE UNITED STATES**

About SafelyYou

SafelyYou’s passionate mission is to empower safer, more person-centered care across senior living through world-leading AI, industry-changing hardware, and remote expert clinicians, significantly improving outcomes for residents while increasing peace of mind for families and reducing costs for communities.

Originating in 2015 as the doctoral research of CEO George Netscher—and inspired by his own family's experience with Alzheimer's disease—SafelyYou was spun out of UC Berkeley’s Artificial Intelligence Research Lab, one of the top five AI research groups in the world. And today, our company is solving critical challenges in senior living, from resident falls and ER visits to staffing concerns, length of stay, and NOI. All helping ensure that communities can focus on improved care for residents while still reaching their financial goals.

SafelyYou is one of five most innovative fall technologies referenced in the Senate Falls Report (2019), a winner of the McKnight’s Tech Partner of the Year, and has been named to Fortune’s Impact 20 list, which recognizes companies making people’s lives better through innovation.

Your Role at SafelyYou
The Install Coordinator serves as the operational backbone of the installation process, ensuring seamless execution of SafelyYou’s in-room sensor deployments while Implementation Managers focus on customer-facing responsibilities. This role acts as a bridge between the Implementation Managers, Implementation Agents, and field technicians providing real-time support, resolving install blockers, and maintaining installation accuracy, timeliness, and quality.

At SafelyYou, the work you do truly matters. Our mission to protect and empower older adults is at the heart of everything we build and deliver. You’ll be part of a team that believes technology can make care more human; creating safer, calmer, and more connected communities for residents, caregivers, and families alike.

You will play a key part in ensuring that every SafelyYou deployment meets our high standards of excellence, supporting both new installations and ongoing expansions across the customer base.

Key Responsibilities:

Installation Support & Coordination

  • Manage day-to-day install operations for all active installations, including tracking progress, coordinating schedules, and resolving blockers.

  • Handle installation escalations flagged by Implementation Agents such as late or damaged shipments, unique room layouts requiring special mounting consideration, alternate cable routing, inaccessible power outlets, or inaccessible mounting locations.

  • Conduct virtual walkthroughs with community maintenance teams or field technicians to confirm sensor placement and validate completed installations.

  • Perform quality checks for sensor view and IR settings upon completion of each installation to ensure full system functionality.

  • Coordinate with field technicians to complete post-sale Wi-Fi assessments of customer buildings, ensuring network readiness for installation and identifying any connectivity concerns in advance.

  • Coordinate with vendors and shipping teams to ensure timely and accurate delivery of all equipment.

  • Submit work orders for installations to vendor partners, monitor progress through completion, and verify adherence to SafelyYou’s documentation requirements and installation standards. Provide proactive communication and support to ensure timely resolution of any field issues or delays.

  • Occasional travel required; up to 25%

Cross-Functional Liaison

  • Collaborate with Implementation Agents and field technicians to manage install progress and resolve issues while Implementation Managers are customer-facing, maintaining clear communication, alignment on priorities, and shared task ownership.

  • Provide IA team with clear escalation paths and documentation standards to ensure accurate issue tracking in Salesforce or other systems.

  • Communicate install updates, delays, and resolutions to the Implementation Manager and other stakeholders in real time.

  • Collaborate with Solutions team to ensure building readiness prior to installation.

  • Escalate to Support as needed for troubleshooting during installation.

System & Data Management

  • Verify post-install sensor connectivity and accuracy; document outcomes and flag discrepancies.

  • Add and maintain all installation documentation in customer folders to ensure accuracy, consistency, and easy access for internal stakeholders.

  • Oversee data entry and workflow management in Salesforce, ensuring install milestones and statuses are up to date.

  • Partner with Procurement to monitor equipment inventory and proactively identify low-stock or delayed shipments.

Process Improvement

  • Identify recurring install pain points and propose improvements to process, tooling, or field workflows.

  • Partner with leadership to refine the install playbook, standardize documentation templates, and support onboarding of new Implementation Agents or field technicians.

The Ideal Candidate:

  • 2–4 years of experience in project coordination, field operations, or technical implementation, ideally in a SaaS, healthcare environment paired with physical hardware deployment experience.

  • Experience with structured cabling or RF technology a bonus.

  • Excellent communication and problem-solving skills, especially under time constraints.
    Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and coordinate across global or distributed teams.

  • Proficiency with Salesforce records and cases, G-Suite, Slack, Microsoft Teams, and Confluence.

  • Technical aptitude and familiarity with hardware deployment in building environments, including basic construction knowledge and the ability to read floor plans, identify structural materials, and anticipate how they may impact installation or cable routing.

  • Detail-oriented, organized, and proactive about anticipating install challenges before they escalate.

Success in This Role Looks Like

  • 95%+ of install escalations resolved within 24 hours of flagging.

  • Reduction in Implementation Manager time spent on day-of-install troubleshooting.

  • Improved communication and install SLA adherence among field technicians and vendor partners.

  • Seamless handoff between Implementation Agents and Implementation Managers for each install phase.

Salary Range:$85,000 - $95,000

Why Join Us? You Can Make a Difference!

SafelyYou offers a competitive compensation package, including but not limited to:

  • A mission-driven company culture

  • Fully remote

  • Competitive salary & benefits, including fully paid employee premiums for Medical, Dental, and Vision

  • 401k Program

  • Monthly Education, Well-being & WFH stipends

  • Non-accrual PTO

  • Growth Potential

  • Company Retreats

  • Medical & Family/Parental Leave

At SafelyYou, we believe that a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace makes us a more relevant, competitive, and resilient company. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workforce that celebrates diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ancestry, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or family status, disability, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

We value all the perspectives our team members bring to the table, and that is why we don’t look for culture fit, but culture add. We want to hear from YOU! We encourage you to apply even if you do not fit 100% of the technical requirements.

raw.excerpt: Join ICOMAT – Revolutionising the Future of Lightweight Manufacturing!
raw.description:
Join ICOMAT – Revolutionising the Future of Lightweight Manufacturing!

iCOMAT is an advanced manufacturing company that invented Rapid Tow Shearing (RTS) - the only proven technology for producing defect-free curved-fiber composite parts at industrial scale. We deliver the lightest structures possible for aerospace, automotive, defense, and space, at a rate and cost efficiency that far exceeds existing composite production processes.

We build and operate automated factories for composite materials, delivering components to Tier 1 suppliers and OEMs. The business has three main divisions: development of automated production machines, development of software design and production tools, and operation of the factory. We work with 25+ customers and completed the largest ever Series A in composites manufacturing to fuel a significant scale-up, with growth plans that will see the business multiply in size over the next two to three years and expand operations into the UK, Europe and the US.

The business has currently more than 130,000 sqm of production capacity with manufacturing facilities in the UK (Gloucester and Swindon) and the US (Dayton, Ohio); a Hardware R&D Centre in Bristol, UK; and a Software R&D Centre in Athens, Greece.

We are hiring Senior Software Engineers to join our in-house Software Engineering team and build iCOMAT’s manufacturing and business operations system. This platform is iCOMAT’s central hub for executing R&D and manufacturing activities, connecting ERP, production scheduling, machine telemetry, shop-floor execution and business operations across our manufacturing sites.

What will you be doing?

From day one, you will be building and shipping systems that are used daily by planners, manufacturing engineers, and R&D teams to run real factories.

The software platform is built on a modern web-stack and runs entirely using on-prem infrastructure, with cloud adoption ramping up in 2027. All aspects of iCOMAT’s business and manufacturing activities are within scope, from ERP and SaaS integrations to real-time telemetry streams from the machines on our production floor. The goal is to provide a real-time view of our factories that enables autonomous decision making to deliver high quality, repeatable composite manufacturing at scale.

Depending on your strengths, your focus will sit across one or more of the platform's three pillars:

  1. Web application development. Building production-grade, full-stack features in Nuxt, TypeScript and Postgres, including asynchronous and event-driven workloads (queues, Pub/Sub) and real-time interfaces over websockets.

  2. Data orchestration. Designing and operating data pipelines and warehousing (BigQuery or similar) with orchestration frameworks such as Dagster, Airflow or Prefect, in Python.

  3. Agent Development and Orchestration. Deploying autonomous agents that integrate with ICOMAT’s business systems and operating context to power AI-enabled decision making across the business.

As well as writing software code, you will be expected to contribute across much of the software development lifecycle, from co-designing requirements with end users on the factory floor, to validating MVPs, and executing the build, test and release of production-standard software.

What does success look like?

As a manufacturing business, our success is defined by the quality of the parts we produce, the repeatability of our manufacturing processes, and the reliability of the operations behind them.

iCOMAT’s business and manufacturing platform builds on this by giving our teams a single, trusted view of the factory — replacing fragile spreadsheets and disconnected tools with software that makes scheduling, execution, and reporting faster, clearer, and dependable.

From a personal perspective, we value engineers who can turn ambiguous operational problems into robust software systems, communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders, and deliver production-quality tools that are trusted by the business.

iCOMAT is setting the standard for how advanced composite structures are designed, manufactured, and industrialised at scale. Your contributions will build the operational backbone for world-leading technology that will be embedded in the next generation of aerospace and defence hardware.

How do you fit in?

You will be joining iCOMAT's in-house software engineering team, reporting directly to the Head of AI and working alongside other Senior Software Engineers. This is a small, senior team developing the software foundations for iCOMAT's design, manufacturing, and operations capability.

The current team brings experience across manufacturing and engineering, machine learning and production-grade software delivery. We work closely with iCOMAT's planning, manufacturing engineering, and production teams to understand the problems that matter most, then turn those problems into reliable internal products.

This role would suit someone who enjoys contributing to a team where the boundaries between product thinking, engineering judgement, and software delivery are deliberately close.

For this role, your contribution will be to deepen the team's capability across full-stack web development, data engineering, and cloud/platform operations — and to help set the engineering standards for a platform that the whole business will come to depend on. You will bring practical software engineering discipline, curiosity about manufacturing operations, and the confidence to collaborate with domain experts to build software that is robust, maintainable, and genuinely useful.

Who you are?

Innovative. You are comfortable developing novel solutions for truly complex problems.

Independent.You don't shy away from open-ended problems and enjoy helping shape end-to-end solutions. You are comfortable working as an individual contributor as part of a multi-functional team.

Product-minded. Software is more than just code. You embrace the opportunity to contribute across the end-to-end software development lifecycle and care about delivering a solution that creates real, measurable value for the business.

Operations-led. You enjoy working close to the realities of a live production environment — scheduling constraints, machine data, shop-floor workflows — and you are motivated by building software that helps a factory run better every day.

What should you expect?

iCOMAT is on a mission to revolutionise the way engineers design and manufacture with composite materials. We have a build-first methodology and take pride in developing in-house capabilities that cater for our specific needs. Our technology is world-leading, and our software must be capable of supporting demanding operational workflows from the planning office through to the production floor.

You should expect to work on problems where software, data, manufacturing, and product thinking meet. This role will suit someone who enjoys writing high-quality code but also wants to understand how that code changes the way a real factory operates.

iCOMAT is fast paced. The atmosphere is demanding but rewarding. We are operating at the cutting edge of composite manufacturing technology, and we are looking for people who want to help build the operational software foundations that allow that technology to scale.

Our Stack

  • Full Stack Framework: Nuxt

  • Application Database: Postgres

  • Data Orchestration: Currently evaluating Dagster, Prefect and Airflow

  • AI Tooling: Claude Code

  • Version Control & CI/CD: Self-Hosted GitLab

  • Languages: Typescript, Python (bonus points for Go, C++, C#, Julia)

  • Application Hosting: On-prem, docker-based deployments

  • Cloud: GCP & Azure (GCP preferred for new workflows)

Skills and Experience

Essential

  • 5+ years of demonstrable industry experience building and operating production software systems used by real end users

  • 5+ years hands-on software development experience in TypeScript and/or Python. We also value experience in Go, C# and C++.

  • Deep, hands-on expertise in at least two of the platform's three pillars: full-stack web development (Nuxt/Vue or comparable modern framework, Postgres, async/event-driven patterns, websockets); data orchestration (data warehousing such as BigQuery, plus Dagster, Airflow or Prefect); cloud computing (AWS, Azure or GCP; GCP preferred)

  • Solid working knowledge of relational databases, including schema design, migrations, and query performance (Postgres preferred)

  • Familiarity with modern software development practices, such as test-driven development, automated testing, code review, CI/CD, and containerisation

  • Strong first-degree or Masters/PhD in computer science or a STEM-related subject

  • Eligible to work with UK export-controlled material and willing to undergo security screening if required

Desirable

  • Previous start-up or scale-up experience is highly advantageous – we move very fast

  • Experience working in aerospace & defence, manufacturing or logistics

  • Experience developing software for highly regulated and/or export-controlled environments

  • Experience developing software to comply with common information management and cyber security certifications (e.g. ISO 27001, SOC 2, etc.)

  • Experience integrating with ERP, MES, or other manufacturing/business systems

  • Experience with industrial data protocols and telemetry (e.g. MQTT, OPC-UA) or other high-volume event streams

  • Working knowledge of C# / .NET – some engineering systems run this stack

  • Experience deploying and operating software in self-hosted / on-prem environments

  • Experience developing accessible and intuitive user experiences across a variety of design tools and front-end frameworks

  • Experience developing agentic tools for use by end-users

  • Comfortable using AI coding tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar developer assistants

  • Experience applying machine learning in production environments (e.g. AI Engineer, MLOps, Data Science)

Our Values: Uncompromising Excellence

  • Discipline over excuses. We commit. We follow through. We hold ourselves and each other to the highest standard, especially when the pressure is on.

  • Push the edge. iCOMAT was built on a refusal to accept that curved fiber could not be manufactured at scale. We innovate where others hesitate.

  • Aligned and accountable. Everyone owns their lane, communicates openly, and delivers without being chased. No silos. No ambiguity.

Why iCOMAT?

  • Competitive Salary & Benefits: We offer a comprehensive benefits package, including private healthcare, pension scheme.

  • Stock Options: Equity options to give employees a stake in the company’s success

  • Career Growth Opportunities: Join us at a pivotal time as we scale up, offering unmatched professional growth opportunities in the rapidly advancing field of composite materials.

  • Innovation-Focused Culture: We pride ourselves on our inclusive, forward-thinking work environment. Recognized by Bloomberg as a "UK Startup to Watch," iCOMAT celebrates diversity and encourages all applicants, regardless of background, to apply.

  • Global Impact: Be a part of our mission to redefine lightweight structures for the automotive, aerospace, and space industries, working with some of the most influential companies worldwide.Ready to be part of something big?

Apply now to learn more and join us on our exciting journey!

raw.description:
This role is eligible for full-time remote employment within the US or can be hybrid in our Durham, NC office 2-3 days/week. Please note that we unfortunately cannot sponsor H1B visas at this time. Arpio participates in the US Government's eVerify Program.

Who We Are

Arpio is building the next generation of disaster recovery (DR) for the cloud.

Modern enterprises face a growing list of threats to their cloud applications. With the increasing complexity of cloud-native environments, we know resilience to these threats is about more than just data. That's why, at Arpio, we have built a best in class SaaS offering that makes it easier than ever to protect your entire cloud infrastructure across AWS and Azure from catastrophic downtime.

About the Role

Most companies don't think seriously about disaster recovery…until they have to. Ransomware hits. A cloud region goes dark. An audit looms. That's where we come in. As an Arpio SDR, you'll own the top of the funnel for a platform that protects businesses from catastrophic data loss across both AWS and Azure environments. You'll prospect into IT and security teams, surface the gaps in their current backup posture, and book meetings that turn into real pipeline. This is a role with real ownership and real influence on how we grow. Your work directly funds our next stage of growth.

What You'll Do

Generate Pipeline

  • Run high-volume, high-quality outbound via cold call, email, and LinkedIn, targeting IT Directors, CISOs, and infrastructure owners across AWS and Azure environments
  • Build and execute personalized multi-touch sequences tailored to DR-specific pain (Disaster Recovery): ransomware exposure, compliance deadlines, migration risk, and multi-cloud complexity
  • Qualify inbound leads quickly and accurately, routing the right opportunities to AEs with full context
  • Follow up on events, webinars, and content downloads to convert intent into booked meetings
  • Expectations: Maintain high daily call volume (150+ dials/day) and optimal call time to consistently achieve a target of 6 Sales Qualified Leads (SQLs) per month

Run Sharp Discovery

  • Ask the questions that uncover real urgency like current RTO/RPO targets, last DR test date, compliance obligations, recent incidents, and which cloud platform(s) house their critical workloads
  • Map stakeholders across IT, security, and finance since DR decisions rarely live with a single person
  • Pass qualified meetings to AEs with documented pain points, stakeholder context, and relevant use case, not just a calendar invite; take end-to-end relationship ownership with Account Executives by attending booked meetings and driving joint success

Build the Foundation

  • Log all activity accurately in the CRM (HubSpot), maintain clean pipeline hygiene, and produce weekly reports detailing top-of-the-funnel additions and outbound activity campaigns to drive self-accountability
  • Test messaging, track what resonates, and feed insights back to marketing and leadership
  • Share what's working with messaging, objections, competitive intel, because the whole team moves faster when knowledge isn't siloed
  • Help build the outbound playbook from the ground up — including messaging that speaks credibly to Azure buyers as well as AWS buyers

Must-Haves

Experience & Background

  • Minimum 1.5 years of SDR/BDR, inside sales, or quota-carrying outbound experience in a SaaS B2B environment
  • Prior experience prospecting into or selling to technical buyers in cloud infrastructure, security, or IT operations
  • Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure (e.g., compute, storage, networking) sufficient to speak credibly with IT and security buyers about cloud resilience; AWS or Azure familiarity is a strong plus

Skills & Competencies

  • Proven comfort with outbound prospecting including phone, email, LinkedIn, and multichannel sequences
  • Outstanding verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills with the ability to educate and persuade diverse audiences
  • Proficiency with sales tools: HubSpot, Nooks, SmartLead, Walaxy (for LinkedIn automation)
  • Strong grit and analytical skills to evaluate outreach metrics, understand performance drivers, and optimize prospecting actions independently

How You Work

At Arpio, we care about the outcome as much as the effort it took to get there. We take initiative, follow through, and report back on what we learned along the way. That same instinct shows up in how we treat customers and each other: we respond quickly, speak honestly and openly, and trust our teammates to take direct feedback as a chance to grow. We move like a startup because we are one, spending wisely and treating every dollar and every customer like they matter, because they do. If that's how you like to work, you'll fit in well here. In this role it’s especially important that you:

  • Demonstrate grit and determination, with a willingness to embrace and navigate challenging situations with a strong drive to win and exceed goals
  • Are coachable, accountable, receptive to direct feedback, organized, and disciplined
  • Are comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment with high personal standards, urgency, and strong work ethic

Salary & Benefits

  • Competitive salary + Equity: Base Salary plus Commission for each Sales Qualified Lead (SQL), Lead Kicker: A 25% kicker added on top of the SQL rate for any leads generated beyond 6, Monthly Champion Bonus, and Quarterly Champion Bonus if an SDR leads all three months of a quarter
  • Arpio will cover 100% of your personal medical premiums, 100% of your life insurance premium, and 75% of your personal premiums for vision and dental (because the insurance companies won't let us pay 100%). For your dependents, Arpio will cover 75% of medical, dental, and vision premiums. No life insurance is included.
  • For fully remote employees, a $125 home office stipend or $250 company-subsidized co-working membership
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Small, collaborative team environment
  • Opportunity to work on the cutting edge of cloud technology

Arpio is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse team and an inclusive workplace, and we welcome applicants of all backgrounds. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We provide reasonable accommodations to applicants and employees with disabilities; if you need an accommodation during the application or interview process, let us know.

raw.description:
Position Summary

The Business Continuity Manager is a key role responsible for overseeing the development and implementation of business continuity plans to ensure the company’s operations can withstand and recover from unexpected disruptions.

What will your job entail?

Job Responsibilities:

  • Assess the potential impact of disruptions on critical business processes, identifying dependencies, recovery time objectives (RTOs), and resource requirements.
  • Identify and evaluate risks that could affect business operations, including natural disasters, cyber threats, supply chain disruptions, and other emergencies. Develop strategies to mitigate these risks.
  • Create and maintain comprehensive emergency response plans that outline procedures for handling crises, evacuations, communication, and resource allocation during disruptions.
  • Develop and update business continuity plans (BCPs) that address various scenarios, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and compliance requirements.
  • Coordinate regular testing and exercises to validate BCP effectiveness. Conduct tabletop simulations, functional exercises, and full-scale drills to assess readiness.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams, including IT, facilities, legal, and senior management, to ensure alignment and buy-in for business continuity efforts.
  • Provide training sessions to employees on BCPs, emergency procedures, and their roles during disruptions. Foster a culture of preparedness and awareness.
  • Regularly review and enhance business continuity strategies based on lessons learned, industry best practices, and changes in the business environment.

    Work Experience and Education:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Risk Management or Business with 6+ years of experience
  • 3+ years of supervisor or lead experience.
  • Insurance industry experience preferred

Licenses & Certifications:

Certified Business Continuity Professional (CBCP) or ISO 22301 Lead Implementer or Project Management Professional (PMP) is preferred

Technical/Functional Skills:

  • Risk assessment and risk management: Identifies, analyzes, and prioritizes operational, technology, third-party, and environmental risks, and develops practical risk mitigation strategies aligned with enterprise risk management frameworks.
  • Business impact analysis (BIA): Conducts BIAs to determine critical processes, dependencies, recovery time objectives (RTOs), recovery point objectives (RPOs), maximum tolerable downtime, and financial and operational impacts of disruption.
  • Business continuity and resilience planning: Develops and maintains business continuity plans, crisis management and emergency response plans, and recovery strategies in line with ISO 22301, DRI International, or Business Continuity Institute (BCI) standards and practices.
  • Strategic planning: Builds multi-year business continuity program roadmaps, defines program metrics, and aligns continuity priorities with business strategy and operational resilience goals.
  • IT disaster recovery and technology resilience: Partners with IT and information security to align application recovery priorities, system dependencies, and disaster recovery capabilities with business recovery requirements.
  • Third-party and vendor continuity: Evaluates the resilience of critical vendors, service providers, and delegated authority partners, including review of vendor continuity plans and recovery capabilities.
  • Business continuity software administration: Administers and configures business continuity planning platforms to manage plans, BIAs, contact data, assessments, and reporting.
  • Mass notification and threat intelligence administration: Manages emergency notification systems, including contact data quality, message templates, and delivery testing, and monitors threat intelligence sources to provide timely alerts on severe weather, safety, and other events affecting employees and operations.
  • Exercise design and facilitation: Designs, facilitates, and documents tabletop, functional, and full-scale exercises, and tracks resulting corrective actions through to completion.
  • Data analysis and reporting: Analyzes plan, exercise, and incident data to draw clear conclusions, and produces dashboards and metrics that inform decisions by leadership.
  • Presentation development and delivery: Develops and delivers clear, concise presentations and training materials to audiences ranging from front-line employees to senior executives.

Functional Requirements:

  • Own the enterprise business continuity program lifecycle, including governance, policy and standards, annual plan review and approval cycles, and program maintenance across all business units.
  • Lead and maintain the BIA process for all business units, and ensure results drive recovery strategies, resource requirements, and plan content.
  • Maintain business continuity, crisis management, and emergency response plans, and verify that plan owners review and update them at least annually and after significant organizational or operational change.
  • Plan and execute an annual schedule of exercises and tests, and document results, gaps, and corrective actions with assigned owners and due dates.
  • Coordinate the organization’s response during incidents and disruptions, including activating plans, convening the crisis management team, and supporting internal and external communications.
  • Conduct post-incident and post-exercise reviews, and incorporate lessons learned into plans, training, and program improvements.
  • Ensure the program meets applicable insurance regulatory, contractual, and audit requirements, such as state department of insurance expectations, NAIC guidance, and client or carrier due diligence requests.
  • Support client, carrier, regulator, and auditor inquiries by providing business continuity attestations, evidence, and documentation.
  • Report on program status, risks, exercise results, and key metrics to senior leadership, executive committees, and the board as required.
  • Manage the business continuity planning and mass notification platforms, including user access, data accuracy, and regular testing.
  • Develop and deliver business continuity awareness and training programs for employees, plan owners, and crisis management team members.
  • Supervise or lead business continuity staff, contractors, and a network of plan owners and coordinators, setting priorities and providing direction and coaching.

Behavioral Skills:

  • Effective communication: Communicates clearly and calmly in writing and verbally, tailoring messages for executives, technical teams, and employees, especially during high-pressure incidents.
  • Interpersonal skills and influence: Builds trusted relationships and gains buy-in across departments, business units, and levels of leadership without relying on direct authority.
  • Attention to detail: Maintains accurate, complete, and audit-ready plans, records, and contact data.
  • Decision making: Makes timely, well-informed decisions with incomplete information and balances risk, cost, and operational impact.
  • Problem-solving: Applies structured, analytical thinking to resolve complex issues and develop practical solutions.
  • Leadership and accountability: Leads by example, follows through on commitments, and holds teams and plan owners accountable for deliverables.
  • Continuous learning: Stays current on emerging threats, regulatory changes, and industry best practices, and applies new knowledge to improve the program.
  • Emotional intelligence: Remains composed under pressure, shows empathy toward affected employees, and adapts communication style to different audiences and situations

Associate Director / Director, MS&T – Solid Biosciences

Charlestown, MA (Remote)

Solid Biosciences is a precision genetic medicine company focused on advancing a portfolio of gene therapy candidates targeting rare neuromuscular and cardiac diseases, including Duchenne muscular dystrophy (Duchenne), Friedreich’s ataxia (FA), catecholaminergic polymorphic ventricular tachycardia (CPVT), TNNT2-mediated dilated cardiomyopathy, BAG3-mediated dilated cardiomyopathy, and additional fatal, genetic cardiac diseases. Patient-focused and founded by those directly impacted by Duchenne, Solid’s mission is to improve the daily lives of patients living with devastating rare diseases.

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Associate Director to be responsible for providing direct and detailed GMP manufacturing oversight for the company’s gene therapy products at external manufacturing partners. The ideal candidate will be able to apply strong depth of applied manufacturing sciences and technical project management to deliver all manufacturing preparations to meet quality requirements, while coordinating across internal and external stakeholders including Process and Analytical Development, Quality, Regulatory, and CDMO functions.

This role will report to the Senior Director, MS&T and will be remote, requiring up to 25% travel at times.

  • Drive GMP Compliance and evaluate all aspects of ongoing production and understand when to intervene on company’s behalf and when to escalate more significant issues for resolution.
  • Work in close collaboration with the CDMO and internal teams to support manufacturing investigations and change controls. Provide assessments of product and process impact and contribute to the identification of root cause and determination and development of appropriate action plans.
  • Review and/or approve CDMO manufacturing documentation including manufacturing bill of materials, production master batch records, and executed production record review.
  • Communicate routine production manufacturing status to company stakeholders and assist as necessary with process data retrieval, processing, analysis, through written, verbal, and presentation at various company meeting forums.
  • Author key technical documentation supporting manufacturing activities including technical risk assessments, manufacturing protocols, campaign reports, and descriptions of manufacturing process and controls.
  • Author supporting documentation for relevant CMC manufacturing content of various regulatory submissions as needed.

Requirements

  • BS in science, engineering or equivalent with 10+ years of experience working in a related pharmaceutical environment.
    • OR advanced degree (MS/PhD) with 8+ years of experience.
  • Demonstrated experience managing projects in the pharmaceutical industry.
  • Knowledge and experience working in accordance with cGMP, GDP, GCP, and ICH guidelines.
  • Experience engaging with external suppliers and partners, including CDMOs.

  • Strong interpersonal flexibility with ability to adapt to other personalities in a respectful manner that is conducive to the achievement of personal and team goals.
  • Excellent communication skills, both oral and written, which may include planning and execution of meetings and presentations.
  • Ability to multitask and handle multiple competing priorities and projects at once in a changing and fast-paced environment.
  • Strong analytical skills, strong oral and written communications skills, and the ability to work in new/unstructured environments.

Compensation

The base compensation range for this role is: $180,000.00 - $240,000.00

Base salary offered is determined through an internal analysis utilizing a combination of factors including, but not limited to, relevant skills & experience, job location, and internal equity.

Regular employees are eligible to receive both short-term and long-term incentives, including cash bonus and equity incentive opportunities, designed to reward individual performance and align incentives to Solid’s long term company performance.

Job Overview:

The Hosting Architect will lead Fortrea’s enterprise transition from on premises datacenters to Hyperscaler, delivering a modern, resilient, and automated hosting platform that accelerates application delivery and business innovation. This role owns the target state Azure and hybrid hosting architecture, governs large scale cloud migration, and modernizes operations through automation, Infrastructure as Code, and AI driven operations. The objective is to increase speed to market, reduce operational friction, improve resiliency, and lower total cost of ownership. This is a hands-on senior architecture role with accountability for measurable business and operational outcomes, operating in a regulated enterprise environment.

Summary of Responsibilities:

Cloud Migration & Hybrid Architecture

  • Define and own Fortrea’s target‑state Cloud hosting architecture aligned to business and technology strategy.
  • Design and govern hybrid architectures during phased migration from on‑premises to Cloud.
  • Lead workload migration strategies (rehost, re‑platform, refactor, retire) to balance speed, risk, and value.
  • Act as the architectural authority for hosting and Cloud migration decisions.

Cloud Platform & Cloud‑Native Enablement

  • Architect Cloud platforms including landing zones, identity, networking, security, HA, and DR.
  • Establish standardised Cloud reference architectures and blueprints to accelerate application onboarding.
  • Enable self‑service, repeatable platforms that reduce delivery lead time for application and product teams.
  • Drive adoption of cloud‑native services to simplify operations and improve scalability and cost efficiency.

Automation, IaC & AI‑Led Operations

  • Implement an automation‑first operating model across hybrid and Cloud environments.
  • Build and govern Infrastructure‑as‑Code using Terraform, ARM/Bicep, PowerShell, Python, or Ansible.
  • Introduce AIOps and intelligent automation for predictive monitoring, self‑healing, and faster incident resolution.
  • Reduce environment provisioning time, manual effort, and operational cost through standardisation and automation.

Operational Excellence, Resilience & Governance

  • Embed resiliency, observability, and reliability engineering into all hosting designs.
  • Improve platform availability, reduce incidents, and optimise recovery objectives (RTO/RPO).
  • Ensure hosting platforms meet security, audit, and regulatory requirements.
  • Provide architectural leadership across infrastructure, application, security, and compliance teams.

Value & Outcomes

The Hosting Architect is accountable for delivering:

  • Faster and safer Cloud migration at enterprise scale.
  • Reduced time‑to‑provision and change lead times for applications.
  • Improved platform reliability, availability, and recovery performance.
  • Measurable reduction in hosting OPEX through automation and cloud optimisation.
  • Hosting platforms that accelerate business capability delivery, not constrain it.

Qualifications (Minimum Required):

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
  • Excellent communication and public speaking skills, with the ability to present complex architectural concepts to senior leadership, technical teams, and non‑technical stakeholders.

Required skills (Minimum Required):

Core Experience

  • 10+ years in hosting, infrastructure, or cloud architecture roles.
  • Proven leadership of large‑scale Cloud migration programs.
  • Strong foundation in enterprise datacentre technologies and hybrid architectures.

Cloud & Cloud Expertise

  • Deep hands‑on experience with Cloud compute, networking, storage, identity, and security.
  • Experience designing hybrid connectivity and phased migration strategies.
  • Cloud architecture and/or security certifications preferred.

Automation & AI

  • Strong experience with Infrastructure‑as‑Code and scripting.
  • Exposure to AIOps or intelligent automation platforms.
  • Demonstrated success in reducing operational effort and cost through automation.

Professional Skills

  • Strong communication and stakeholder‑influencing skills.
  • Comfortable operating in complex, regulated enterprise environments.
  • Outcome‑driven mindset with a focus on business value and execution speed.

Preferred Qualifications Include:

  • Fortrea may consider relevant and equivalent professional experience in lieu of formal educational requirements.

Emerald Zebra, on behalf of our client, a global regulated trading and fintech group, is looking to hire a Group Product Manager to lead its Engagement tribe, covering Trading and Loyalty. The role can be remote, or hybrid from one of the group's offices in Cyprus, the UAE or the UK.

The Role

Our client is taking its own trading platform to mass market. You'll lead the Engagement tribe and report to the VP of Product, with two to three domain Product Managers reporting to you. You'll own the tribe's strategy, its key results and the development of its Product Managers.

Today the tribe objective has no single owner, and trading and loyalty are planned separately even though clients experience them as one thing. You'll change that: set the direction, bring the work together around shared goals and build a team that decides without escalating.

What You'll Do

  • Take the platform to market: decide what ships first, who gets it, what ready means and how existing traders move over without losing their habits or trust.
  • Own the tribe's key results outright. When a number is flat, surface it early and change something.
  • Run loyalty as a retention system, not a rewards catalogue. Work out which tiers, points, missions, challenges and referrals actually change behaviour, and drop the rest.
  • Develop the Product Managers so they get materially better within a year at framing problems, using evidence, talking to clients and making decisions.
  • Set a three-year direction for how a funded client becomes a habitual, confident trader, with quarterly bets that organise the work.
  • Run the portfolio across trading and loyalty: sequence, trade off and stop what isn't working.
  • Build a culture of experimentation and rapid release, balanced with a few protected long-term bets.
  • Bring dealing, risk, compliance, commercial and marketing in early enough to shape decisions.

Qualifications and Experience

  • A B2C trading background. Candidates with a B2B product background will not be considered.
  • Has taken a product from zero to launch and on to real adoption, ideally in a business with existing clients and revenue to protect.
  • Has owned an engagement, retention or monetisation outcome with a number attached, on a CFD or multi-asset trading platform.
  • Real depth in the trading experience: order entry, risk controls, charting, signals, and how trader behaviour differs between a third-party terminal and a proprietary platform.
  • Has run retention mechanics and developed junior Product Managers.
  • Has raised a team's release and experiment cadence from a low base.
  • Commercial fluency in how engagement converts to value: ARPU, retention and what incentives cost.
  • Can move compliance, risk and commercial teams without formal authority, and write a strategy from a blank page.
  • Loyalty and rewards mechanics at scale, progression or gamification systems, or building experimentation infrastructure, are an asset.

The Type of Person We're Looking For

  • A strategic thinker who adds features that generate revenue.
  • Hands-on, with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Talks to clients directly, from beginners through to high-value traders.
  • A problem solver who can take the product to the next level.

Package and Benefits

  • Salary: EUR 6,000 to 8,000 gross per month
  • Annual performance bonus
  • Monthly cash flex benefit (taxable)
  • Hybrid working for office-based hires: 3 days in the office and 2 days from home
  • 30 days per year remote working policy
  • 40 days annual leave including public holidays
  • Private medical insurance, 100% covered for the employee and 50% for dependents
  • Work permit support and costs covered for candidates based in Cyprus who need one
