raw.description:
Arise is a globally active weight-loss app with over 10 million downloads and a 4.6 rating on the App Store. Our mission is simple but ambitious: empower millions of people to become healthier and happier.

We're looking for a CTO who is a true architect on both iOS and Android — someone deeply skilled in iOS who can take full ownership of our existing app and raise it further, and who can also build our Android app from scratch. You'll develop primarily through AI rather than by hand, and you'll thrive on ownership, precision, and long-term thinking. This role is for someone who ships high-quality code today while foreseeing how today's decisions shape the app for years ahead — technically, strategically, and financially.

Today Arise is iOS-only, so this is where you'll start and where you'll prove yourself: owning, deepening, and future-proofing a mature codebase used by millions. From there, you'll architect and build our Android app from the ground up.

If you excel at structured, autonomous work, build with AI as your default way of working, understand the importance of monetization, and want to own the technology behind a product used by millions, we'd love to hear from you.

Your Role

  • Own and architect the existing iOS app — maintain, optimize, deepen, and future-proof a codebase used by millions.
  • Build the Arise Android app from scratch — architecture, delivery, and long-term ownership.
  • Ensure cross-platform consistency and a coherent technical vision across both platforms.
  • Develop and test features that enhance the Arise experience.
  • Use AI agents and automated workflows as your primary means of building, testing, and shipping — not as an occasional helper.
  • Anticipate technical pitfalls and proactively design solutions.
  • Collaborate with design to refine usability for a smooth user experience.
  • Support monetization by integrating features with measurable business impact.

Requirements

  • Proven track record architecting and shipping production mobile apps, ideally as a senior engineer, lead, or technical founder.
  • Deep, architect-level iOS expertise — you can own a mature codebase end to end and make the hard structural calls with confidence.
  • Demonstrated ability to build an Android app from scratch to the same standard.
  • Hands-on fluency building through AI — agentic coding tools, LLM-driven workflows, automated testing and release. You've actually shipped this way, not just experimented.
  • Excellent problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
  • Comfortable working fully in English.

Technical Skills

  • Expert-level iOS/Swift — architecture, patterns, performance, and the judgment to keep a large app maintainable as it grows.
  • Strong Android development (Kotlin) with the ability to architect a new app end to end.
  • Familiarity with mobile build and release tooling (e.g. Fastlane).
  • Deep understanding of Apple and Android design principles, patterns, and best practices.
  • Ability to write clean, well-documented, maintainable code — and to direct AI to do the same.

Who You Are

  • A decisive builder who takes a problem and runs with it — you'd rather ship and iterate than wait for certainty.
  • Direct and results-driven, comfortable owning outcomes and making the call.
  • Energized by autonomy and full ownership of the technology.
  • Allergic to bureaucracy — "meetings that should have been emails" are your enemy.

Why You'll Love Working with Us

  • High autonomy: own the entire tech stack from idea to release.
  • Clear decision-making with minimal bureaucracy.
  • Work with the newest hardware and technologies.
  • Complimentary Claude Max subscription.
  • Flexible, remote-first role (full-time).
  • Paid annual leave.
  • Direct collaboration with the founder — your work will have visible impact from day one.

How to Apply

Send us your application including:

  • Your CV
  • A history of the mobile apps you've built (iOS and Android)
  • Salary expectations
  • (Optional) Code samples or GitHub repositories

Help us build and refine a product that runs like a well-oiled machine — and improves millions of lives in the process.

raw.description:
Company Overview

Planview has one mission: to close the gap between strategic intent and business outcome, providing the intelligence organizations need to act decisively.

As the global leader in Strategic Portfolio Management, Planview helps organizations of all sizes achieve their business goals, faster and smarter. Our comprehensive platform bring initiatives, investments, and resources into a continuous, connected model of the business: the actionable understanding leaders need to move decisively, keep teams and AI in lockstep, and know how their initiatives are performing.—now powered by Planview Anvi, our next-generation enterprise AI that delivers expert guidance, intelligent recommendations, and actionable insights, turning complex data into decisive action from strategy through execution.

Recognized as a Leader in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Strategic Portfolio Management for the fifth consecutive year, we proudly serve more than 3,000customers globally, including 45% of the Fortune 100—and more than 3 million users worldwide.

Why Join Planview?

At Planview, our people’s connections drive our innovation and success. Our global team of 1,500+ employees work remotely and across offices in Austin, Vancouver, Hod HaSharon, Bangalore, Sydney, and Stockholm. We've built a world-class, connected culture rooted in shared values that empowers our teams to thrive and succeed from anywhere. When you join Planview, you're not just joining a company, you're joining a movement to transform how the world works.

Discover more about our portfolio at planview.com, and connect with us on LinkedIn,Instagram, and X.


The Opportunity

We are looking for a Vice President, Information Security (VP, InfoSec) to join our team in Austin, TX or remote. The VP, InfoSec is responsible for the development, implementation, and management of the organization’s information security programs. This role involves protecting the organization’s information assets, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, and mitigating cybersecurity risks. The VP, InfoSec will work directly with the CIO/CISO to align security initiatives with the company’s overall business objectives and to safeguard against potential threats in an increasingly digital and interconnected environment.


What You'll Do

  1. Strategic Leadership
  • Develop and execute a comprehensive information security strategy aligned with organizational goals and regulatory requirements.
  • Provide expert advice on emerging cybersecurity trends, threats, and solutions.
  • Lead the creation of policies, procedures, and controls to protect sensitive information.
  1. Risk Management and Compliance
  • Identify, assess, and mitigate security risks.
  • Ensure compliance with industry standards, regulations, and legal requirements.
  • Oversee disaster recovery and business continuity planning.
  • Own the organization’s AI risk management framework, including assessment, treatment, and ongoing monitoring of AI-specific risks in alignment with ISO/IEC 42001.
  • Ensure compliance with AI-related regulations, including the EU AI Act and GDPR as applied to AI systems.
  1. Security Operations Management
  • Lead the design, implementation, and management of the organization’s security architecture.
  • Monitor and respond to security incidents, managing response teams and coordinating with external partners.
  • Proactively identify and address potential vulnerabilities.
  1. Team Leadership and Development
  • Build and manage a high-performing information security team.
  • Foster a culture of security awareness throughout the organization.
  1. Collaboration and Stakeholder Engagement
  • Integrate security measures across all aspects of the organization’s operations.
  • Establish relationships with external partners, including regulatory bodies and industry groups.
  • Communicate the value of information security initiatives to non-technical stakeholders.
  1. Governance and Reporting
  • Implement a global governance program for information security and compliance.
  • Provide regular status reports to senior business leaders.
  • Assess the effectiveness of cybersecurity activities to minimize risks.
  1. Strategy and Framework Implementation
  • Develop security vision aligned with organizational priorities.
  • Implement and maintain up-to-date security management frameworks (ISO 27001, ISO 42001, NIST, etc.).
  • Build and maintain an AI Management System (AIMS) aligned with ISO/IEC 42001:2023, including policies, procedures, controls, and audit readiness.
  • Balance user experience with security requirements.
  1. AI Governance
  • Chair or lead the AI Working Committee (or equivalent body) responsible for reviewing, risk-assessing, and approving generative AI adoption across the organization.
  • Develop and maintain AI governance policies covering responsible use, vendor assessment, incident response, and AI subject rights.
  • Evaluate and implement AI-powered security tooling (e.g., AI-driven threat detection, email security, vulnerability management).
  • Advise executive leadership and the Board on AI risk, emerging AI threats, and regulatory developments.
  1. Networking and Communication
  • Build internal networks among security team and other departments.
  • Nurture external networks with industry peers, partners, and agencies.
  • Provide input for company’s security policies and standards.
  1. Operational Management
  • Establish processes for security operations and incident management.
  • Create risk assessment processes for third parties.
  • Ensure security is embedded in project delivery processes.
  • Monitor external threats and advise on appropriate actions.
  1. Product Security
  • Provide expert leadership in product security, encompassing definition, documentation, and implementation of security concepts, requirements, and policies.
  • Effectively communicate product security strategies and practices to both internal organizational stakeholders and external customers.
  • Ensure AI-integrated product features are assessed for security risk and comply with the organization’s AIMS policies and customer-facing security commitments.
  • Offer subject matter expertise to guide and enhance the overall product security landscape within the company.
  1. Customer Contract Security and Data Privacy
  • Review and negotiate security addendums in customer and prospect contracts, ensuring commitments are achievable, clearly scoped, and consistent with the organization’s security posture and certification status.
  • Serve as the internal authority on security-related contract language, including data processing agreements (DPAs), data residency requirements, encryption standards, incident notification obligations, and audit rights.
  • Partner with Legal, Sales, and Customer Success to respond to customer security questionnaires, RFP security sections, and due diligence requests.
  • Maintain a working understanding of relevant data privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA, and equivalents) and ensure security controls and contractual commitments remain aligned with applicable privacy obligations.
  • Oversee the organization’s data privacy posture in coordination with the Data Privacy Officer, ensuring security practices support privacy-by-design principles.
  1. Financial Management
  • Contribute to annual budget planning and forecasting.
  • Track actuals against plan monthly and actively reforecast.
  1. Metrics and Reporting
  • Develop metrics to measure security goals and progress.
  • Implement and manage Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for key security functions and systems.
  1. Acquisition Support
  • Develop frameworks for efficient onboarding of new acquisitions.
  • Provide senior security leadership to clients, internal integration teams, and auditors.

What You'll Bring

Key Competencies

  • Drive Results
  • Be Adaptable
  • Build Collaborative Relationships
  • Make Complex Decisions
  • Create the New & Different

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Computer Science, or related field. Master’s degree or professional certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM, CISA) preferred.
  • Minimum 15 years of progressive experience in information security roles, with at least 5 years in senior management.
  • Proven experience in security strategy development and implementation.
  • Deep understanding of security frameworks, standards, and regulations.
  • Strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex security incidents and lead cross-functional teams.
  • Experience with AI governance frameworks (ISO/IEC 42001) and AI-related regulatory requirements (EU AI Act, GDPR) strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience building or maturing an AI Management System (AIMS) in a commercial software or SaaS environment.
  • Experience reviewing and negotiating security addendums, DPAs, and other security-related contract language in a B2B SaaS environment.

Supervision & Autonomy

  • Accountable for the performance of the information security function, with significant decision-making autonomy.
  • Provides guidance on prioritization, delegation, and resource allocation across the information security team.

Benefits at Planview

At Planview, you’ll join our global team and culture which reflects the vibrant communities in which our employees live and work. To support you at Planview, you will enjoy:

  • Unplugged Days: 4 company-wide paid days off per year to recharge and relax.
  • Generous PTO offerings (region dependent).
  • Region specific competitive benefit plans to support you at any life stage including parental leave, retirement, medical plans, wellness support, and remote work support.
  • Paid time to volunteer through Planview’s Force for Good Week.
  • Employee Referral bonus program.
  • Weekly office lunches for hybrid team members and social events.
  • Flexible work hours/environment.

Now is a great time to join our team. If you are looking for a place to grow your career, innovate with best-in-class solutions, and build the future of connected work, Planview is the right place for you!


Equal Employment Opportunity at Planview

Planview is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. As part of our efforts to build a diverse workforce, we encourage applications from Indigenous, Black, and other racialized communities, 2SLGBTQIA+ communities, people with neurodivergence, immigrants, people with disabilities, and other equity deserving groups. In addition to building a diverse workforce, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible experience.

Reasonable accommodations for the interview process can be requested by emailing .


AI Use in Recruitment

Planview may employ AI-based tools to support certain recruiting activities, however all decisions affecting a candidate's application are made by a human recruiter or hiring manager. Planview is committed to complying with applicable AI regulations, including the EU AI Act and other emerging legislation in the jurisdictions in which we operate, and reviews its AI practices as these requirements evolve. If you require further information or would like to exercise your rights under applicable privacy laws, please submit your request at the Planview Data Subject Access Request (DSAR) Portal.

raw.description:
Regional Sales Manager

KiddeFenwal

Overview

KiddeFenwal is a global leader in industrial and commercial fire suppression systems and safety controls. Through our trusted brands—Kidde Fire Systems and Kidde Fire Protection—we deliver certified fire detection, suppression, and control solutions across industrial, commercial, and marine sectors. Our Fenwal Controls business supports OEMs with gas ignition, temperature control, and overheat detection products.

Headquartered in Ashland, Massachusetts, with operations in the United States, United Kingdom (KFI-UK), and India (KTI-India), we are committed to protecting lives, livelihoods, and iconic assets worldwide. Learn more at

Our Purpose

We protect lives and livelihoods through innovation, trusted partnerships, and a commitment to excellence. Integrity, safety, and teamwork are the foundation of everything we do.

Regional Sales Manager - Germany

Position will be remote from your home, based in Germany. Must have close proximity to a major transportation hub.

Position Summary

The Regional Sales Manager is responsible for driving revenue growth, increasing market share, and achieving sales objectives across assigned territories with a focus on Germany but extending to other parts of Europe, with support for selected international markets as required. This customer-facing, quota-carrying role focuses on developing and executing sales strategies, managing key customer and channel relationships, expanding existing accounts, and acquiring new customers to achieve aggressive growth targets.

The Regional Sales Manager serves as the primary commercial leader for assigned territories and accounts, working closely with distributors, end users, engineering firms, contractors, OEMs, and strategic partners to increase sales of KiddeFenwal's fire suppression and fire protection solutions. The role requires a highly motivated sales professional with a proven ability to develop opportunities, close business, manage complex sales cycles, and consistently exceed sales goals.

Key Responsibilities

Sales Leadership and Revenue Growth

raw.description:
Reebelo is a marketplace for refurbished tech devices and certified pre-owned lifestyle products. We empower consumers to save up to 70% on their favorite brands while contributing to a sustainable future with every purchase. Our ambitious vision is to lead the circular economy, transforming how people think about consumption. Headquartered in the San Francisco Bay Area with team members across the US, Canada, Australia, Singapore, Malaysia, the UK, France, Germany and Italy. We have raised over $65M in funding and are fully profitable, join our VC-backed scaleup if you’re ready to be part of a dynamic, high-growth team dedicated to making a meaningful impact.

About the role

In this genuinely exciting role, you’ll be the sole owner of the day-to-day People function for 50+ global team — people operations, recruitment, and employee support — working directly with the founders. You’ll inherit a well-documented foundation: a global HRIS (Rippling), a documented payroll and compliance calendar with per-country runbooks, and established external providers and advisors.

What you’ll do

  • People operations: own onboarding and offboarding end-to-end (contracts, right-to-work, systems access, final pay, benefits administration including US open enrollment and leave, records, and verification letters).
  • Team Engagement: find creative and exciting ways to connect our globally distributed team.
  • Recruitment: run the full lifecycle — job ads, sourcing, LinkedIn applicant review, screening, interview coordination, ATS data integrity, references, and offers.
  • Employee relations & difficult conversations: act as first point of contact for all employee matters; support performance conversations, exits, and separation agreement negotiations across jurisdictions with maturity and discretion, escalating to external counsel where needed.
  • Compliance in a global setup: execute statutory obligations per jurisdiction to hard deadlines.
  • Founder support: people reporting, headcount and cost data, and quarterly board input preparation.

What you’ll bring

  • Minimum of 3+ years in a generalist role where you have experienced the entire employee lifecycle and recruitment.
  • HRIS & tech fluency. Rippling experience a significant advantage.
  • Ideally you will have experience with supporting team members based outside of the US, experience with APAC and EU a significant advantage.
  • You can hold difficult conversations with judgment and discretion — performance, exits, sensitive employee matters.
  • Extreme organisation and follow-through in a solo-operator environment with minimal supervision; you document as you go and know when to pull in external experts.
  • Comfort working across time zones with a globally distributed team.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Remote: Open to candidates based across the US. We have offices in San Mateo, New York and Salt Lake City.
  • Compensation: Competitive salary, performance bonus, 4% employer match and performance bonus (increasing to 5% 1 Jan 2027).
  • Benefits: 85% employer coverage & generous HSA plans (increasing to 90% 1 Jan 2027).
  • Low-Meeting Culture: We prioritize focus time and async communication.
  • Lean, High Performance Team: Reebelo intentionally operates with a lean, high performance team. Our engineers love this because they love owning their projects end-to-end and seeing the impact of their contributions daily!
  • Global Mobility: We support team members working remotely anywhere in the globe for set periods of time with the option to spend time working from one of our international co-working space in San Francisco, New York, Toronto and Melbourne.

Interview process

  1. Initial Screen Interview with our outgoing Head of People [15-30 minutes]
  2. Case Study Interview [60 minutes]
  3. Final Interview (45-60 minutes]
  4. References & Background Checks
  5. Offer 🎉

We know the job search can be both exciting and exhausting, so we strive to keep things simple, streamlined and respectful of your time—our interview process takes 2-3 weeks.

Work Rights

We are only able to consider applicants who hold full, independent working rights in the US. Unfortunately, we are unable to offer visa sponsorship or support work permit applications for this role.

Então se você quer fazer parte dessa missão de quebrar barreiras de comunicação entre pessoas surdas e ouvintes através da tecnologia no mundo inteiro, trabalhe conosco e conheça mais daHand Talk!

  • Faça parte de um time AAA.
  • Temos um excelente clima de trabalho, com o tempero necessário para você viver uma grande experiência :)
  • Trabalhe lado a lado com alguns dos empreendedores sociais mais reconhecidos no Brasil e no mundo.
  • Tenha o protagonismo na sua carreira em um ambiente com projetos desafiadores.
  • Um ambiente altamente desafiador e colaborativo.
  • Possibilidade de aprendizado e crescimento acelerado, com oportunidade de implementar projetos que serão cases de sucesso no mundo digital.

Visite nosso blog, canal no Youtube, redes sociais ou dá um Google aí que também vai achar muita coisa bacana sobre a Hand Talk!

Responsabilidades Principais:

Aqui, a autoridade é dividida por tipo de decisão, não por cargo: o Tech Lead é o dono final da execução técnica e da arquitetura - aponta o caminho, e cada pessoa escolhe como chegar lá. Roadmap e estratégia são construídos em conjunto com o Engineering Manager e o PM.

  • Definir as prioridades técnicas do time, transformando o roadmap de produto em requisitos técnicos acionáveis - sendo o dono final das decisões de arquitetura e execução;
  • Governança de código na era da IA: estabelecer e manter os padrões de desenvolvimento, segurança e sustentabilidade do código do time - incluindo guardrails e processos de revisão, testes e QA para código gerado por IA;
  • Mentoria e multiplicação: elevar a barra técnica do time através de mentoria constante e revisão - o papel é ser multiplicador do código de todos, não o melhor dev individual da sala;
  • Segurança e compliance: liderar tecnicamente as revisões de segurança, a análise de vulnerabilidades e a conformidade com os padrões corporativos de desenvolvimento;
  • Observabilidade: construir e ler o monitoramento (saúde dos apps, erros operacionais, uptime, SLAs) que diz ao time onde agir - conectando-o às métricas de qualidade e representatividade dos dados;
  • Fundação compartilhada: liderar o desenho e a evolução incremental da fundação comum entre os apps - componentes, sequenciamento e padrões de integração decididos junto com o time.

Habilidades Técnicas:

  • Experiência comprovada com liderança de equipes técnicas de desenvolvimento de software;
  • Proficiência em desenvolvimento web full-stack com TypeScript e Javascript (React e Angular), incluindo modelagem e uso de bancos de dados e design de APIs;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em arquitetura de software: APIs, arquitetura orientada a eventos, padrões de projeto e design de plataformas;
  • Inglês avançado em escrita e conversação;
  • Experiência comprovada com desenvolvimento assistido por IA: uso fluente de IA no dia a dia, tanto para desenvolvimento quanto para documentação - e, principalmente, capacidade de definir padrões, guardrails e processos de revisão para código gerado por IA;
  • Experiência com observabilidade: construir e ler monitoramento (logs, métricas, alertas) como base para decidir onde o time atua;
Diferencial:
  • Stack: conhecimentos sólidos em AWS (ECS/Fargate, S3), containers, Terraform/IaC e CI/CD;
  • Experiência com segurança no ciclo de desenvolvimento: análise estática e dinâmica (ex.: SonarQube), threat modeling e processos formais de security review e compliance;

Habilidades Comportamentais:
  • Interesse por diversidade, inclusão e acessibilidade;
  • Curiosidade;
  • Colaboratividade;
  • Estrutura e orientação para a ação;
  • Confortável trabalhando em ambiguidade e em ambientes de estágio inicial;
  • Foco no impacto — não apenas na produção (output);
  • Pensamento sistêmico: capacidade de prever como uma mudança em um app ou na fundação compartilhada impacta a qualidade dos dados que chegam ao modelo e os times que dependem deles;
  • Liderança por influência: habilidade de guiar o time tomando decisões técnicas sem depender de autoridade hierárquica - aqui, decisões relevantes passam por diálogo aberto antes de serem fechadas, mesmo quando a palavra final é sua;
  • Desenvolvimento de pessoas: saber identificar pontos de melhoria técnica e comportamental e atuar de forma humana e individualizada - cada perfil precisa de uma dose diferente de autonomia e de suporte;
  • Cultura de segurança psicológica: tratar falha como hipótese refutada, não como erro - e construir um ambiente onde testar, perguntar e discordar não tem custo;
  • Comunicação clara, objetiva e acessível: escrita assíncrona de qualidade em um time remoto e internacional, que inclui pessoas Surdas e ouvintes;
  • Autonomia e resiliência: conforto em liderar durante transições reais - herança de sistemas, migrações e revisões de segurança acontecendo em paralelo à entrega;
  • Tradução técnica: capacidade de traduzir conceitos técnicos para um público diverso de stakeholders - linguistas, cientistas de IA, produto e liderança.

Job Category

Customer Success

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

** This is a skillbridge role and only open to transitioning service members currently in our Military Fellowship program


Salesforce Professional Services is hiring a Senior Solution Consultant to join our Missionforce Delivery team. This role supports complex workstreams for strategic customers in the Defense and National Security space, partnering closely with stakeholders to translate mission priorities into scalable, secure Salesforce solutions.


The Solution Consultant / Senior Solution Consultant serves as a key point of contact for solution design and delivery execution — shaping and maintaining the final-state vision across process design, platform configuration, requirements prioritization, and sprint delivery. They navigate ambiguity, identify risks, and drive alignment across customer and internal delivery teams.

In this role, they lead platform configuration activities, facilitate process mapping, validate requirements, analyze business needs, and partner with customer product owners, business process owners, technical resources, and internal delivery teams to craft comprehensive, mission-aligned solutions. You will apply sound judgment to assess data quality, validate sources, and responsibly evaluate AI-generated outputs to mitigate bias, improve accuracy, and ensure reliable delivery outcomes.


This role requires a strong learning mindset, intellectual curiosity, and the ability to adapt in a dynamic, mission-focused environment. Solution Consultants and Senior Solution Consultants proactively adopt new ways of working — including the responsible use of AI where applicable — while maintaining accountability and ethical judgement for outcomes.


YOUR IMPACT:

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to Defense and National Security clients, translating complex mission requirements into actionable Salesforce solutions
  • Participate as an active contributor to internal initiatives, growing the consulting practice and advancing the community's knowledge base and expertise
  • Guide customers and colleagues in rationalizing and deploying emerging technologies — including Agentforce and AI-powered capabilities — that drive measurable business and mission value
  • Work collaboratively across delivery teams with strong communication skills; bring creative, prescriptive thinking across all levels of a client organization

  • Review and correct key artifacts to keep projects on track, and ensure solutions are extendable and maintainable going forward
  • Work closely with Delivery Managers, Solution Architects, and Technical Architects — and directly with clients — to design technology solutions that meet mission needs
  • Contribute to program vision and case creation; monitor and deliver program elements across the lifecycle while articulating strategies for enabling technologies including the Salesforce Platform

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:


  • 3+ years of relevant experience, including enterprise consulting experience in a mid- to large-sized organization in positions of growing responsibility
  • Security clearance: Active Secret, TS or TS/SCI (a must)
  • This candidate must be a U.S. citizen (U.S. born or naturalized) who does not hold dual citizenship and agrees to complete a U.S. federal government Minimum Background Investigation (MBI) for a Moderate Public Trust position.
  • Demonstrated experience with Salesforce platform implementation across the full delivery lifecycle
  • Strong presentation skills; able to clearly articulate a point of view to diverse stakeholders including government clients
  • Meticulous with the ability to rapidly learn and take advantage of new concepts, business models, and technologies
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to effectively develop materials that are appropriate for the audience
  • A skilled listener with the ability to connect with people across diverse roles
  • Proven ability to analyze, design, and optimize business processes via technology and integration
  • Resourceful and innovative problem-solver who can work through complexity and ambiguity
  • Travel is an integral part of this role; approximately 25%, based on individual customer requirements

PREFERRED REQUIREMENTS:


  • Metro DC located
  • Relevant Salesforce certifications strongly recommended (e.g., Administrator, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Platform App Builder)
  • Degree or equivalent relevant experience; experience will be evaluated based on core competencies (extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
  • Demonstrated results translating business user stories into technical requirements documents
  • Confirmed results leading customer and/or partner success
  • Knowledge of Agile methodology and experience in Agile delivery environments
  • Hands-on knowledge of AI tools and the ability to apply them for strategic impact across planning, delivery, and customer engagements

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance andbe your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you cando your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. raw.excerpt: Our Company The North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) is a not-for-profit international regulatory authority whose mission is to assure the effective and efficient reduction of risks to the reliability and security of the grid.
raw.description:
Our Company

The North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) is a not-for-profit international regulatory authority whose mission is to assure the effective and efficient reduction of risks to the reliability and security of the grid. NERC develops and enforces Reliability Standards; annually assesses seasonal and long‐term reliability; monitors the bulk power system through system awareness; and educates, trains, and certifies industry personnel. NERC’s area of responsibility spans the continental United States, Canada, and the northern portion of Baja California, Mexico. NERC is the Electric Reliability Organization (ERO) for North America, subject to oversight by the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) and provincial authorities in Canada. NERC’s jurisdiction includes users, owners, and operators of the bulk power system, which serves nearly 400 million people.

Our Mission

The vision for the ERO Enterprise, which is comprised of NERC and the six Regional Entities, is a highly reliable and secure North American bulk power system. Our mission is to assure the effective and efficient reduction of risks to the reliability and security of the grid.

Your Impact

The Standard Development Administrator will administer standards registration, balloting, and electronic systems for NERC’s Standards Information area along with providing administrative support of a varied nature to the standard development area. The Standard Development Administrator reports to the Manager of Standard Information.

Your Role

Support multiple, concurrent standard development projects and activities including:

  • Post meeting agendas, minutes, draft standards, and related documents to the NERC website to reflect the status of Standards Development efforts.
  • Maintain the public NERC Standards calendar for all project-related standard development drafting team meetings, workshops, webinars, and other items as needed.
  • Respond to industry stakeholder inquiries related to standards development processes, approved Reliability Standards and supporting systems.
  • Administer the standard registration and balloting processes by preparing ballot events, assisting stakeholders in registering to become members of the Registered Ballot Body, and by fielding technical questions associated with registration and balloting.
  • Maintain a public record of NERC standards development activities in accordance with the current NERC Rules of Procedure by maintaining, providing quality assurance review of, and recommending improvements to the public NERC Reliability Standards Web pages.
  • Maintain and update department-wide templates and process documents.
  • Conduct extensive and frequent document reviews for project-related standard development and other ad-hoc items as needed.
  • Administer electronic systems for the collection and publication of stakeholder comments on standard-related projects.
  • Assist with system-related enhancements, including user acceptance testing.
  • Other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Qualifications

The successful candidate will have at a minimum:

  • Four-year degree from an accredited college or university preferred.
  • Two or more years’ work experience in a high-volume production environment.
  • Proficiency in using Microsoft Office applications including ability to use advanced formatting with Microsoft Word and Adobe Acrobat.
  • Exceptional focus and diligence. Skills in proofing, editing, or other detailed work.
  • Excellent oral and written communications skills, including excellent grammar and spelling.
  • Ability to provide excellent customer service to internal and external customers.
  • Ability to work well in a fast-paced environment without direct supervision to meet deadlines, manage multiple tasks and accept shifting priorities.

Preferred candidates will also have:

  • Experience with administering web content, understanding of process to place content on web pages.
  • Working knowledge of NERC's standards process.
  • Strong organizational skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to think "outside the box" by making recommendations for improvements to processes and tools.
  • Demonstrated curiosity in a wide variety of areas and is open to exploring new situations, knowledge and opportunities for growth and development.
  • Demonstrates an anticipatory mindset, preventing problems, and building contingencies where appropriate.

Other

  • A background check will be conducted prior to employment.
  • In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification document form upon hire.
  • This position has been classified as exempt.
  • Thepositionmay be based remotely but must be able to travel to NERC offices or meeting locations when needed. Reimbursement of travel expenses will be in accordance with the company’s travel and expense reimbursement policies.

Our Culture Declarations

  • Everyone at NERC is a leader.
  • We are accountable personally and organizationally to deliver on commitments.
  • We develop ourselves and people in the organization to ensure that NERC realizes its strategic objectives.
  • We are resilient and adaptable to the challenges and needs of the business/people.
  • We exude a growth mindset and empower teams to take risks.
  • We build collaborative relationships within NERC, the ERO, and the stakeholders of NERC.
  • We exemplify NERC cultural behaviors:
  • We reward high-quality, creative, and innovative work.
  • We attract, engage, and retain top talent.
  • We value and respect diverse perspectives.
  • We provide a safe, inclusive, and collaborative work environment.
  • We form strong relationships within the company and with the ERO Enterprise.
  • We demonstrate curiosity in a wide variety of areas and are open to exploring new situations, knowledge, and opportunities for growth and development.
  • We demonstrate an anticipatory mindset by preventing problems and building contingencies where appropriate.
  • We champion diversity and inclusion by seeking out and valuing diverse perspectives.

Xplor Technologies powers the experiences at the heart of everyday life. Through modern vertical software, embedded payments, and AI-powered capabilities, we help businesses in fitness, recreation, golf and club, field services, laundry, education, and other membership-based and service-based industries simplify operations, uncover insights, and elevate customer and member experiences.

We unite popular brands such as foreUP, myFitApp, Vermont Systems, Momence, Exerp, Mariana Tek, Resamania, FieldEdge, CampBrain and many more.

Join our Fitness and Wellbeing vertical as Global Customer Support Director dedicated to our Momence team, to make a real impact every day. We say that because we know that every conversation we have, every code line we write and every interface we design is another opportunity for us to enrich our customers’ experiences.

We are seeking an experienced, results-driven Senior Director of Global Customer Support to lead and transform customer support operations for Momence, a leading software platform serving fitness, wellness, and service-based businesses worldwide.

This leader will be responsible for delivering a consistently exceptional customer support experience while building a highly efficient, scalable, and technology-enabled global support organization.

The ideal candidate is a strong operational leader with a proven track record of scaling high-volume SaaS support organizations, optimizing workforce performance, improving service quality, and leveraging AI and automation to drive operational excellence.

This role requires someone who is equally comfortable developing a global support strategy and diving deep into operational metrics, workforce models, customer escalations, and process improvements.

You will lead a global, 24/7 support operation, ensuring customers receive timely, accurate, and effective assistance across multiple channels, geographies, and time zones.

We are looking for a leader who can challenge traditional support models, build high-performing teams, and create a modern support organization where people, processes, data, and technology work together to deliver outstanding customer outcomes.

Some of the things you'll do:

  • Global Support Operations: Lead and optimize 24/7 global customer support operations, ensuring consistent service quality, operational standards, and customer experiences across regions, time zones, and channels.
  • Operational Performance: Own support performance, including service levels, response and resolution times, backlog management, productivity, and customer satisfaction, driving measurable improvements in speed, quality, and efficiency.
  • Workforce Management: Develop and execute a comprehensive workforce management strategy, including capacity planning, forecasting, scheduling, and resource optimization to support 24/7 operations.
  • AI & Automation: Lead the adoption of AI, automation, and emerging technologies to transform support delivery, improve agent productivity, enhance customer experiences, and increase operational efficiency.
  • Quality Assurance: Establish and continuously improve quality assurance programs, operational processes, and performance standards to ensure consistent, high-quality customer interactions.
  • Customer Experience: Own support satisfaction metrics, including CSAT and customer effort, and drive initiatives to reduce repeat contacts, unnecessary escalations, and customer friction.
  • Operational Efficiency: Identify opportunities to improve operating leverage, streamline workflows, reduce costs, and scale support operations without compromising service quality.
  • Incident & Escalation Management: Ensure effective incident response, escalation procedures, and proactive customer communication during critical customer-impacting events.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to address root causes of customer issues, improve product quality, and reduce support demand.
  • Leadership & Talent Development: Lead and develop a geographically distributed support organization, building strong frontline leadership, clear accountability, succession plans, and a culture of customer focus.
  • Continuous Improvement & Change Management: Foster a culture of innovation, operational discipline, and continuous improvement, leading organizational change and adoption of new technologies and processes.
  • Financial & Operational Accountability: Own support budgets, headcount planning, and cost management while establishing a data-driven operating model with clear KPIs, performance reporting, and actionable insights for executive leadership.

Working arrangements:

  • Fully Remote in US: You can work remotely in this position, provided you reside in US, have full working rights and do not require sponsorship.

Qualifications

What would make me a good candidate?

We are looking for curious and empathetic people. We also love to hear from people who are motivated by meaningful work, resonate with our core values, have a positive outlook, are comfortable with ambiguity and thrive working in an ever-evolving and complex environment. We are inspired by meeting big-picture thinkers and doers, people who can be both tactical and strategic, aim high and put people first in everything they do.

You'll need:

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in customer support, customer operations, or service delivery, including significant leadership experience in a high-growth SaaS or technology environment.
  • 5+ years leading large-scale, multi-layered support organizations, ideally with global, 24/7 operations.
  • Demonstrated success scaling support operations while improving service quality, operational productivity, and cost efficiency.
  • Proven experience implementing AI, automation, and self-service technologies that deliver measurable operational and customer experience improvements.
  • Strong command of support performance metrics, including CSAT, SLA attainment, first-contact resolution, average handle time, response and resolution times, productivity, and cost per contact.
  • Experience developing and implementing comprehensive quality assurance, coaching, and performance management programs.
  • Strong financial and analytical capabilities, including budget ownership, resource planning, and ROI analysis.
  • Experience leading organizational transformation and driving meaningful change across geographically distributed teams.
  • Excellent communication, executive presentation, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Ability to operate strategically while remaining highly engaged in day-to-day operational execution.

It would be great if you also have:

  • Experience supporting SMB customers in a high-volume, multi-tenant SaaS environment.
  • Experience in fitness, wellness, hospitality, payments, or other transaction-intensive software industries.
  • Hands-on experience with modern customer support platforms such as Intercom, Zendesk, or similar solutions.
  • Familiarity with workforce management and quality platforms, including forecasting, scheduling, and automated quality monitoring.
  • Experience supporting customers across North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific.
  • Experience leading distributed or outsourced support teams.
  • Knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement methodologies.

At Xplor, we believe that the best innovation and ideas happen at the intersections of our differences - people of diverse cultures, generations, disciplines, and lived experiences. So even if you don't tick all the boxes, we still encourage you to apply.

Values and Life at Xplor

Our five core values guide us from how we hire and recognise our team members to how we interact with our customers day to day:

  • Find a better way
  • Do the right thing
  • Say it straight
  • Win together
  • Own the outcome

If these values sound like you and describe people you want to work with, you will thrive at Xplor.

As an Xplorer, you will be part of a global network of talented colleagues who will support your success. We look for commonalities and shared passions and give people the tools they need to deliver great work and grow at speed.

Ready to apply?

To start your application, please submit your resume, and we will be in touch as soon as we can.

raw.title: Staff Accountant
raw.excerpt: Linus Health is a digital health company on a mission to transform brain health through the early detection of cognitive impairment and neurological conditions, including Alzheimer's disease.
raw.description:
Linus Health is a digital health company on a mission to transform brain health through the early detection of cognitive impairment and neurological conditions, including Alzheimer's disease. Our AI-powered digital cognitive assessments help healthcare providers identify cognitive changes earlier, enabling more informed clinical decisions and improved patient outcomes.

At Linus, we embrace AI not only in the products we develop but also in how we operate as a business. Across our teams, including Finance, we leverage AI and emerging technologies to streamline processes, improve efficiency, enhance decision-making, and drive continuous improvement.

The Role

Linus Health is seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Staff Accountant to join our Finance team. In this role, you will support day-to-day accounting operations, month-end close activities, account reconciliations, and financial reporting to ensure the accuracy and integrity of our financial records.

We are building an AI-native accounting function that leverages emerging technologies and automation to streamline processes, improve efficiency, and enhance financial operations. As part of this effort, you will have the opportunity to help shape how we close the books, using tools such as Claude and NetSuite automation to modernize workflows and drive continuous improvement.

The ideal candidate is organized, analytical, tech-savvy, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities may evolve. This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to expand their accounting experience, take ownership of key processes, and play an active role in building a modern, technology-driven accounting function.

What You’ll Do

AI-Enabled Accounting & Automation

  • Use AI to draft reconciliations, flux analysis, accruals, and variance commentary, and validate all outputs before posting
  • Build and document reusable AI workflows for recurring close tasks
  • Use AI to flag anomalies in AP, card, and billing data
  • Follow our data-handling rules for financial and health-related data when using AI tools

General Accounting & Month-End Close

  • Support monthly, quarterly, and annual close processes to ensure timely and accurate financial reporting.
  • Prepare and post journal entries, including accruals, prepaids, and other recurring adjustments.
  • Perform monthly balance sheet account reconciliations and investigate discrepancies.
  • Maintain accurate general ledger records and supporting documentation.
  • Assist with preparation of monthly financial statements and management reporting.
  • Support intercompany accounting and reconciliations across domestic and international entities.

Accounts Payable & Expense Management

  • Support accounts payable activities, including invoice processing, coding, and payment reconciliations.
  • Review employee expenses and corporate card transactions to ensure accurate classification and compliance with company policies.
  • Maintain vendor records and assist with resolving invoice or payment discrepancies.
  • Monitor outstanding payables and support timely payment processing.

Accounts Receivable & Revenue Support

  • Assist with customer invoicing, accounts receivable reconciliations, and payment tracking.
  • Support revenue recognition processes and related documentation in accordance with ASC 606.
  • Partner with Finance and other departments to resolve billing discrepancies and maintain accurate customer account records.

Compliance & Process Improvement

  • Ensure accounting records and processes comply with U.S. GAAP and internal controls.
  • Identify opportunities to improve accounting workflows, reporting accuracy, and operational efficiency.
  • Support accounting system improvements and automation initiatives.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with People Operations to support payroll-related reconciliations and benefit expense accounting.
  • Assist with ad hoc financial analysis, reporting, and special projects as needed.

What Excellence Looks Like

  • Drive measurable improvements in accounting operations, including reducing month-end close timelines each quarter, converting recurring tasks into documented AI-assisted workflows, minimizing post-close adjustments, and improving overall efficiency and accuracy.
  • Consistently accurate and timely completion of assigned month-end close activities.
  • Well-maintained reconciliations and supporting financial documentation.
  • Proactive identification and resolution of accounting discrepancies.
  • Strong collaboration with Finance and cross-functional stakeholders.

About You

Required

  • 1–3 years of relevant accounting experience.
  • Hands-on AI use in accounting or analysis work, with a habit of checking outputs against source data.
  • Solid understanding of U.S. GAAP and general accounting principles.
  • Experience preparing journal entries, performing account reconciliations, and supporting month-end close.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, including pivot tables, lookups, and financial data analysis.
  • Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Excellent communication and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fully remote environment.

Preferred

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

●Scripting or automation experience

  • Experience with NetSuite or a comparable ERP system.
  • Previous experience in a SaaS, healthcare technology, or high-growth technology company.
  • Familiarity with ASC 606 revenue recognition.
  • Experience supporting multi-entity or international accounting operations.
  • Exposure to accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll accounting, and expense management systems.
  • CPA certification or progress toward CPA licensure is a plus.

Linus Health is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, genetic information, disability or any characteristic protected by law. We believe that diversity is critical to the growth of our company and understand the importance of fostering an environment where everyone has a voice. We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities during the recruiting process. If you are in need of assistance due to a disability, please contact us.

The expected base salary range for this position is $75,000 to $85,000 USD annually. In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for equity, discretionary bonus and a comprehensive benefits package, including health benefits, unlimited PTO, a monthly flex day, and a 401(k) plan with an employer match.

Actual compensation will be determined based on a variety of factors, including, but not limited to, relevant skills, professional experience, qualifications, geographic location, internal equity, and market conditions. The final offer may vary based on these factors.

raw.title: Account Manager, US
raw.excerpt: The Opportunity As Account Manager, US, you’ll own and grow a portfolio of MedMe’s US customers, starting with independent pharmacies and smaller organizations and expanding into larger, more complex accounts over time.
raw.description:
The Opportunity

As Account Manager, US, you’ll own and grow a portfolio of MedMe’s US customers, starting with independent pharmacies and smaller organizations and expanding into larger, more complex accounts over time.

MedMe is actively expanding across the US, launching new products, entering new states, and working with customers who often require more hands-on support as workflows, regulations, and local requirements vary. This role exists to ensure customers are successfully onboarded, supported through change, and positioned to expand their use of MedMe as we grow together.

You’ll be responsible for managing customer relationships end to end, with a strong focus on adoption, pilots, and expansion. The work involves leading customers through change as MedMe evolves, coordinating across Product, Customer Success, and Sales to support new capabilities, additional locations, and expanded programs. A core part of the role is understanding how different state requirements, clinical programs, and pharmacy workflows shape adoption, and using that context to embed MedMe into day-to-day operations in ways that create stickiness, reliance, and long-term account growth.

This role is ideal for someone who has managed healthcare accounts through periods of change before, is comfortable running pilots and implementation programs, and knows how to drive expansion through new product adoption, additional locations, referrals, and broader organizational rollouts.

About MedMe Health

At MedMe, we are passionate about empowering pharmacists to provide services beyond just prescribing. Our mission is to build an all-in-one cloud-based platform that enables pharmacists to schedule, document, and manage clinical services at scale. With over 4,500 pharmacies using our software, we've facilitated more than 25 million patient services, transforming pharmacies into community health hubs across North America.

What You'll Do

  • Account ownership: Own end-to-end relationships with a portfolio of US customers, serving as the primary point of accountability for adoption, retention, and expansion

  • Account growth: Drive account growth through new product adoption, additional locations, expanded programs, and broader organizational rollouts

  • Cross-functional partnership: Partner closely with Customer Success and Sales to ensure clean handoffs, aligned expectations, and continuity across the customer lifecycle

  • Expansion opportunities: Identify expansion opportunities by understanding customer goals, workflows, and operational constraints, not just usage metrics

  • Implementations and pilots: Lead customers through implementations, pilots, and phased rollouts as MedMe launches new capabilities or enters new states

  • Pilot planning: Coordinate with Product, Customer Success, and Operations to define success criteria, timelines, and next steps for pilots and expansion initiatives

  • Change management: Guide customers through operational and regulatory change, helping them adopt new workflows in a way that aligns with local requirements

  • Product partnership: Work closely with Product during new launches and market expansion, bringing real-world customer use cases, state-level nuance, and workflow context into rollout planning

  • Customer feedback: Share structured feedback from customers to inform prioritization, rollout approaches, and future product decisions

  • Rollout quality: Help ensure new capabilities land in ways that are practical, scalable, and aligned with how customers actually operate

About You

  • You bring 4+ years of managing complex mid-market (typically regional) and enterprise (typically national) healthcare accounts

  • You understand which stakeholders matter at different moments, from operational leaders and clinical teams to executive sponsors, and when to engage each to drive adoption, rollout, and expansion

  • You bring a strong understanding of pharmacy operations at scale, including how large organizations standardize workflows, manage change, and roll out technology across many locations

  • You’re comfortable operating in regulated healthcare environments, with practical experience accounting for state-level regulations, compliance requirements, and risk considerations that shape customer behaviour

  • You’ve driven account expansion from within existing customers, through product adoption, additional locations, or broader organizational rollouts

  • You know how to identify where a product becomes embedded into operational workflows, creating stickiness, reliance, and durable account growth

  • You communicate clearly, navigate complex situations well, and reliably follow through

Success in This Role Looks Like

  • 30 days: Learn MedMe’s platform, US service lines, and how state requirements shape adoption. Meet your accounts alongside Customer Success and Sales, and build an account plan for each priority customer.

  • 60 days: Own day-to-day relationships across your portfolio. Lead at least one active pilot or rollout, with success criteria and next steps agreed with Product and Customer Success.

  • 90 days: Fully own retention and expansion across your book, with a clear pipeline of expansion opportunities (new products, locations, and programs) and a first round of structured customer feedback shared with Product.

  • Long-term: A growing book where MedMe is embedded in customers’ day-to-day operations. You’re the go-to voice on how state requirements and pharmacy workflows shape US adoption, and you take on larger, more complex accounts over time.

How We Hire

MedMe is committed to a fair and equitable hiring process for all candidates. To ensure that each candidate's journey is consistent and the selection process is unbiased, the team at MedMe will not be responding to any personal messages regarding this role or other opportunities. This role will follow the below Interview Process:

  1. Initial screening conversation with our People and Culture team

  2. Intro interview with the hiring manager

  3. Technical interview with the team

  4. Additional cross-functional interview as required (depending on the role)

  5. References and offer

How We Use AI

At MedMe, we use AI to help us organize and manage applications, so our team can spend their time where it matters most. Every CV is personally reviewed by a human being; AI helps us stay organized, not make decisions. We believe AI should make great people more effective, not replace the thinking and judgment that great hiring requires.

Perks at MedMe

  • Health Benefits: A monthly health allowance through our QSEHRA that reimburses your individual health insurance premiums and eligible medical expenses, so you pick the plan, doctors and coverage that fit your needs

  • Professional Development: We support your growth with a yearly budget dedicated to learning opportunities

  • Work-from-Home Stipend: A dedicated stipend to help set up and maintain your ideal home office

  • Office Closure for Holidays: Enjoy 1 week of company-wide office closure during the holidays

  • Company Retreats: Participate in exciting on-site team retreats for collaboration and bonding

Location

This is a remote position based in the United States. Candidates based in Canada with relevant experience supporting the US healthcare market may also be considered. Occasional travel may be required for customer meetings, internal onsites or offsites, and company events.

Equal Opportunity & Accessibility

MedMe is a proud equal opportunity workplace that is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We're looking for motivated and compassionate people who can execute from the ground up and support the work that MedMe believes in.

MedMe is committed to developing an inclusive, barrier-free recruitment process and work environment. Should you require any accommodation, please inform us and we will work with you to meet your accessibility needs. For any accessibility-related assistance, requests for information in accessible alternative formats or to report any accessibility problems, please share in your application.

Learn More About MedMe

If you’d like more context on MedMe, our growth, and the team you’d be joining, here are a few highlights:

  • TIME – World’s Top HealthTech Companies (2026): MedMe was named to TIME’s list of the World’s Top HealthTech Companies, developed with Statista, which recognizes 500 health tech companies globally. 🔗 Link

  • Globe and Mail – Canada’s Top Growing Companies (2025 & 2026): MedMe has been recognized on The Globe and Mail’s list of Canada’s Top Growing Companies two years running, based on audited three-year revenue growth. 🔗 2026 | 🔗 2025

  • Forbes 30 Under 30: Our co-founders were named to Forbes 30 Under 30 for their work building MedMe. 🔗 Read more

  • C100 Growth Cohort (2025): MedMe is part of the 2025 C100 Growth Cohort, a selective community of Canada’s top scaling companies. 🔗 Link

Compensation

The salary range for this role is USD $70,000 - $110,000 annually. Compensation is determined based on experience, skills, and alignment to the role's scope. We're happy to discuss the full details of our compensation package with candidates who progress through our interview process. Compensation for candidates based in Canada will be market-adjusted based on location and experience.

Job Description

Position - Corporate Legal & Compliance Executive

Location

Dubai, UAE

Experience

2–3 Years

Job Summary

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Corporate Legal & Compliance Executive to support the Group's legal, corporate secretarial, and regulatory compliance functions across the UAE and international jurisdictions. The role involves managing company incorporation, governance, statutory compliance, licensing, legal documentation, regulatory coordination, and corporate records while ensuring compliance with applicable laws and corporate governance standards.

Key Responsibilities

Corporate Secretarial & Governance

Support end-to-end corporate secretarial functions for Group companies across the UAE and international jurisdictions.

Assist in implementing governance frameworks, compliance review mechanisms, and internal control processes.

Coordinate Board Meetings, General Meetings, prepare agendas, minutes, and maintain statutory registers and corporate records.

Ensure timely filing of statutory documents and regulatory submissions.

Monitor compliance with applicable corporate laws and governance requirements.

Legal Documentation

Draft, review, and maintain agreements, contracts, MOUs, resolutions, powers of attorney, and other legal documents.

Coordinate with external legal counsel for legal opinions and documentation where required.

Maintain legal document repositories and ensure version control.

Company Incorporation & Corporate Structuring

Coordinate incorporation of companies across UAE Mainland, Free Zones, and

Offshore jurisdictions.

Handle incorporation in jurisdictions including DIFC, JAFZA, IFZA, Meydan,

RAKEZ, DMCC, and other UAE authorities.

Support establishment and restructuring of holding companies and international entities.

Process post-incorporation amendments including:

o Share transferso Addition or removal of shareholders

o Change in directors

o Amendment of share capital

o Amendment of business activities

o Trade licence renewals

Coordinate company liquidation and deregistration processes.

Regulatory Compliance

Liaise with Government Authorities, Free Zone Authorities, Ministry of Economy,

VARA, DLD, RERA, Immigration, and other regulatory bodies.

Coordinate licensing activities including:

o VARA Licence

o Innovation Licence

o RERA Licence

o Commercial Licence amendments

Support implementation of regulatory changes across the organization.

Maintain compliance calendars and ensure timely renewals.

AML & Compliance

Assist in AML inspections and regulatory reviews.

Conduct customer and stakeholder name screening and sanctions screening.

Assess screening results and escalate potential compliance risks.

Maintain KYC and compliance documentation.

Support implementation of AML policies and compliance procedures.

Stakeholder Management

Coordinate with external regulators, auditors, legal consultants, banks, and government departments.

Provide compliance guidance to internal departments.

Support business teams with legal and regulatory documentation requirements.

Documentation & Process Improvement

Design and maintain standard legal templates and compliance documentation.

Assist in developing SOPs, compliance workflows, and governance documentation.

Maintain digital and physical corporate records.

Support automation and continuous improvement initiatives within Legal &

Compliance.

Qualifications

raw.description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a Research Operations Analyst to support a multi-year mineral title consolidation program for one of the largest royalty funds in the United States.

This is a program-scale, long-term engagement that spans the full retitling pipeline- from title research through revenue recovery. The role begins with a strong focus on chain-of-title research, but is designed as an entry point into a broader operational career path across adjacent functions including curative resolution, owner communications, recording operations, and revenue administration.

The ideal candidate combines the analytical rigor of a legal researcher, the precision of a data analyst, and the operational adaptability to learn and execute across evolving workflows.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct structured chain-of-title research for owner/fund pairs, tracing ownership histories from current ownership back to origin.
  • Review and interpret legal documents including deeds, probate filings, court orders, affidavits, conveyance instruments, and powers of attorney.
  • Cross-reference ownership data across multiple sources (county records, ownership registers, transfer histories) to verify accuracy and identify discrepancies.
  • Identify and document title gaps, ownership defects, missing documents, inflated decimals, and chain breaks, and flag issues for review and resolution.
  • Classify ownership records using the program's A/B classification framework (clean title vs. curative required).
  • Enter research findings into structured databases using defined workflows and validation protocols.
  • Assemble and maintain complete evidence packs, including supporting documents, source references, and classification rationale, with proper version control.
  • Ensure all research outputs meet quality standards, targeting a 90%+ first-pass acceptance rate, and participate in quality control audits.
  • Navigate and extract data from county clerk and recorder systems across multiple jurisdictions, adapting to varying formats and access methods.
  • Use land records aggregator platforms where direct county access is limited or incomplete, and document county-specific access constraints.
  • Maintain consistent productivity against defined throughput benchmarks, with improving efficiency over time.
  • Follow established research methodologies, SOPs, and workflow protocols, and incorporate feedback to continuously improve accuracy.
  • Cross-train into additional operational functions over time, including curative resolution, owner communications, recording operations, operator engagement, and revenue transition workflows, following structured training and competency assessments.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Law, Business, Finance, Political Science, Public Administration, or a related field.
  • Strong analytical and research skills with exceptional attention to detail and ability to maintain accuracy across high-volume work.
  • Ability to read, interpret, and extract information from legal and property-related documents.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook) and comfort working with structured databases.
  • Strong written communication skills to document findings, flag issues, and assemble structured evidence files.
  • Ability to manage multiple workflows simultaneously while maintaining organization and meeting productivity targets.
  • Self-disciplined, reliable, and comfortable working within structured processes and defined methodologies.
  • Strong learning agility and adaptability as responsibilities expand across the operational pipeline.
  • Fluency in English is required; French, Arabic, or Urdu is a plus.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in title research, legal research, land records, real estate transactions, or property administration.
  • Familiarity with U.S. county records systems, land data platforms, or document aggregator services.
  • Understanding of property ownership structures, mineral rights, or chain-of-title concepts.
  • Experience in data entry, document review, or compliance-driven environments with quality standards.
  • Exposure to oil & gas operations, royalty administration, or mineral interest management.
  • Experience working in cross-functional, distributed teams across multiple time zones.

About this role

TFS HealthScience is a leading global mid-size Contract Research Organization (CRO) that partners with biotechnology and pharmaceutical companies throughout their entire clinical development journey. Our expertise includes full-service capabilities, resourcing, and Functional Service Provider (FSP) solutions.

The Clinical Research Associate (CRA) is responsible for ensuring clinical studies are conducted in accordance with the protocol, ICH-GCP guidelines, and applicable regulatory requirements. This role involves site management and monitoring activities throughout the study lifecycle to ensure patient safety, data quality, and study compliance.

As part of our FS team, you will be dedicated to one sponsor, a global pharmaceutical company that is an industry leader within its therapeutic area.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform site monitoring visits, including Site Selection Visits (SSVs), Site Initiation Visits (SIVs), Interim Monitoring Visits (IMVs), and Close-Out Visits (COVs).

  • Ensure investigator sites comply with study protocols, ICH-GCP, sponsor requirements, and local regulations.

  • Monitor patient safety, data quality, and study documentation throughout the clinical trial lifecycle.

  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with investigators, site staff, and sponsor stakeholders.

  • Support site readiness, subject recruitment, and issue resolution to ensure study timelines are met.

  • Identify, document, and escalate risks while supporting risk-based monitoring approaches.

  • Assist with audit and inspection readiness activities as required.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Nursing, Pharmacy, or a related field.

  • Minimum 3 years of independent clinical monitoring experience within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or CRO industry.

  • Experience in monitoring Medical Device studies.

  • Strong knowledge of ICH-GCP guidelines and applicable regulatory requirements.

  • Experience managing sites from initiation through close-out.

  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.

  • Fluent German and English, both written and spoken.

  • Nice-to-have: experience in MDR submissions

What We Offer

We provide opportunities for personal and professional growth in a rewarding environment. You will join a team that values collaboration, quality, and making a difference in the lives of patients.

Our core values of Trust, Quality, Passion, Flexibility, and Sustainability guide our decisions and shape our culture. By aligning on these values, we foster collaboration, innovation, and a shared commitment to excellence. Together, we make a difference.

A Bit More About Us

Our journey began over 30 years ago in Sweden, in the city of Lund. As a full-service global CRO, we build solution-driven teams working toward a healthier future. Bringing together over 600 professionals, TFS delivers tailored clinical research services in more than 50 countries, offering flexible clinical development and strategic resourcing solutions across key therapeutic areas including Dermatology, Neuroscience, Oncology, and Ophthalmology.

About Us:

TreeHouse Foods is a leading manufacturer of private label packaged foods and beverages, operating a network of over 20 production facilities and several corporate offices across the United States and Canada. At TreeHouse Foods, our commitment to excellence extends beyond our products and revolves around our people. We are investing in talent and creating a performance-based culture where employees can do their best work and develop their careers, directly impacting our mission to make high quality, affordable food for our customers, communities, and families. We hope you will consider joining the team and being part of our future.

Named one of America’s Best Large Employers by Forbes Magazine, we are proud to live by a strong set of values and strive to "Engage and Delight – One Customer at a Time." Guided by our values—Own It, Commit to Excellence, Be Agile, Speak Up, and Better Together. We are a diverse team driven by integrity, accountability, and a commitment to exceptional results. We embrace change, prioritize continuous learning, and foster collaboration, transparency, and healthy debate. Together, we set each other up for success to achieve enterprise-wide goals.

What You Gain:

  • Comprehensive paid time off opportunities, including immediate access to four weeks of vacation, five sick days, parental leave and 11 company holidays (including two floating holidays).
