Job Description:

About the Role:


We are seeking a strategic and collaborative Senior Project Manager, Automation & Packaging Engineering, to build and drive an automation strategy across TreeHouse and lead the execution of projects in the packaging and automation space. This hands-on role will define where and how we automate across our food manufacturing network, translate that strategy into a prioritized roadmap, and own high-impact projects from concept through start-up. You will partner with plants, business functions, and external automation and packaging experts to deliver safe, reliable, and sustainable results using a structured Initiative Management process.


You’ll add value to this role by performing various functions including, but not limited to:


  • Own assigned automation and packaging projects end-to-end, from concept and scope through design, procurement, installation, commissioning, start-up, and seamless handoff to Operations.
  • Collaboratively form and lead internal and external cross functional resources to develop a 5-year automation roadmap for manufacturing packaging and automation across TreeHouse.
  • Build and drive project scope, budget, and schedule, balancing speed, cost, quality, safety, and operational impact.
  • Create clear capital-approval and engineering deliverables, including charters, screening scopes, estimates, business cases, justifications, schedules, and technical specifications.
  • Lead vendors, contractors, partner engineering firms, and internal experts through procurement, construction, installation, and commissioning.
  • Responsible for the team’s project KPIs including safety, food safety, environmental impacts, operational impacts, adherence to scope, CQV performance, on time delivery, cash flow, and overall budget tracking.
  • Identify and manage execution risks early, maintain stakeholder alignment, and use disciplined escalation and change management to protect project outcomes.
  • Lead start-up and early equipment management to deliver stable, repeatable performance and a confident ramp-up for manufacturing teams.
  • Mentor, coach and lead team members, both internal and external, to ensure resources meet the business’ engineering needs.

Important Details:


  • This is a full-time role that is expected to travel approximately 50% across assigned plants
  • This remote role may be based near any of our manufacturing facilities, with preference for candidates near a major airport, particularly in the Chicago, Atlanta, or Dallas metro areas
  • The anticipated compensation for this position ranges from $132,300.00 – 198,500.00 USD Annually. This is the lowest to highest salary that we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, specific competencies, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, shift, travel requirements, sales or revenue-based metrics and business or organizational needs. For certain roles, the successful candidate may be eligible for annual discretionary merit compensation award, bonus and equity pay.

You’ll fit right in if you have:


  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering (mechanical, electrical, or similar) or related technical field
  • 7+ years of project management experience, including responsibility for multiple capital projects totaling approximately $15M annually and have experience with executing projects sized >$10M
  • Demonstrated experience leading automation and packaging projects in a food manufacturing environment across project engineering and/or project management
  • Experience developing multi-site automation strategies and roadmaps, with demonstrated strategic planning capabilities
  • Hands-on experience with industrial automation and controls (e.g., robotics, palletizing, vision systems) and with primary and secondary packaging systems (e.g., forming, filling, sealing, case packing, and end-of-line) preferred
  • Experience evaluating emerging automation and packaging technologies, selecting vendors, and building business cases that quantify ROI, labor productivity, and throughput gains
  • Formal project management training or certifications are a plus
  • Demonstrated track record of following LEAN Capital Initiative Management processes
  • An operational excellence mindset, challenging current processes both internally and externally with a commitment to bringing adaptable solutions forward
  • Clear, confident communication, technical writing, stakeholder management, and cross-functional influence skills.
  • Comfortable communicating, presenting & influencing senior leadership on key technical issues
  • Proficient with CADD and Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Project. Proven effectiveness in working collaboratively within a matrix organization

Silverback Strategies is a performance marketing agency built to help marketers grow and capitalize on change. Ad Age, Inc Magazine, The Washington Post, The Washingtonian, and The Washington Business Journal have recognized Silverback as one of the best places to work.

We hire the best and help them get better. Silverbackers are supported, challenged and inspired by their peers. Regardless of title or tenure, every Silverbacker plays a role in helping our agency get better. This is a place where you can make a difference.

What you will do:

    • Translate strategy into visuals: partner closely with our Creative Strategist to take research, hooks, and loose creative briefs and turn them into concrete visual concepts, storyboards, and finished assets
    • Produce both statics and video: design and build static ad creative and edit/produce short-form video and motion content for paid social at a consistently high craft level
    • Interpret brand guidance at any altitude: work from anything ranging from a thin one-pager to a comprehensive brand system, and reliably produce creative that's unmistakably on-brand either way
    • Navigate regulated-industry review cycles: produce creative that anticipates compliance and legal scrutiny, minimizing revision rounds and rejection risk without watering down creative quality
    • Push brands into new creative territory: identify opportunities to evolve a brand's creative expression to unlock scale and new-market growth, while staying inside brand-safety guardrails
    • Select and edit raw footage/imagery: review raw photography and video footage from shoots and select, crop, cut, and edit the strongest material into finished assets — no on-set creative direction required
    • Own asset quality and turnaround: deliver polished, client-ready work with minimal internal revision cycles so assets aren't burning days internally before they even reach the client
    • Maintain visual consistency at scale: keep creative consistent and on-brand across a high volume of ad variations, formats, and platform

What we are looking for:

    Core Experience
    • 5+ years in a hands-on creative production role — Art Director, Senior Designer, Creative Producer, or similar —with dedicated performance/paid social experience
    • A portfolio that shows range across both static design and video/motion editing, ideally for paid social specifically
    • Experience working within brand guidelines of varying depth and translating them into new creative applications
    • Experience in regulated or highly regulated industries (healthcare, finance, insurance, legal, or similar) is a strong plus, given our client base
    • Experience working in matrixed organizations with multiple stakeholders and layered approval processes

    Craft & Technical Skills
    • Expert-level proficiency in Figma (or similar) for static design and layout
    • Strong proficiency in After Effects (or similar) for motion graphics and video editing
    • Comfortable editing raw video/photo footage into finished assets: selects, cuts, pacing, captions/graphics overlays
    • Working knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Premiere, Illustrator) as needed
    • Understands platform-specific creative specs and best practices across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, and other paid social channels

    Creative & Strategic Judgment

    • A strong eye for what "good" looks like in modern performance advertising — thumb-stopping, polished, and effective, not just pretty
    • Understands performance/paid-social fundamentals (hooks, pacing, hierarchy, CTAs) well enough to make smart creative calls independently, without needing to run the strategy
    • Can take a loose brief or visual direction and fill in the gaps with sound creative judgment
    • High attention to detail — typos, brand misapplications, and spec errors don't make it to client review
    • Comfortable giving and receiving fast, iterative feedback in a deadline-driven environment

    Working Style
    • Thrives on speed without sacrificing polish — this role owns production timelines that need to move fast to offset long approval cycles
    • Collaborative by nature; sees the Creative Strategist as a partner, not a hand-off point
    • Self-sufficient in production; doesn't need heavy oversight to get from brief to finished asset

What success looks like:

    • Assets consistently reach client/compliance review in 1–2 internal revision rounds or fewer
    • Creative reliably passes compliance and legal review with minimal rework
    • Output balances brand safety with creative freshness — clients see growth and new territory, not just "more of the same"
    • The Strategist and Senior Performance Creative function as a true two-person creative engine, each covering what the other doesn't

What This Role Is Not:

    • Not a photo/video shoot creative director — you won't be expected to run or direct live shoots, just to select and edit from what's captured
    • Not a pure strategist — research, testing frameworks, and reporting live with the Creative Strategist, not this role

—Why Silverback?—

    Silverback isn’t for everybody. If you’re an A player, you will get paid more, learn more and grow faster with support from a smart and fun team. If you’re a B player, you will be miserable

  • Make an impact: We’re a small agency. Everybody has the opportunity to drive change and impact

  • Get paid: We hire the best and pay them generously

  • Do cool sh*t: From media to SEO to measurement, learn the cutting edge of what works

—Benefits & Perks—

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision plans

  • Virtual Team Events and a fun, casual, inclusive company culture

  • Company-paid ClassPass membership

  • 12 weeks of Paid Parental Leave

  • Summer Fridays

  • 401(k) with Employer Match

Customer Success Managers are naturally curious about PTC solutions and the domains they are used in and seek hands-on experience while working with experts in the field to best understand how PTC’s solutions help our customers meet their business objectives. If you have deep domain and relationship management experience, we want you to join our team.


Responsibilities:

  • Advance PTC’s relationship with Direct Strategic/Enterprise and Commercial customers.
  • Establish and maintain the partnership operating framework, ensuring stakeholder engagement to drive effective adoption, expansion and renewal.
  • Function as a trusted advisor for the client’s executive, program and technical teams, collaborating tightly with PTC stakeholders.
  • Act as the voice of the customer within PTC, providing critical feedback to enhance the overall experience, product quality, and identify market growth opportunities.
  • Contribute as an integral member of the account team(s); properly identifying and reacting to new threats/opportunities, maintaining proactive engagement, and providing account management support.
  • Effectively manage critical adoption programs for key accounts as designated by the Customer Success and Sales Regional Directors.
  • Ensure a rapid and successful adoption of any acquired solutions and ensure that customers realize value from these solutions.

Preferred Skills and Experience:

  • Domain experience with CAD, PLM or ALM software plus the ability to understand how these solutions are implemented
  • Experience working with accounts in the Electronics and High tech (EHT) industry
  • Well-developed oral and written communication skills with a proven ability to listen and tailor messages for multiple audiences from executive decision-makers to staff at all levels.
  • Broad understanding of business functions and priorities, with the ability to translate technical and operational issues into business terms and value propositions, ensuring executive support for long-term improvements
  • Basic practical understanding of project management and ability to multi-task while coordinating activities from multiple functions in a matrix environment.

Competencies:

  • Integrity & Trust: You have an established record of trust and are seen as a direct, thoughtful individual unafraid to present the unvarnished truth in an appropriate and helpful manner. You keep confidences, admit your mistakes and never misrepresent yourself or the company for personal gain.
  • Composure: You thrive in ambiguous environments, stay cool under pressure and do not become defensive or irritated and are the one who can be counted on to hold things together during tough times.
  • Organizational Agility: You are knowledgeable about how organizations work and know how to get things done both through formal channels and the informal network. You are an expert at understanding the culture of organizations and how to navigate them while building and maintaining consistent key policies, practices and procedures to provide a consistent high level client experience.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Ability to speak, read and write in fluent English
  • Cover customer based out of United States of America
  • 8+ years of Customer Success, Project Management, Program Management or relevant industry experience
  • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience
  • Ability to travel ~25% of time to the US

Life at PTC is about more than working with today’s most cutting-edge technologies to transform the physical world. It’s about showing up as you are and working alongside some of today’s most talented industry leaders to transform the world around you.

If you share our passion for problem-solving through innovation, you’ll likely become just as passionate about the PTC experience as we are. Are you ready to explore your next career move with us?

We respect the privacy rights of individuals and are committed to handling Personal Information responsibly and in accordance with all applicable privacy and data protection laws. Review our Privacy Policy here."

raw.description:
A Note On How To Reach Us

We're truly grateful that so many people have Foundant on their radar — it means a lot that our work resonates with others. That said, due to the high volume of direct messages and emails we receive, cold outreach isn't the preferred way to be considered for a role, and we're not able to prioritize applications submitted this way. To apply for open positions, please visit our careers page, which is the fastest and most effective route to being considered.

About Foundant

At Foundant, we build mission-critical software for the social good ecosystem — helping foundations, grantmakers, nonprofits, and community organizations streamline their work, strengthen relationships, and maximize their impact. We serve the giving community worldwide with a comprehensive suite of solutions spanning grant management, community foundation software, and giving analytics.

We're a unified company shaped by strong roots across our product portfolio, and we operate with intention and purpose. Our team of ~350 people across six countries is connected by a shared North Star: to be the trusted partner and strategic advisor to the communities we serve.

Where You’ll Work:
  • As a remote-first workplace, we believe in offering flexibility and the freedom to work where it suits you best, while staying connected through technology. Our global network of talent is supported by physical office hubs and virtual collaboration, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation and growth thrive.
  • With office locations in Bozeman, MT, Toronto, Canada, and Dublin, Ireland, you'll be part of a globally connected team. Whether you're working remotely or from one of our office locations, you'll be contributing to a vibrant, collaborative culture focused on driving meaningful impact across the world.
WhatYou’llDo:
  • You’ll build your own pipeline. Consistent, personalized outreach to corporations with giving programs, research funders, and healthcare organizations is the foundation of your results. You see it as the best way to sharpen your craft, because earning a response to a cold email or call is the hardest part of selling. Marketing and BDR-sourced leads are a welcome bonus on top of your own efforts, never a substitute for them.
  • You’ll own the full sales cycle and its results, carrying each opportunity from first conversation through a signed deal.
  • You’ll run discovery that goes past the surface request, listening for the mission, constraints, and outcomes each organization is working toward, reading both the people and the process, and shaping solutions that fit what they’re trying to achieve.
  • You’ll deliver clear, compelling demos and proposals that connect Foundant’s grant management and giving solutions, including our purpose-built AI, to the results your prospect cares about.
  • You’ll work through multi-stakeholder buying processes, including corporate approval processes, committee reviews, and security reviews, keeping every stakeholder informed and bringing in your director and senior colleagues as deals grow more complex.
  • You’ll think critically about how to position Foundant for each buyer and learn how our internal teams work together, so you know who to involve, when, and why.
  • You’ll use AI to work smarter, from account research to outreach to proposal preparation, and you’ll apply critical thinking to how you use it: checking its outputs, protecting data, and keeping your own judgment in the lead.
  • You’ll partner with Marketing, Revenue Operations, Product, and Client teams, and hand off every new client with full context so the team that takes over is set up to succeed from day one.
  • You’ll learn from senior Account Executives and your director, asking for feedback on discovery, demos, and deal strategy and applying it in your next conversation.
  • You’ll share what you’re hearing from buyers with your director and cross-functional partners, so what you learn in the field helps shape how we sell.
  • You’ll hold yourself accountable for accurate pipeline data and forecasts in our CRM, using that data to prioritize your time and flag risks early, including your own.
  • Other duties as assigned.
WhatYou’llNeed:
  • 2–5 years of B2B SaaS sales experience
  • Demonstrated history of meeting or exceeding sales targets in a full-cycle sales role
  • Experience building your own pipeline through proactive, personalized outbound outreach
  • Experience working multi-stakeholder sales cycles, ideally including procurement, committee, or security reviews
  • Sound judgment and critical thinking, including the ability to use AI tools thoughtfully and evaluate their output
  • Proficiency with a CRM platform for pipeline management and forecasting
  • Must be legally eligible to work in the United States
  • A plus: Experience in corporate, research, or healthcare philanthropic programs, grantmaking, social good sector
WhatYou’llBring to our Team Dynamics:

Adaptive Achievement

Owns a pipeline and a number, building that pipeline through self-driven outreach and keeping deals moving through shifting buyer priorities and long, multi-stakeholder buying cycles. Follows through when a deal gets hard, not just when it’s going well, and takes responsibility for outcomes, including misses.

Productive Collaboration

Works hand in hand with Marketing, Revenue Operations, Product, and Client teams, applying emotional intelligence to build trust across the organization. Hands off new clients with context, so the relationship doesn’t restart at signature.

Service Orientation

Treats every prospect conversation as the start of a long-term relationship: listens for the mission behind the request, reads what’s said and unsaid, and recommends what will genuinely serve the client’s outcomes, even when it isn’t the fastest path to a close.

Business Insight

Builds a working understanding of how corporate giving programs, research funders, and healthcare organizations manage their grants and giving, and connects Foundant’s solutions to those outcomes. Thinks critically about positioning and about how AI is used in their own work, and uses pipeline data to prioritize accounts and forecast accurately.

Active Learning

Ramps quickly on Foundant’s solutions and the segment’s funding landscape, stays curious about evolving needs, asks for feedback from clients, peers, and deal reviews, applies it noticeably in the next conversation, and adjusts without being told.

Why You’ll Love Working at Foundant:
  • At the heart of everything we do is a commitment to innovation and making a positive impact. Whether you’re working on projects that empower not-for-profits, community foundations, or corporations, your contributions will help drive real-world change.
  • We offer competitive salary and benefits, including tuition, and lifestyle reimbursements, and bespoke mindfulness and fitness initiatives.
  • With our Flexible PTO policy, you’ll have the freedom to manage your time in a way that supports your personal well-being and professional success.
  • We’re committed to your professional and personal development. With our merger, you'll have the chance to collaborate across teams, giving you exposure to diverse ideas, expertise, and projects that span multiple industries.
  • As part of a larger organization, you’ll have even more opportunities to grow your career. Whether it’s exploring new roles, leadership opportunities, or shifting to a different department, we support internal mobility to help you achieve your career goals
  • You’ll enjoy autonomy and responsibility, empowering you to approach your work creatively and independently, fostering innovation and independent thought.
  • Employee recognition is a core part of our culture. When you do a great job, we make sure everyone knows about it!

Foundant is an equal opportunity employer, committed to building a diverse workforce that represents the communities we serve. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified candidates, and will consider all applicants without regard to race, color, citizenship, religion, sex, marital/family status, sexual orientation, gender identity, Indigenous status, age, disability, or individuals who may require accommodation.

Foundant is also committed to providing accommodations throughout the interview and employment process. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in all aspects of the selection process. If you have accessibility requirements during the recruitment process and require accommodation, please contact .

raw.title: Senior Director – Cyber Security Operations
raw.excerpt: Job Summary: WHO ARE WE?  Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship.
raw.description:
Job Summary:

WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide. Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit .

WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on!

THE TEAM

The Cyber Defense and Incident Response team operates within the Corporate Information Security and Privacy Organization and are a critical function within Live Nation Entertainment. We specialize in detecting and responding to adverse events within our global network and provide snap response times to mitigate the impact of potential threats.

THE ROLE

As Senior Director - Cyber Security Operations, you will provide the first layer of defense by continuously improving current detections through innovative automation techniques that improve detection and response times to intercept and defend against cyberattacks.

You will be the subject matter expert in all things related to threat detection and response. Learning how the adversary operates and their key objectives is imperative to protecting and defending against damage to mission-critical systems. Detecting these precursors allows the team to respond quickly to reduce the risk to the organization.

You will work with a team that shares a common goal: continuously improving threat detection and response by building a strong team of SMEs who share ownership of the mission and the duty to protect the global organization.

We are growing our team to provide threat detection and incident response capabilities for Live Nation Entertainment; this is an exciting time to join!

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

  • Prepare, detect, respond and mitigate against cyber threats, protecting Live Nation Entertainment data and assets utilizing industry information security best practices

  • Lead a geographically dispersed team of technical detection and response analysts who are responsible for monitoring, detecting, triaging, and responding to security events and incidents in Live Nation Entertainment’s 24x7 global network

  • Implementation of detection methodologies with a solid understanding of how to baseline network traffic and monitor for anomalous activity for early detection and mitigation

  • Responsible for all management activities related to the Threat Detection and Response team’s operations including people management, training, and mentoring of direct reports

  • Leverage automation and orchestration solutions to automate repetitive tasks

  • Network, collaborate, and engage multiple internal and external teams and subject matter experts to address cybersecurity issues to reduce overall organizational risk

  • Contribute to and support team projects and strategic initiatives, including improving current workflows and processes to mature our monitoring and response capabilities

  • Assist with incident response as events are escalated to include threat hunting, data collection/analysis, triage, containment, remediation, and documentation

  • Champion process documentation and lessons learned to improve team efficiency and consistency for scalable response operations to ensure continuous improvement of internal playbooks

  • Develop and deliver metrics that measure the team’s efficiency and effectiveness to leadership

  • Manage career development for team members, including training and mentoring, conducting performance reviews and exhibiting behaviors to be modeled by team members

  • Drive a culture of inclusiveness and team unity to deliver exceptional customer service within the team and to our partner teams

  • Research and stay current on the latest trends, best practices, and technology developments

  • Participate in on-call weekly rotations with other team members (Required)

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING - REQUIRED

  • 8+ years of Information Technology experience

    • Member of a Security Operations Center (SOC)

    • Security Incident Response Analyst or supporting function (2 years minimum)

    • eDiscovery or related role performing forensic functions

  • 6+ years of people management experience

  • 2+ years of Information Security and Incident Response or similar discipline

  • 2+ years of Linux/Unix, Mac and Windows system analysis experience

  • Technical Cyber Security Certification(s) required (min. 1): GCED, GCDA, GDAT etc.

  • BA/BS in Computer Science, Information Security, or Information Systems or equivalent related work experience

  • Experience working in a large enterprise and management of a wide range of security tools such as IDS/IPS (network and host), advanced anti-malware (network and endpoint), DLP, encryption, anti-virus, firewalls, identity management, NAC, etc.

  • Familiarity with security standards NIST Cyber Security Framework, NIST SP800-61 R2 and ISO/IEC 27035

  • Experience with threat modeling concepts such as threat indicators, threats actors and attack surfaces

  • Understanding of network architecture and security infrastructure placement

  • Experience with SIEM technologies (i.e. ArcSight, Splunk, Elk Stack)

  • In-depth technical knowledge of Windows and Unix/Linux based operating systems

  • Travel is at a minimum, but some domestic and international travel is required

  • Must be willing to be available 24x7 during weekly on-call rotations

  • Must be willing to work non-traditional hours which may occur over weekends and holidays in support of incidents as needed

  • Exceptional ability to remain calm under stress

  • Must be able to pass a criminal background check and a U.S. government security clearance if requested

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING - TECHNICAL SKILLS

  • Identify and understand how malware and threat actors operate at a functional level, as well as understanding their main objectives, to reduce the potential spread and impact

  • Demonstrate knowledge of relevant data sources to log in the SIEM

  • Utilize threat detection and other tools to analyze event logs to prevent and detect adversary attacks

  • Experience with containment, eradication, and remediation while preserving forensic artifacts for analysis

  • Practical level of understanding of security benchmarks and hardening of devices to reduce their attack surface, both physical and cloud devices

  • Innovative Content Development. Develop detection rules that perform aggregate and correlated activity detections across the security stack leveraging API automation integrations

  • Experience with escalating and participating in small- and large-scale incident response activities to include threat hunting, containment, and remediation

  • Technical Savvy. Must be able to design and implement dashboards, reports and queries using various query and scripting languages

  • Ability to reverse engineer how a network or endpoint was compromised to develop new detections to prevent future attacks of the same

  • Consistent and proven ability to generate well-organized notes at a high-level and ability to document timelines of events and incidents in the internal ticketing system

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING - BEHAVIORS AND SKILLS

  • Strong sense of moral character, high-ethical standards, servant-leader and accountability

  • Very strong leadership skills with the ability to maintain team composure during times of high stress

  • Highly meticulous with exceptional attention to detail

  • Analytical and strategic mindset to overcome obstacles and solve complex problems

  • Have a global mind-set for working with different cultures and backgrounds

  • Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to complete tasks assigned in a timely manner

  • Ability to develop team projects and execute strategic initiatives to completion

  • Strong negotiation, influence, mediation & conflict management skills

  • Embraces mentorship, knowledge sharing and teaming skills

  • Excellent English written and verbal communication skills, additional languages is a plus

  • Excellent customer service skills required

  • Flexible and responsive to changing situations

  • Self-driven, self-disciplined to perform tasks and complete projects with little to no supervision, with a high sense of duty

This job description is a summary of duties that are expected to be performed. Duties outlined in this job description may not be all-inclusive and can be modified at any time if requested by management.

BENEFITS & PERKS

Our motto is ‘Taking Care of Our Own’ through 6 pillars of benefits:

  • HEALTH: Medical, vision, dental and mental health benefits for you and your family, with access to a health care concierge, and Flexible or Health Savings Accounts (FSA or HSA)

  • YOURSELF: Free concert tickets, generous paid time off including paid holidays, sick time, and personal days

  • WEALTH: 401(k) program with company match, stock reimbursement program

  • FAMILY: New parent programs including caregiver leave and baby bonuses, plus fertility, adoption, foster, or surrogacy support

  • CAREER: Career and skill development programs with School of Live, tuition reimbursement, and student loan repayment

  • OTHERS: Volunteer time off, crowdfunding match

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

We aspire to build teams that reflect and support the fans and artists we serve. Every day we aim to promote environments where everyone can be themselves, contribute fully, and thrive within our company and at our events. As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with.

Live Nation strongly supports equal employment opportunity for all applicants regardless of age (40 and over), ancestry, color, religious creed (including religious dress and grooming practices), family and medical care leave or the denial of family and medical care leave, mental or physical disability (including HIV and AIDS), marital status, domestic partner status, medical condition (including cancer and genetic characteristics), genetic information, military and veteran status, political affiliation, national origin (including language use restrictions), citizenship, race, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding and medical conditions related to pregnancy, childbirth or breastfeeding), gender, gender identity, and gender expression, sexual orientation, intersectionality, or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state or local law, rule, ordinance or regulation.

We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of the Los Angeles Fair Chance Ordinance, San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the California Fair Chance Act and consistent with other similar and / or applicable laws in other areas.

We also afford equal employment opportunities to qualified individuals with a disability. For this reason, Live Nation will make reasonable accommodations for the known physical or mental limitations of an otherwise qualified individual with a disability who is an applicant consistent with its legal obligations to do so, including reasonable accommodations related to pregnancy in accordance with applicable local, state and / or federal law. As part of its commitment to make reasonable accommodations, Live Nation also wishes to participate in a timely, good faith, interactive process with a disabled applicant to determine effective reasonable accommodations, if any, which can be made in response to a request for accommodations. Applicants are invited to identify reasonable accommodations that can be made to assist them to perform the essential functions of the position they seek. Any applicant who requires an accommodation in order to perform the essential functions of the job should contact a Human Resources Representative to request the opportunity to participate in a timely interactive process. Live Nation will also provide reasonable religious accommodations on a case-by-case basis.

HIRING PRACTICES
The preceding job description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of employees assigned to this job.

Live Nation recruitment policies are designed to place the most highly qualified persons available in a timely and efficient manner. Live Nation may pursue all avenues available, including promotion from within, employee referrals, outside advertising, employment agencies, internet recruiting, job fairs, college recruiting and search firms.

The expected compensation for this position is:

$188,000.00 USD - $235,000.00 USD

** Pay is based on a number of factors including market location, qualifications, skills, and experience.

Live Nation Entertainment will never request payment or equipment purchases as part of the hiring process. Recruiters will only contact candidates from official Live Nation or affiliated brand email domains.

raw.description:
At Side, we partner with some of the world's leading developers and publishers to solve complex production challenges and help bring exceptional games to life. From concept through live operations, our co-development teams work as trusted extensions of our clients' studios, contributing expertise across design, engineering, art, audio, QA, and production.

We're looking for a Senior Level Artist to own game spaces from blockout through final polish, combining gameplay layout, world building, and visual composition. You'll work with a library of pre-generated assets to create, refine, and integrate spaces that are both visually compelling and effective to play.

This is a remote freelance contract for approximately 3–6 months, with up to 40 hours per week of support needed. Candidates must be available to overlap with the CEST team's working hours; location is otherwise flexible.

As these are project-based opportunities, positions may be amended, postponed, or withdrawn as a result of changing client requirements and project priorities.

Requirements

What you'll be doing:

Level & World Building

  • Own spaces from blockout through final polish, balancing gameplay layout with visual composition, staging, lighting, and world-building.
  • Create, refine, and integrate pre-generated assets into cohesive, playable game environments.
  • Make intentional decisions about player flow, composition, sightlines, and navigation to support the gameplay experience.

Unreal Engine & Performance

  • Build and polish environments in Unreal Engine with a strong understanding of composition, lighting, and in-engine presentation.
  • Manage streaming, HLODs, draw calls, frame budgets, and memory budgets, personally optimizing spaces to meet performance targets.
  • Use Unreal PCG and Houdini to support efficient world-building and asset placement workflows.

Gameplay Integration

  • Implement level features, triggers, and interactives using Unreal Blueprints.
  • Collaborate with design, art, and engineering teams to ensure spaces support both gameplay and visual goals.
  • Take ownership of spaces across multiple stages of development, from initial blockout through a shipped, cancelled, or personal project.

What we're looking for:

  • 5+ years of experience in level design, level art, or world building.
  • A portfolio demonstrating composition, staging, lighting, and playable spaces built in-engine; portfolios should show environments from a player's perspective rather than primarily props or asset reels.
  • Deep experience building worlds and spaces in Unreal Engine, with the ability to own both gameplay layout and visual execution.
  • Strong gameplay layout literacy, including the ability to make and articulate intentional decisions around player flow, navigation, sightlines, and spatial composition.
  • Experience owning a space through multiple stages of a development pipeline, including shipped, cancelled, or personal projects.
  • Proven experience managing and optimizing streaming, HLODs, draw calls, frame budgets, and memory budgets.
  • Working knowledge of Unreal Blueprints for implementing level features, triggers, and interactives.
  • Experience with Unreal PCG and Houdini.
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of a space from blockout through final polish.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with material and shader authoring.
  • Experience with terrain tools such as Gaea, World Machine, or equivalent.
  • Background in architecture, urban planning, or production design.
  • Experience working on open-world or large-scale streaming worlds.
  • Experience authoring tools using Python or Blueprints.

Benefits

  • Competitive Salary.
  • Dynamic, multicultural and fun environment.
  • You will be working for the world's leading provider of game services.
  • We empower our people and offer regular progression opportunities to ensure our employees flourish.

About Side
Side (formerly PTW) is a global video game development and services provider, offering technical and creative solutions to many of the largest developers and studios around the world. Founded in 2009 and drawing on 30+ years' experience from our parent company in Japan, Side has since grown to become a global force with 20 studios in 14 countries across North America, Europe, South America, and Asia.

Our industry-leading services include game development, art production, audio production, quality assurance, localization, localization QA, player support, community management, and datasets.

Experience our side of life. For more information, visit

Tu conçois et fais évoluer l'expérience AssessFirst dans son ensemble, de la compréhension du problème jusqu'à la mise en production. Tu travailles au quotidien avec notre Lead Designer, les Product Managers, les Front-end Engineers et les ML Engineers pour transformer des problématiques complexes en expériences simples, intuitives et engageantes.

Tu contribues directement aux décisions produit, tu challenges les solutions, tu prototypes rapidement et tu testes tes idées avant de les transformer en expériences utilisées à grande échelle. Une part importante du rôle consiste à imaginer les nouvelles interactions rendues possibles par l'IA : agents, copilots, interfaces conversationnelles, voice AI et expériences dynamiques ou génératives.

Tes missions :

  • Product Design : concevoir les fonctionnalités et expériences de bout en bout, de la discovery à la mise en production, en collaboration avec les Product Managers et les équipes Engineering.

  • AI-native experience : concevoir des expériences intégrant agents IA, copilots, conversational UI et voice AI, en lien avec les ML Engineers.

  • Design system et visual craft : maintenir et faire évoluer le design system AssessFirst, garantir la qualité du visual design et du motion, sur tous les supports.

  • Product building : construire des prototypes interactifs ou fonctionnels et collaborer directement avec les Front-end Engineers jusqu'à la mise en production.

  • Recherche continue : mener recherche utilisateur, tests et analyses d'usage, et mesurer l'efficacité des expériences après leur lancement.

Ta future équipe

Tu feras partie de l'équipe Product composée de 6 personnes.

Tu travailleras également en étroite collaboration avec notre Lead Designer, les Product Managers, les Front-end Engineers et les ML Engineers.

Expérience souhaitée

🎨 5+ ans d'expérience en Product Design sur des produits digitaux réellement mis en production.

🤖 Expérience sur des produits intégrant agents IA, copilots, conversational UI ou voice AI.

🧩 Expérience dans la création ou l'évolution de design systems.

📐 Solide culture produit et capacité à travailler à partir de problématiques encore peu définies.

💻 Bonne compréhension des technologies web et aisance dans la collaboration avec les équipes techniques.

🖌️ Maîtrise avancée de Figma et FigJam, notamment des composants, du prototypage et des design systems.

⚡ Utilisation régulière d'outils d'IA (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) pour accélérer la recherche, l'exploration et la conception ; appétence pour des outils comme FigmaMake, Cursor, v0, Lovable ou Framer.

🇬🇧 Anglais professionnel indispensable.

Qu'est ce que tu obtiendras ?

Fourchette salariale :60-70K fixe

Autonomie & flexibilité :tu t’organises librement selon les priorités et les projets du moment.

Full remote :travaille d’où tu veux en Europe ! 🌍

Tickets resto :carte Swile à 10 € par jour travaillé.

Mutuelle :couverture santé avec Alan.

Épargne & participation :dispositif d’épargne salariale et de participation.

Bien-être :participation à tes activités sportives, chèques cadeaux et plateforme d’avantages.

Coworking :accès à des espaces partagés jusqu’à 6 fois par mois avec Worklib.

Vie d’équipe :une culture forte et quatre séminaires par an pour se retrouver.

Notre processus de recrutement:

  1. Notre annonce te parle et te donne envie d’en savoir plus

  2. Tu remplis nos tests en ligne en postulant (tu recevras un lien par email).

  3. L'équipe Talent te contacte

  4. 3 entretiens maximum : avec Yohan (Team Lead) et Sima (UX/UI Designer), puis Kévin (Lead Developer Front) et Emeric (ton futur n+1), et enfin Quentin (CEO) et David notre fondateur !

  5. Bienvenue, tu fais désormais partie de l'équipe ! 👏

Business Development Manager (BDM) Pakistan

Location: Pakistan (Remote/Flexible)
Base Salary: $2,400 USD per year + Commission
Experience Level: Mid-level (3+ years in trading, prop firm, or fintech industry)
Department: Global Growth & Sales Strategy

About the Role

CK Funded is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Business Development Manager based in Pakistan to help lead our expansion in the South Asian trading market. This role is perfect for someone with a strong academic background, deep experience in the trading industry, and a proven ability to drive growth through strategic partnerships and client acquisition.

As a BDM, you'll be responsible for building CK Funded brand presence in Pakistan, forming relationships with traders, influencers, and institutions, and ensuring consistent pipeline growth.

What You Will Do

  • Develop and execute business development strategies tailored to Pakistans trading landscape

  • Identify and onboard trading influencers, partners, affiliates, academies, and institutions

  • Promote CK Funded trading challenges, funding models, and unique value proposition to local markets

  • Represent CK Funded at virtual events, digital campaigns, webinars, and community platforms

  • Manage and grow a qualified pipeline of leads and close high-potential traders

  • Work closely with internal teams (marketing, support, and product) to align local efforts with global strategies

  • Provide weekly market feedback and performance reports to senior management

  • Help localize offers, promotions, and communication for cultural relevance

  • Uphold the brands professionalism and ethics in all communications and partnerships

Qualifications

  • Bachelors degree or higher in Business, Finance, Marketing, or a relevant field (Internationally recognized degrees preferred)

  • Fluency in English and Urdu (both written and verbal)

  • Strong understanding of the trading industry, including prop firms, forex, and funding challenges

  • Skilled in using CRM tools such as HubSpot, Salesforce, or Zoho

  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills

  • Certifications in financial markets, trading, or digital sales are a plus

Experience

  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in business development, sales, or partnership management

  • Previous experience in a prop firm, trading platform, forex brokerage, or fintech company is required

  • Demonstrated success in achieving targets and building scalable growth systems

  • Deep knowledge of Pakistans trading audience, behaviour, and content channels

  • Familiarity with digital marketing campaigns and trader acquisition funnels

What We Offer

  • Base salary of $2,400 USD per year

  • Attractive, uncapped commission structure based on performance

  • Remote work flexibility with full access to our global systems and support

  • Opportunity to lead and shape CK Funded market presence in Pakistan

  • Career growth opportunities into regional leadership roles based on performance

  • Fast-paced, impact-driven fintech culture

If you're a BDM with deep ties to the trading industry in Pakistan, hungry to grow, and ready to make your mark we want to hear from you.

Apply now and become part of CK Funded mission to empower traders across the world.

raw.description:
Expression is seeking a Principal DevOps & Site Reliability Engineer to lead the reliability, security, and operation of VOR, our platform for connecting data, AI agents, and workflows to support complex operational needs.

You will work alongside software engineers, product owners, and security stakeholders to make VOR easier to deploy, operate, troubleshoot, and recover. Our environment includes independently deployable products, Kubernetes, AWS GovCloud, infrastructure as code, and automated build and release pipelines.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will write code, improve infrastructure, investigate failures, and guide decisions that affect the whole platform. We are looking for someone who can connect infrastructure choices to user experience, establish practical operating standards, and help the team deliver reliably without creating unnecessary complexity.

Clearance: No security clearance is required. Eligibility to obtain a clearance is a plus.
Location: Remote

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the technical direction for VOR’s infrastructure, deployment automation, observability, and reliability practices.
  • Build and maintain reproducible cloud environments using Terraform, Kubernetes, Helm, and AWS services, including EKS.
  • Improve GitLab CI/CD pipelines so builds, tests, artifact publication, and deployments are dependable, secure, and easy to diagnose.
  • Design deployment and recovery approaches that protect availability, account for stateful dependencies, and make failures recoverable.
  • Establish service-level objectives, actionable monitoring, and useful logs, metrics, and traces based on user journeys and operational risks.
  • Lead incident investigation and recovery, communicate impact clearly, and turn findings into lasting improvements through blameless reviews.
  • Develop and exercise backup, restore, and disaster recovery procedures, verifying that systems and data can be recovered.
  • Partner with developers to improve service health checks, resource management, configuration, failure handling, and operational readiness.
  • Strengthen identity and access management, secrets handling, network boundaries, and software supply chain controls in partnership with security stakeholders.
  • Diagnose performance, capacity, and cost issues across application services, data ingestion and retrieval, and AI-enabled workflows.
  • Improve local development and test environments so engineers can reproduce problems and validate changes before deployment.
  • Use approved AI tools to accelerate investigation, scripting, infrastructure development, and documentation while reviewing and verifying their output.
  • Mentor engineers, document important technical decisions, and build shared operational knowledge across the team.

Required Qualifications

  • Substantial experience operating production software systems, with demonstrated ownership of reliability and infrastructure improvements across multiple services or teams.
  • Experience providing technical leadership at Staff level or equivalent: setting direction, resolving ambiguous problems, and delivering improvements through collaboration.
  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS, Kubernetes, containers, and infrastructure as code.
  • Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and repeatable environment provisioning.
  • Strong Linux and networking fundamentals, including practical troubleshooting of DNS, TLS, routing, load balancing, and connectivity.
  • Ability to write and maintain production-quality automation in Python, Go, or a comparable language, and work effectively with shell scripting.
  • Experience building observability that supports diagnosis and action, including service-level objectives, alerting, and distributed system troubleshooting.
  • Experience responding to production incidents and validating recovery procedures for stateful systems.
  • Sound judgment about security, availability, cost, and delivery speed, with the ability to explain tradeoffs clearly.
  • Ability to work across application and infrastructure boundaries, influence decisions without relying on reporting authority, and help other engineers become more effective.
  • A degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with AWS GovCloud, restricted networks, or government and national security environments.
  • Familiarity with FedRAMP or DoD security requirements and translating security expectations into maintainable engineering controls.
  • Experience with GitLab CI/CD, Terraform, Helm, EKS, and private container registries.
  • Experience operating data platforms, ingestion pipelines, search and retrieval services, or applications that use language models.
  • Familiarity with OIDC, OAuth, Keycloak, and workload identity.
  • Experience with artifact signing, software bills of materials, vulnerability management, and delivery into disconnected environments.
  • Experience establishing reliability practices as a platform and engineering organization grow.
  • Eligibility to obtain a U.S. security clearance.

What Success Looks Like

Engineers can deploy changes confidently, understand failures quickly, and recover services using procedures the team has tested. Monitoring reflects what users depend on, alerts lead to useful action, and recurring incidents become less frequent.

You help the team make clear decisions about reliability, security, capacity, and cost. Your impact extends beyond the infrastructure you build: other engineers can operate it, improve it, and take ownership with confidence.

Benefits:

Expression offers competitive salaries and benefits, such as:

  • 401k matching
  • PPO and HDHP medical/dental/vision insurance
  • Education reimbursement
  • Complimentary life insurance
  • Generous PTO and holiday leave
  • Onsite office gym access
  • Commuter Benefits Plan

About Expression:

Founded in 1997 and headquartered in Washington DC, Expression provides data fusion, data analytics, AI/ML, software engineering, information technology, and electromagnetic spectrum management solutions to the U.S. Department of Defense, Department of State, Department of Commerce, and national security community. Expression’s culture focuses on creating immediate and sustainable value for our clients via agile delivery of tailored solutions built through constant engagement with our clients.

We make sure to provide everyone with the tools and opportunities to grow while working on some of the newest technologies in the industry. We get excited about celebrating our professionals' milestones, accomplishments, promotions, overcoming challenges, and many other aspects that make an engaging collaborative environment.

Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled
Expression is an Equal Opportunity Employer. If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please submit your request to our Human Resources department through the application portal.
